🏷️ 标题要求

需要自拟标题吗？

DSE English Paper 2 / Paper 3 常考文体的标题要求一览。写之前先确认：本题要不要自拟标题？

✅ 需要自拟标题
Article 文章标题是必备格式元素，需吸引读者、概括主题
Feature Article 专题文章需自拟标题 + byline（署名）
Column 专栏与 article 类似，需有标题
Blog Entry / Blog Post 网志需有 blog title，通常还加日期
Essay 议论文/随笔包括 argumentative / opinion / theme / two-sided essay 等
Proposal 建议书常用格式 "Proposal for ___"
Report 报告常用 "A Report on ___" / "Report on ___"
Editorial 社论需有标题
Profile 人物简介Paper 3 常见，需有标题
Press Release 新闻稿Paper 3 常见，需有 heading/title
Leaflet / Pamphlet 小册子/单张需有 eye-catching title
Review 书评/影评Book Review / Film Review 等需有标题
News Report 新闻报道需有 headline（标题）
❓ 视题目而定
Short Story 短篇故事题目已给标题（"entitled '...'"）→ 直接用；题目只给主题或 "about..." → 需自拟
❌ 不需要自拟标题
各类书信 LetterLetter to the Editor / Complaint / Advice / Formal / Informal / Reply / Application 等——以 "Dear ___," 开头
Speech / Debate Speech 演讲辞/辩论辞以问候语开头，无标题
Notice 通知标题固定为 "Notice"，机构名通常题目已给
Email 电邮Subject 栏不算创作性标题，通常题目已给或简单填写
Diary Entry 日记只写日期，无标题

Letter to the editor 致编辑信（共 3 篇）

2021 年 — 电动汽车销量问题

共20句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q2 Part B Learning English through Social Issues
Although studies show electric cars are more environmentally friendly than petrol cars, less than 3% of all vehicles sold in 2020 worldwide were electric. Write a letter to the editor of Hong Kong Post. Discuss why sales of electric vehicles are so low. Suggest what can be done to attract more people to drive these vehicles.
1
🇳 亲爱的编辑：
Dear Editor（亲爱的编辑）
Dear Editor,
2
🇳 我写信是为了表达我对全球电动汽车销量低迷的担忧。
express my concern regarding（表达对……的担忧） underwhelming sales figures（低迷的销售数据） electric vehicles (EVs)（电动汽车）
I am writing to express my concern regarding the underwhelming sales figures of electric vehicles (EVs) worldwide.
3
🇳 尽管有充分证据表明电动汽车比传统汽油车更环保，但它们在2020年全球汽车销量中所占比例还不到3%。
ample evidence demonstrating（充足的证据表明） environmental superiority（环保优势） conventional petrol cars（传统汽油车） made up less than 3%（占比不到3%）
Despite ample evidence demonstrating the environmental superiority of EVs over conventional petrol cars, they made up less than 3% of all vehicles sold globally in 2020.
4
🇳 这是一个令人担忧的数据，尤其是在气候变化这一紧迫的全球问题背景下。
concerning statistic（令人担忧的数据） in the context of（在……的背景下） pressing global issue（紧迫的全球问题） climate change（气候变化）
This is a concerning statistic, particularly in the context of the pressing global issue of climate change.
5
🇳 电动汽车普及率低的原因是多方面的。
adoption rate（普及率） multifaceted（多方面的）
The reasons for the low adoption rate of EVs are multifaceted.
6
🇳 首先，电动汽车的初始购买价格通常远高于燃油汽车，这使得它们对潜在买家来说吸引力较低。
initial purchase price（初始购买价格） petrol-fueled vehicles（燃油汽车） a less appealing option（吸引力较低的选择） potential buyers（潜在买家）
Firstly, the initial purchase price of electric vehicles is typically much higher than that of petrol-fueled vehicles, making them a less appealing option for potential buyers.
7
🇳 其次，充电设施的匮乏——尤其是在城市地区——导致了所谓的"里程焦虑"现象，即潜在的电动汽车买家因担心车辆没电而却步。
dearth of（缺乏） charging infrastructure（充电基础设施） range anxiety（里程焦虑） deterred by（被……劝退） running out of power（电量耗尽）
Secondly, the dearth of readily available charging infrastructure, particularly in urban areas, contributes to the phenomenon known as 'range anxiety', where potential EVs buyers are deterred by the fear of their vehicle running out of power.
8
🇳 此外，公众对于驾驶电动汽车的长期成本节约和环保效益普遍缺乏了解和认识。
general lack of（普遍缺乏） long-term cost savings（长期成本节约） environmental benefits（环保效益）
Additionally, there is a general lack of understanding and awareness about the long-term cost savings and environmental benefits of driving an EV.
9
🇳 为了刺激电动汽车销量的增长，需要政府部门和行业利益相关者共同采取全面、多管齐下的方法。
stimulate an increase in（刺激……的增长） comprehensive, multi-pronged approach（全面、多管齐下的方法） government bodies（政府部门） industry stakeholders（行业利益相关者）
To stimulate an increase in EVs sales, a comprehensive, multi-pronged approach involving both government bodies and industry stakeholders is necessary.
10
🇳 首先，应推出退税、免税和低息贷款等财政激励措施，以抵消电动汽车高昂的初始成本，从而使其成为消费者更能负担得起的选择。
financial incentives（财政激励措施） rebates（退税） tax exemptions（免税） low-interest loans（低息贷款） offset the high initial cost（抵消高昂的初始成本）
Firstly, financial incentives such as rebates, tax exemptions, and low-interest loans should be introduced to offset the high initial cost of EVs, thus making them a more affordable option for consumers.
11
🇳 其次，需要大量投资来发展完善且高效的充电基础设施。
significant investment（大量投资） robust and efficient（完善且高效的） charging infrastructure（充电基础设施）
Secondly, a significant investment is needed to develop a robust and efficient charging infrastructure.
12
🇳 这不仅应包括建设更多的充电站，还应包括提高充电速度以缓解里程焦虑。
not only... but also...（不仅……而且……） construction of charging stations（建设充电站） enhancement of charging speed（提高充电速度） alleviate range anxiety（缓解里程焦虑）
This should involve not only the construction of a larger number of charging stations but also the enhancement of charging speed to alleviate range anxiety.
13
🇳 公私合作伙伴关系可能是加快这一发展的潜在策略。
public-private partnerships（公私合作伙伴关系） potential strategy（潜在策略） expedite this development（加快这一发展）
Public-private partnerships could be a potential strategy to expedite this development.
14
🇳 最后，应开展广泛的公众意识宣传活动，向公众普及电动汽车的诸多好处。
widespread public awareness campaigns（广泛的公众宣传活动） educate the public about（向公众普及） myriad benefits（诸多好处）
Lastly, widespread public awareness campaigns should be conducted to educate the public about the myriad benefits of EVs.
15
🇳 这些宣传活动应强调电动汽车的长期成本效益、环保优势，以及它们在迈向更可持续未来方面的关键作用。
underscore（强调） long-term cost-effectiveness（长期成本效益） crucial role（关键作用） advancing towards（迈向） sustainable future（可持续未来）
These campaigns should underscore the long-term cost-effectiveness of EVs, their environmental benefits, and their crucial role in advancing towards a more sustainable future.
16
🇳 我相信，随着扶持政策的实施和所有利益相关者的共同努力，我们可以显著提高电动汽车的普及率。
implementation of supportive policies（扶持政策的实施） combined efforts（共同努力） significantly boost the adoption（显著提高普及率）
I am confident that with the implementation of supportive policies and combined efforts from all stakeholders, we can significantly boost the adoption of electric vehicles.
17
🇳 这将是减少我们集体碳足迹和促进可持续城市发展的重要一步。
represent a major step（代表重要一步） collective carbon footprint（集体碳足迹） fostering（促进） sustainable urban development（可持续城市发展）
This would represent a major step in reducing our collective carbon footprint and fostering sustainable urban development.
18
🇳 感谢您关注这一紧迫问题。
thank you for your attention to（感谢您关注） pressing issue（紧迫问题）
Thank you for your attention to this pressing issue.
19
🇳 此致，
Yours sincerely（此致）
Yours sincerely,
20
🇳 [你的名字]
[Your Name]（[你的名字]）
[Your Name] ---
❌ 不需要自拟标题

Letter to the editor 致编辑信（共 3 篇）

2022 年 — 年轻人对传统艺术缺乏兴趣

共21句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2022 Q5 Part B Learning English through Social Issues
The following comment appeared in the editorial of Hong Kong Post: 'Young people today lack interest in traditional art forms such as lion dance, calligraphy or the art of tea drinking.' You are the chairperson of your school's Heritage Club. Express your views by writing a letter to the editor of Hong Kong Post.
1
🇳 亲爱的编辑：
Dear Editor（亲爱的编辑）
Dear Editor,
2
🇳 我最近读了《香港邮报》上一篇关于当今年轻人似乎对传统艺术形式缺乏兴趣的社论。
read the editorial（读了社论） perceived lack of interest（被认为缺乏兴趣） traditional art forms（传统艺术形式）
I recently read the editorial in the Hong Kong Post concerning the perceived lack of interest in traditional art forms among today's youth.
3
🇳 作为学校遗产俱乐部的主席，我觉得有必要就这个问题分享一个不同的观点。
chairperson（主席） Heritage Club（遗产俱乐部） felt compelled to（觉得有必要） share a different perspective（分享不同观点）
As the chairperson of my school's Heritage Club, I felt compelled to share a different perspective on this matter.
4
🇳 虽然舞狮、书法或饮茶等传统艺术形式看起来可能无法引起年轻一代的共鸣，但我认为这并非不感兴趣的表现，而是缺乏接触和了解。
resonate with（引起共鸣） not a reflection of disinterest（并非不感兴趣的表现） lack of exposure and understanding（缺乏接触和了解）
While it might seem that traditional art forms like lion dance, calligraphy, or tea drinking may not resonate with the younger generation, I believe this is not a reflection of disinterest, but rather a lack of exposure and understanding.
5
🇳 在我们的遗产俱乐部，我们亲眼目睹了当这些艺术形式以引人入胜且贴近生活的方式呈现时，年轻人如何能够培养出对它们的深厚欣赏。
witnessed firsthand（亲眼目睹） develop a deep appreciation（培养深厚欣赏） presented in an engaging and relatable manner（以引人入胜贴近生活的方式呈现）
In our Heritage Club, we have witnessed firsthand how young people can develop a deep appreciation for these art forms when they are presented in an engaging and relatable manner.
6
🇳 舞狮、书法和饮茶等传统深深植根于我们的文化和历史之中。
deeply ingrained in（深深植根于） culture and history（文化与历史）
Traditions like lion dance, calligraphy, and tea drinking are deeply ingrained in our culture and history.
7
🇳 它们不仅仅是艺术形式，更是我们身份认同的一部分。
more than just（不仅仅是） part of our identity（身份认同的一部分）
They are more than just art forms; they are part of our identity.
8
🇳 年轻人了解这些传统背后的意义和故事至关重要，而不是仅仅将它们视为过时或无关紧要的东西。
it's crucial for（对……至关重要） significance and narratives（意义与故事） old-fashioned or irrelevant（过时或无关紧要）
It's crucial for young people to understand the significance and the narratives behind these traditions, not just see them as old-fashioned or irrelevant.
9
🇳 我们发现，互动工作坊、示范表演以及到这些艺术形式实践场所的实地考察可以激发学生的兴趣。
interactive workshops（互动工作坊） demonstrations（示范表演） field trips（实地考察） spark interest（激发兴趣）
We have found that interactive workshops, demonstrations, and field trips to places where these art forms are practiced can spark interest among students.
10
🇳 此外，将这些传统艺术与现代兴趣或爱好联系起来可以使它们更具吸引力。
drawing connections between（在……间建立联系） modern interests or hobbies（现代兴趣爱好） more appealing（更具吸引力）
Additionally, drawing connections between these traditional arts and modern interests or hobbies can make them more appealing.
11
🇳 例如，强调舞狮所需的运动能力和协调性可以与现代舞蹈或体育运动相类比。
highlighting the athleticism and coordination（强调运动能力与协调性） draw parallels to（与……类比） contemporary dance or sports（现代舞蹈或体育）
For example, highlighting the athleticism and coordination required in lion dance can draw parallels to contemporary dance or sports.
12
🇳 此外，让年轻人参与这些艺术的实际实践可能非常有益。
involving young people in（让年轻人参与） actual practice（实际练习） highly beneficial（非常有益）
Moreover, involving young people in the actual practice of these arts can be highly beneficial.
13
🇳 掌握一个书法字的笔画或完善舞狮套路的节奏会带来一种满足感。
certain satisfaction（某种满足感） mastering the strokes（掌握笔画） perfecting the rhythm（完善节奏） lion dance routine（舞狮套路）
There's a certain satisfaction that comes from mastering the strokes of a calligraphy character or perfecting the rhythm of a lion dance routine.
14
🇳 这些经历可以建立自信、耐心和成就感。
build confidence, patience, and a sense of achievement（建立自信、耐心和成就感）
These experiences can build confidence, patience, and a sense of achievement.
15
🇳 为年轻人提供展示他们在这些艺术方面的技能和创造力的平台也很重要。
provide platforms for（为……提供平台） showcase their skills and creativity（展示技能与创造力）
It's also important to provide platforms for young people to showcase their skills and creativity in these arts.
16
🇳 学校表演、社区活动和社交媒体渠道都是突出和庆祝他们努力与成就的绝佳方式。
school performances（学校表演） community events（社区活动） social media channels（社交媒体渠道） highlight and celebrate（突出并庆祝）
School performances, community events, and social media channels are excellent ways to highlight and celebrate their efforts and achievements.
17
🇳 总之，我们不要急于给年轻人贴上对传统艺术形式不感兴趣的标签。
in conclusion（总之） don't be too quick to（不要急于） label... as（给……贴上……标签） disinterested（不感兴趣）
In conclusion, let's not be too quick to label young people as disinterested in traditional art forms.
18
🇳 相反，让我们专注于寻找创新的方式来吸引他们，帮助他们发现我们文化遗产的美丽、相关性和丰富性。
instead（相反地） focus on（专注于） innovative ways to engage（创新的吸引方式） cultural heritage（文化遗产） beauty, relevance, and richness（美丽、相关性与丰富性）
Instead, let's focus on finding innovative ways to engage them, helping them discover the beauty, relevance, and richness of our cultural heritage.
19
🇳 此致，
Yours sincerely（此致）
Yours sincerely,
20
🇳 [你的名字]
[Your Name]（[你的名字]）
[Your Name]
21
🇳 学校遗产俱乐部主席
Chairperson, School Heritage Club（学校遗产俱乐部主席）
Chairperson, School Heritage Club ---

Letter to the editor 致编辑信（共 3 篇）

2023 年 — AI作曲比赛获奖争议

共23句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2023 Q8 Part B Learning English through Poems and Songs
Contestants in a song-writing competition complained when a song created by artificial intelligence (AI) software won first prize. Write a letter to the editor on whether computer-generated songs should be allowed to compete in such competitions.
1
🇳 主题：AI在歌曲创作比赛中的创造力平等性问题
subject（主题） parity（平等性） AI creativity（人工智能创造力） song-writing competitions（歌曲创作比赛）
Subject: The Parity of AI Creativity in Song-Writing Competitions
2
🇳 亲爱的编辑：
Dear Editor（亲爱的编辑）
Dear Editor,
3
🇳 我今天写信给您，是想讨论最近一场歌曲创作比赛中令人意外的结果——一个人工智能软件的作品获得了一等奖，这引发了关于计算机生成创造力在此类比赛中是否合法的争论。
discuss the recent upset（讨论最近的意外结果） Artificial Intelligence (AI)（人工智能） composition（作品） won first prize（获得一等奖） sparking a debate over（引发关于……的争论） legitimacy（合法性） computer-generated creativity（计算机生成创造力）
I am writing to you today to discuss the recent upset in a song-writing competition where an Artificial Intelligence (AI) software's composition won first prize, sparking a debate over the legitimacy of computer-generated creativity in such contests.
4
🇳 人工智能在社会各领域的应用一直是一个有争议的问题，创意艺术也不例外。
integration of AI（人工智能的融入） various sectors of society（社会各领域） controversial issue（有争议的问题） creative arts（创意艺术） not exempt from（也不能免于）
The integration of AI in various sectors of society has been a controversial issue, and creative arts are not exempt from this.
5
🇳 争论的焦点是AI创作是否应该被允许与人类创作竞争，或者它们是否应该被单独分类。
main point of contention（争论的焦点） allowed to compete against（被允许与……竞争） categorised separately（单独分类）
The main point of contention is whether AI creations should be allowed to compete against human creations, or if they should be categorised separately.
6
🇳 我认为这是一个需要深思熟虑的多方面问题。
multi-faceted issue（多方面的问题） requires thoughtful consideration（需深思熟虑）
I believe that this is a multi-faceted issue that requires thoughtful consideration.
7
🇳 首先，认识到AI在音乐创作方面的惊人能力很重要。
recognise the impressive capabilities of（认识……的惊人能力） creating music（创作音乐）
Firstly, it's important to recognise the impressive capabilities of AI in creating music.
8
🇳 AI软件可以从庞大的歌曲数据库中分析模式、音调和节奏，并创作出悦耳的新作品。
analyse patterns, tones, and rhythms（分析模式、音调和节奏） vast database of songs（庞大的歌曲数据库） pleasing to the ear（悦耳动听）
AI software can analyse patterns, tones, and rhythms from a vast database of songs, and create a new composition that is pleasing to the ear.
9
🇳 这是一项不应被低估的重大技术成就。
significant technological achievement（重大的技术成就） should not be downplayed（不应被低估）
This is a significant technological achievement that should not be downplayed.
10
🇳 然而，问题仍然存在：这是创造力，还是仅仅是高级编程？
the question remains（问题仍然存在） creativity（创造力） advanced programming（高级编程）
However, the question remains, is this creativity or merely advanced programming?
11
🇳 正如我们所知，创造力是人类固有的特质。
as we know it（如我们所知） inherently human trait（人类固有特质）
Creativity, as we know it, is an inherently human trait.
12
🇳 它不仅包括以新颖方式组合模式的能力，还包括情感深度、个人经历和文化影响。
not just... but also...（不仅是……也是……） combine patterns in a novel way（以新颖方式组合模式） emotional depth（情感深度） personal experiences（个人经历） cultural influences（文化影响）
It involves not just the ability to combine patterns in a novel way, but also emotional depth, personal experiences, and cultural influences.
13
🇳 这些是AI至少目前无法复制的方面。
at least for now（至少目前如此） cannot replicate（无法复制）
These are aspects that AI, at least for now, cannot replicate.
14
🇳 我们产生共鸣的歌曲常常触动我们的心灵，与我们的个人经历产生共鸣，这是AI生成的歌曲可能缺乏的。
connect with（与……产生共鸣） touch our hearts（触动心灵） resonate with（引起共鸣） personal experiences（个人经历） may lack（可能缺乏）
The songs we connect with often touch our hearts and resonate with our personal experiences, something an AI-generated song may lack.
15
🇳 其次，歌曲创作比赛传统上是有抱负的词曲作者展示才华、表达情感和通过音乐讲述故事的平台。
serve as platforms for（作为……的平台） aspiring songwriters（有抱负的词曲作者） showcase their talents（展示才华） express their emotions（表达情感） tell their stories（讲述故事）
Secondly, song-writing competitions traditionally serve as platforms for aspiring songwriters to showcase their talents, express their emotions, and tell their stories through music.
16
🇳 如果允许AI生成的歌曲参赛，这可能会让人类参赛者感到气馁，他们可能觉得自己无法与AI的计算能力和模式识别能力竞争。
potentially discourage（可能阻碍） human participants（人类参赛者） compete with（与……竞争） computational power（计算能力） pattern-recognition abilities（模式识别能力）
If AI-generated songs are allowed to compete, it could potentially discourage human participants who may feel that they cannot compete with the computational power and pattern-recognition abilities of AI.
17
🇳 然而，也有人认为AI音乐可以推动人类艺术家提升水平，激发音乐界新一轮的创造力和创新。
it can also be argued that（也可以论证） step up their game（提升表现） inspiring a new wave of（激发新一波的） creativity and innovation（创造力与创新）
However, it can also be argued that AI music could push human artists to step up their game, inspiring a new wave of creativity and innovation in music.
18
🇳 也许解决方案不在于禁止AI参加比赛，而在于改变我们看待和评判音乐的方式。
the solution lies not in... but in...（解决方案不在于……而在于……） banning AI from（禁止AI参与） how we view and judge music（我们如何看待和评判音乐）
Perhaps the solution lies not in banning AI from competitions, but in changing how we view and judge music.
19
🇳 评判标准可以扩大，将情感共鸣和个人叙事等方面纳入其中，在这些方面人类艺术家具有优势。
criteria for judging（评判标准） broadened to include（扩展至包括） emotional resonance（情感共鸣） personal storytelling（个人叙事） have the upper hand（占上风）
The criteria for judging could be broadened to include aspects like emotional resonance and personal storytelling, factors where human artists have the upper hand.
20
🇳 总之，虽然在歌曲创作比赛中使用AI引发了关于创造力本质和技术在艺术中作用的复杂问题，但我相信，通过适当的规则和评判标准，人类和AI的创作可以在此类比赛中共存甚至蓬勃发展。
in conclusion（总之） brings up complex questions（带来复杂问题） nature of creativity（创造力的本质） role of technology in art（科技在艺术中的角色） appropriate rules and judging criteria（适当的规则和评审标准） coexist and even thrive（共存甚至繁荣）
In conclusion, while the use of AI in song-writing competitions brings up complex questions about the nature of creativity and the role of technology in art, I believe that with appropriate rules and judging criteria, both human and AI creations can coexist and even thrive in such contests.
21
🇳 这可能会开辟音乐行业的新领域，突破可能性的界限，激发新的艺术表达形式。
open up a new frontier（开辟新前沿） pushing the boundaries of（突破……的界限） inspiring new forms of（激发新的形式） artistic expression（艺术表达）
This could open up a new frontier in the music industry, pushing the boundaries of what is possible and inspiring new forms of artistic expression.
22
🇳 此致，
Sincerely（真诚地）
Sincerely,
23

Argumentative essay 议论文（共 6 篇）

2019 年 — 回声室还是公共广场：社交媒体在公共辩论中的作用（单边）

共18句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q3 Part B Learning English through Debating
The Hong Kong Daily Press invites readers to submit their views on the following topic: 'Do social media platforms such as Facebook or Twitter encourage or stifle public debate? When first created, social media was thought to be a place where rational debate and logic would thrive. However, as time has shown, this is not always the case.' Write an argumentative essay. Choose one side of the argument and state your position, giving reasons and evidence to support your view. Include a title for your essay.
1
🇳 自从Facebook和Twitter等社交媒体平台出现以来，人们表达观点和参与公共辩论的能力显著增强。
since the inception of（自……出现以来） significant increase in（……的显著增长） express their opinions（表达他们的观点） engage in public debates（参与公共讨论）
Since the inception of social media platforms like Facebook and Twitter, there has been a significant increase in the ability of people to express their opinions and engage in public debates.
2
🇳 然而，评估这些平台是真正促进了健康的公共讨论还是抑制了它，至关重要。
it is crucial to（至关重要的是） fostered healthy public discourse（促进了健康的公共讨论） fested it（助长了它）
However, it is crucial to assess whether these platforms have truly fostered healthy public discourse or have fested it.
3
🇳 在我看来，社交媒体平台实际上抑制了公共辩论，与其最初承诺的创建理性讨论开放论坛背道而驰。
in my perspective（在我看来） contrary to（与……相反） initial promise（最初的承诺） open forum for rational discussion（理性讨论的开放论坛）
In my perspective, social media platforms have indeed fested public debate, contrary to their initial promise of creating an open forum for rational discussion.
4
🇳 首先，回声室问题严重妨碍了社交媒体上健康辩论的可能性。
echo chambers（回声室效应） severely hampers（严重阻碍） potential for healthy debate（健康辩论的潜力）
Firstly, the issue of echo chambers severely hampers the potential for healthy debate on social media.
5
🇳 回声室指的是个人只接触到证实其既有观点的信息，而对立观点被过滤掉的情况。
refer to situations where（指……的情况） exposed to information（接触到信息） confirms their preexisting views（确认他们已有的观点） contradictory viewpoints（矛盾的观点） filtered out（被过滤掉）
Echo chambers refer to situations where individuals are exposed to information that confirms their preexisting views, while contradictory viewpoints are filtered out.
6
🇳 这是由根据用户偏好优先推送内容的算法促成的。
facilitated by（由……促成） algorithms（算法） prioritize content（优先推送内容） user preferences（用户偏好）
This is facilitated by algorithms that prioritize content based on user preferences.
7
🇳 因此，社交媒体非但没有鼓励多元化讨论，反而常常放大片面叙事，抑制了平衡的公共辩论。
consequently（因此） instead of（而不是） diverse discussion（多元化的讨论） amplifies one-sided narratives（放大片面叙事） balanced public debate（平衡的公共讨论）
Consequently, instead of encouraging a diverse discussion, social media often amplifies one-sided narratives, stifling balanced public debate.
8
🇳 其次，社交媒体上错误信息和假新闻的盛行也抑制了健康的公共辩论。
prevalence of（……的盛行） misinformation and fake news（错误信息和假新闻） stifles healthy public debate（扼杀健康的公共讨论）
Secondly, the prevalence of misinformation and fake news on social media also stifles healthy public debate.
9
🇳 这些平台已成为误导性信息的温床，可能扭曲公众舆论并破坏理性讨论。
breeding ground for（……的温床） misleading information（误导信息） distort public opinion（扭曲公众舆论） undermine rational discourse（破坏理性讨论）
These platforms have become a breeding ground for misleading information, which can distort public opinion and undermine rational discourse.
10
🇳 例如，麻省理工学院的一项研究发现，Twitter上的虚假信息被转发的可能性比真实故事高70%。
for instance（例如） Massachusetts Institute of Technology（麻省理工学院） false information（虚假信息） 70% more likely to be retweeted（被转发的可能性高70%）
For instance, a study by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology found that false information on Twitter was 70% more likely to be retweeted than true stories.
11
🇳 错误信息的这种盛行使得在社交媒体上进行有根据的辩论变得困难。
prevalence of misinformation（错误信息的泛滥） makes it challenging to（使……变得困难） informed debates（有依据的辩论）
This prevalence of misinformation makes it challenging to have informed debates on social media.
12
🇳 第三，社交媒体平台提供的匿名性常常助长仇恨言论和网络欺凌的传播，进一步抑制了公共辩论。
anonymity provided by（……提供的匿名性） facilitates the spread of（促进了……的传播） hate speech（仇恨言论） cyberbullying（网络霸凌）
Thirdly, the anonymity provided by social media platforms often facilitates the spread of hate speech and cyberbullying, further stifling public debate.
13
🇳 这种敌对环境可能会阻止用户参与公开讨论，因为他们害怕受到骚扰或反击，从而限制了所表达观点的多样性。
hostile environment（敌对的环境） deter users from（使用户不敢） open discussions（开放讨论） fear of harassment or backlash（害怕骚扰或反弹） diversity of opinions（意见的多样性）
This hostile environment can deter users from engaging in open discussions due to fear of harassment or backlash, limiting the diversity of opinions expressed.
14
🇳 最后，社交媒体内容的时效性——以短暂的帖子和快速的信息更新为特征——不利于深入、深思熟虑的辩论。
temporal nature（时间性的本质） short-lived posts（短暂存在的帖子） rapid information turnover（快速的信息更替） not conducive to（不利于） in-depth, thoughtful debates（深入深思的辩论）
Lastly, the temporal nature of social media content, characterized by short-lived posts and rapid information turnover, is not conducive to in-depth, thoughtful debates.
15
🇳 相反，它鼓励简短、反应式的回应，往往导致复杂问题的过度简单化。
instead（相反地） encourages brief, reactive responses（鼓励简短反应性的回应） leading to（导致） oversimplification of complex issues（复杂问题的过度简化）
Instead, it encourages brief, reactive responses, often leading to oversimplification of complex issues.
16
🇳 总之，虽然社交媒体平台为个人表达意见提供了前所未有的机会，但它们在很大程度上抑制了健康的公共辩论。
in conclusion（总之） offer unprecedented opportunities（提供前所未有的机会） voice their opinions（表达意见） largely stifled（在很大程度上被压制）
In conclusion, while social media platforms offer unprecedented opportunities for individuals to voice their opinions, they have largely stifled healthy public debate.
17
🇳 回声室效应、错误信息的传播、仇恨言论的盛行以及社交媒体内容的短暂性，共同导致了不利于理性、有根据讨论的氛围。
echo chamber effect（回声室效应） spread of misinformation（错误信息的传播） prevalence of hate speech（仇恨言论的盛行） fleeting nature（转瞬即逝的本质） collectively resulted in（共同导致了） not conducive to（不利于） rational, informed discourse（理性有依据的讨论）
The echo chamber effect, the spread of misinformation, the prevalence of hate speech, and the fleeting nature of social media content have collectively resulted in a climate that is not conducive to rational, informed discourse.
18
🇳 为了真正促进公共辩论，社交媒体平台必须采取措施解决这些问题，例如改进内容审核、提高算法透明度以及在用户中推广数字素养。
to truly foster（真正培养） take steps to（采取步骤来） address these issues（解决这些问题） content moderation（内容审核） algorithm transparency（算法透明度） promoting digital literacy（推广数字素养）
To truly foster public debate, social media platforms must take steps to address these issues, such as improving content moderation, enhancing algorithm transparency, and promoting digital literacy among users. ---

Argumentative essay 议论文（共 6 篇）

2020 年 — 食品警告标签是否促进健康饮食（单边）

共20句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2020 Q6 Part B Learning English through Debating
To raise public awareness of healthy eating, some countries now legally require food manufacturers to put warning labels on foods that are high in sugar, saturated fat and salt. Write an argumentative essay. Argue either for OR against the effectiveness of food warning labels in changing people's eating habits.
1
🇳 在健康意识日益增强和生活方式疾病日益普及的当代，健康饮食的重要性怎么强调都不为过。
in the contemporary era（在当代） increasing health consciousness（日益增长的健康意识） escalating prevalence of（日益加剧的……） lifestyle diseases（生活方式疾病） cannot be overstated（再强调也不为过）
In the contemporary era of increasing health consciousness and the escalating prevalence of lifestyle diseases, the importance of healthy eating cannot be overstated.
2
🇳 一些国家为促进更健康饮食习惯而采取的一项举措是对高糖、高饱和脂肪和高盐食品强制实施警告标签。
one initiative（一项举措） promote healthier eating habits（促进更健康的饮食习惯） legal enforcement of（对……的依法执行） warning labels（警告标签） high in sugar, saturated fat, and salt（高糖、高饱和脂肪、高盐）
One initiative adopted by several countries to promote healthier eating habits is the legal enforcement of warning labels on foods high in sugar, saturated fat, and salt.
3
🇳 我支持这一举措，认为食品警告标签显著影响人们的饮食习惯，使他们更有健康意识并促使他们选择更健康的食品。
argue in favor of（支持） significantly influence（显著影响） making them more health-conscious（让他们更注重健康） prompting healthier food choices（促使更健康的食品选择）
I argue in favor of this initiative, contending that food warning labels significantly influence people's eating habits, making them more health-conscious and prompting healthier food choices.
4
🇳 首先，食品警告标签是有关食品营养成分的即时、清晰信息来源。
serve as（作为） immediate and clear source of information（即时且清晰的信息来源） nutritional content（营养成分）
Firstly, food warning labels serve as an immediate and clear source of information about the nutritional content of food products.
5
🇳 消费者通常对食品包装上提供的营养信息缺乏足够的了解。
lack sufficient knowledge or understanding of（缺乏足够的……知识或理解） nutritional information（营养信息） food packages（食品包装）
Consumers often lack sufficient knowledge or understanding of the nutritional information provided on food packages.
6
🇳 因此，警告标签通过提供清晰简单的不健康营养素高含量指示来弥补这一差距。
bridge this gap（弥合这一差距） clear and simple indication（清晰简单的指示） high levels of unhealthy nutrients（高含量的不健康营养素）
Warning labels, therefore, bridge this gap by providing a clear and simple indication of the high levels of unhealthy nutrients.
7
🇳 通过为消费者提供这些信息，警告标签使他们能够就食品购买做出明智的决定。
by equipping consumers with（通过让消费者具备） empower them to（赋予他们……的能力） make informed decisions（做出明智决定） food purchases（食品购买）
By equipping consumers with this information, warning labels empower them to make informed decisions about their food purchases.
8
🇳 其次，警告标签具有威慑作用。
deterrent effect（威慑作用）
Secondly, warning labels have a deterrent effect.
9
🇳 看到食品上的警告标签常常会引发谨慎感，促使消费者重新考虑他们的食品选择。
the sight of（看到） triggers a sense of caution（引发警惕感） prompting consumers to（促使消费者） reconsider their food choices（重新考虑他们的食品选择）
The sight of a warning label on a food product often triggers a sense of caution, prompting consumers to reconsider their food choices.
10
🇳 智利大学进行的一项研究发现，在实施警告标签两年后，含糖饮料的购买量下降了23.7%，高糖麦片的购买量下降了5%。
a study conducted by（由……进行的一项研究） 23.7% decrease in（下降23.7%） sugary drinks（含糖饮料） implementation of warning labels（警告标签的实施）
A study conducted by the University of Chile found a 23.7% decrease in purchases of sugary drinks and a 5% decrease in high-in-sugar cereals two years after the implementation of warning labels.
11
🇳 这清楚地表明，警告标签的存在有效地阻止了人们购买不健康食品。
clearly demonstrates（清楚表明） presence of warning labels（警告标签的存在） effective in（在……方面有效） dissuading people from（劝阻人们不要） unhealthy foods（不健康食品）
This clearly demonstrates that the presence of warning labels is effective in dissuading people from purchasing unhealthy foods.
12
🇳 第三，食品警告标签通过推动食品制造商重新配方其产品，间接地促进了更健康的饮食习惯。
indirectly promote（间接促进） nudging food manufacturers（推动食品制造商） reformulate their products（改良他们的产品配方）
Thirdly, food warning labels indirectly promote healthier eating habits by nudging food manufacturers to reformulate their products.
13
🇳 面对因警告标签而可能失去客户的情况，制造商被鼓励降低产品中的糖、饱和脂肪和盐含量以避免这些标签。
faced with（面临） potential loss of customers（潜在顾客流失） reduce the levels of（降低……的水平）
Faced with the potential loss of customers due to warning labels, manufacturers are encouraged to reduce the levels of sugar, saturated fat, and salt in their products to avoid these labels.
14
🇳 这导致市场上有更健康的食品选择，从而促进了公众更健康的饮食习惯。
leads to（导致） availability of healthier food options（更健康食品的可得性） thereby promoting（从而促进）
This leads to the availability of healthier food options in the market, thereby promoting healthier eating habits among the public.
15
🇳 然而，批评者认为食品警告标签只能提供信息，不能改变根深蒂固的饮食习惯。
critics argue that（批评者认为） provide information（提供信息） change ingrained eating habits（改变根深蒂固的饮食习惯）
Critics, however, argue that food warning labels can only provide information, not change ingrained eating habits.
16
🇳 虽然对某些人来说可能确实如此，但必须承认改变往往从意识开始。
while this may hold true for（虽然这可能适用于） it is crucial to acknowledge that（必须承认） change often begins with awareness（改变往往始于意识）
While this may hold true for some individuals, it is crucial to acknowledge that change often begins with awareness.
17
🇳 警告标签不断提醒人们不健康饮食的潜在危害，随着时间的推移，这可能会引发饮食习惯的转变。
serve as a continuous reminder of（不断提醒……） potential harm（潜在危害） over time（随着时间的推移） trigger a shift in（引发……的转变）
Warning labels serve as a continuous reminder of the potential harm of unhealthy eating, which, over time, can trigger a shift in eating habits.
18
🇳 总之，食品警告标签在促进更健康饮食习惯方面发挥着关键作用。
in conclusion（总之） play a pivotal role in（在……中发挥关键作用） promoting healthier eating habits（促进更健康的饮食习惯）
In conclusion, food warning labels play a pivotal role in promoting healthier eating habits.
19
🇳 它们是持续、可见的信息来源，是对不健康食品选择的威慑，也是食品重新配方的催化剂。
constant, visible source of information（持续可见的信息来源） deterrent against（对……的威慑） catalyst for（……的催化剂） reformulation of food products（食品配方的改良）
They serve as a constant, visible source of information, a deterrent against unhealthy food choices, and a catalyst for the reformulation of food products.
20
🇳 因此，食品警告标签在改变人们饮食习惯方面的有效性不应被低估。
therefore（因此） effectiveness（有效性） should not be underestimated（不应被低估）
Therefore, the effectiveness of food warning labels in changing people's eating habits should not be underestimated. ---

Argumentative essay 议论文（共 6 篇）

2019 年 — 平衡国际人才与本地劳动力：香港的挑战与机遇（双边）

共20句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q2 Part B Learning English through Social Issues
The following excerpt appeared in an article in the Hong Kong Daily Press: 'To participate in today's global economy, companies hire individuals whose skills and talent meet standards of excellence. One hundred years ago, people were hired from within the local community but today the best individuals are hired from around the world.' Write an essay for your English teacher. Explain some of the benefits and challenges international talent brings to Hong Kong society and ways to ensure that people from the local community are not neglected. Include a title for your essay.
1
🇳 在21世纪的全球化经济中，企业越来越多地跨越地域界限招聘最优秀的人才。
globalized economy（全球化经济） looking beyond geographical boundaries（放眼地理疆界之外） recruit the best talent（招募最优秀的人才）
In the globalized economy of the 21st century, companies are increasingly looking beyond geographical boundaries to recruit the best talent.
2
🇳 这一国际人才库给香港社会带来了诸多好处，也带来了挑战。
international talent pool（国际人才库） brings with it（随之带来） numerous benefits as well as challenges（诸多益处及挑战）
This international talent pool brings with it numerous benefits as well as challenges to Hong Kong society.
3
🇳 在利用全球专业知识和培养本地人才之间取得平衡至关重要。
it is essential to（……必不可少） strike a balance between（在……间取得平衡） leveraging global expertise（利用全球专业知识） nurturing local talent（培养本地人才）
It is essential to strike a balance between leveraging global expertise and nurturing local talent.
4
🇳 国际人才的注入带来了丰富的好处。
infusion of（……的注入） brings a wealth of benefits（带来丰富的益处）
The infusion of international talent brings a wealth of benefits.
5
🇳 首先，它引入了多样化的技能和视角，促进了创新和竞争力。
introduces diverse skills and perspectives（引入多样化的技能和视角） fostering innovation and competitiveness（促进创新和竞争力）
Firstly, it introduces diverse skills and perspectives, fostering innovation and competitiveness.
6
🇳 来自不同文化和专业背景的人带来了独特的见解和想法，丰富了工作环境并有助于解决问题和决策过程。
different cultural and professional backgrounds（不同的文化和专业背景） unique insights and ideas（独特的见解和想法） enriching the work environment（丰富工作环境） contributing to（有助于） problem-solving and decision-making（问题解决和决策）
Individuals from different cultural and professional backgrounds bring unique insights and ideas, enriching the work environment and contributing to problem-solving and decision-making processes.
7
🇳 其次，国际专业人士帮助建立全球网络，促进国际合作和伙伴关系，从而提升香港在全球经济中的地位。
help to build global networks（有助于建立全球网络） facilitating international collaborations and partnerships（促进国际合作与伙伴关系） boosting Hong Kong's standing in（提升香港在……的地位） global economy（全球经济）
Secondly, international professionals help to build global networks, facilitating international collaborations and partnerships, thereby boosting Hong Kong's standing in the global economy.
8
🇳 然而，国际人才的涌入也带来了挑战。
however（然而） influx of（……的涌入） presents challenges（带来挑战）
However, the influx of international talent also presents challenges.
9
🇳 它可能导致就业市场竞争加剧，可能使本地人才边缘化。
lead to（导致） increased competition in the job market（就业市场竞争加剧） marginalizing local talent（边缘化本地人才）
It can lead to increased competition in the job market, potentially marginalizing local talent.
10
🇳 这种情况可能加剧社会不平等并导致不满情绪。
exacerbate social inequalities（加剧社会不平等） lead to resentment（导致怨恨）
This situation could exacerbate social inequalities and lead to resentment.
11
🇳 此外，语言和文化差异可能带来融合挑战，可能导致社会分裂。
moreover（此外） language and cultural differences（语言和文化差异） pose integration challenges（带来融合挑战） social fragmentation（社会碎片化）
Moreover, language and cultural differences might pose integration challenges, potentially leading to social fragmentation.
12
🇳 为确保本地社区不被忽视，实施包容性就业政策至关重要。
to ensure that（为了确保） is not neglected（不被忽视） implement inclusive employment policies（实施包容性就业政策）
To ensure that the local community is not neglected, it is crucial to implement inclusive employment policies.
13
🇳 应鼓励企业投资于本地员工的培训和发展，使他们具备在全球市场竞争所需的技能。
invest in（投资于） training and development of（……的培训和发展） equipping them with（让他们具备） skills needed to compete（竞争所需的技能）
Companies should be encouraged to invest in the training and development of local employees, equipping them with the skills needed to compete in the global market.
14
🇳 这可能涉及与教育机构建立伙伴关系，以确保所教授的技能符合行业不断变化的需求。
involve partnerships with（涉及与……的合作） educational institutions（教育机构） match the evolving needs of the industry（匹配行业不断变化的需求）
This could involve partnerships with educational institutions to ensure that the skills being taught match the evolving needs of the industry.
15
🇳 实习和指导计划可以为本地人才提供向国际同行学习的宝贵机会，促进知识和技能的互利交流。
internship and mentorship programs（实习和导师计划） provide valuable opportunities（提供宝贵的机会） learn from their international counterparts（向国际同行学习） fostering a mutually beneficial exchange（促进互利交流）
Internship and mentorship programs could provide valuable opportunities for local talent to learn from their international counterparts, fostering a mutually beneficial exchange of knowledge and skills.
16
🇳 此外，促进公平招聘做法的政策有助于确保本地人才不会被国际申请者不公平地掩盖。
in addition（此外） policies that promote fair hiring practices（促进公平招聘的政策） ensure that（确保） not unfairly overshadowed by（不被……不公平地掩盖）
In addition, policies that promote fair hiring practices can help to ensure that local talent is not unfairly overshadowed by international applicants.
17
🇳 此外，促进社会融合和文化交流的举措可以帮助缓解潜在的社会摩擦。
furthermore（而且） initiatives to foster social integration and cultural exchange（促进社会融合和文化交流的举措） mitigate potential social friction（减轻潜在的社会摩擦）
Furthermore, initiatives to foster social integration and cultural exchange can help to mitigate potential social friction.
18
🇳 这可以包括为国际雇员提供语言和文化适应课程，以及为本地和国际雇员提供在工作环境之外互动和相互学习的机会。
language and cultural orientation programs（语言和文化适应项目） opportunities to interact and learn from each other（互动和互相学习的机会） outside of a work context（在工作环境之外）
This could include language and cultural orientation programs for international hires, as well as opportunities for local and international employees to interact and learn from each other outside of a work context.
19
🇳 总之，虽然招聘国际人才给香港社会带来了显著好处，但也带来了某些挑战。
in conclusion（总之） recruitment of（……的招聘） brings significant benefits（带来显著优势） presents certain challenges（带来一定挑战）
In conclusion, while the recruitment of international talent brings significant benefits to Hong Kong society, it also presents certain challenges.
20
🇳 通过战略性政策和举措，可以在利用全球人才和培养本地劳动力之间取得平衡，从而确保一个和谐、包容的社会，在多样性中蓬勃发展并维护公平原则。
through strategic policies and initiatives（通过战略性政策和举措） strike a balance between（在……间取得平衡） thereby ensuring（从而确保） harmonious and inclusive society（和谐包容的社会） thrives on diversity（因多样性而蓬勃发展） upholds the principle of fairness（维护公平原则）
Through strategic policies and initiatives, it is possible to strike a balance between leveraging global talent and nurturing local workforce, thereby ensuring a harmonious and inclusive society that thrives on diversity and upholds the principle of fairness. ---

📋 2020 Q2 Part B Learning English through Popular Culture
Some of Hong Kong's housing estates have become extremely popular places to take Instagram photos. As part of a class assignment, you interviewed Instagrammers and residents at a housing estate which has been listed as one of the top 10 places in Hong Kong to take Instagram photos. Write an essay for your assignment. Explain what attracts Instagrammers to Hong Kong's housing estates and how residents feel about this.
1
🇳 本文题为"从居住空间到Instagram空间：香港公共屋邨研究"，探讨了香港公共屋邨转变为社交媒体金矿的矛盾现象。
titled（名为） explores the paradoxical phenomenon（探讨这一矛盾现象） transformation into（转变为） social media goldmines（社交媒体金矿）
Titled, "From Living Spaces to Instagram Spaces: A Study on Hong Kong's Housing Estates," this essay explores the paradoxical phenomenon of Hong Kong's public housing estates' transformation into social media goldmines.
2
🇳 香港的公共屋邨，包括彩虹邨、黄大仙、益昌大厦、鲗鱼涌等，正日益成为热门的Instagram打卡点。
including（包括） among others（以及其他） increasingly becoming popular（越来越受欢迎） Instagram spots（Instagram打卡点）
Hong Kong's housing estates, including Choi Hung Estate, Wong Tai Sin, Yik Cheong Building, Quarry Bay, among others, are increasingly becoming popular Instagram spots.
3
🇳 这些屋邨的美学特点——丰富鲜艳的色彩、几何图案和密集的建筑——提供了Instagram用户无法抗拒的独特背景。
aesthetics（美学） characterized by（以……为特征） rich vibrant colors（丰富鲜艳的颜色） geometric patterns（几何图案） densely packed structures（密集的建筑结构） unique backdrop（独特背景） find irresistible（无法抗拒）
The aesthetics of these housing estates, characterized by their rich vibrant colors, geometric patterns, and densely packed structures, provides a unique backdrop that Instagrammers find irresistible.
4
🇳 他们被现代城市的喧嚣与香港住宅生活原始、未经修饰的描绘之间的鲜明对比所吸引。
drawn to（被吸引到） stark contrast between（……之间的鲜明对比） hustle and bustle（喧嚣忙碌） raw, unfiltered portrayal（原始未经过滤的刻画） residential life（住宅生活）
They are drawn to the stark contrast between the modern city's hustle and the raw, unfiltered portrayal of Hong Kong's residential life.
5
🇳 这些地点提供了城市的不同视角，不那么精致但同样迷人，与通常的天际线和街拍照片形成清新的偏离。
offer a different perspective（提供不同的视角） less polished but equally captivating（不那么精致但同样迷人） providing a refreshing deviation from（提供了与……不同的清新变化） skyline and street food shots（天际线和街头食品照片）
These locations offer a different perspective of the city that is less polished but equally captivating, providing a refreshing deviation from the usual skyline and street food shots.
6
🇳 然而，这一趋势并非没有争议。
however（然而） not without controversy（并非没有争议）
However, this trend is not without controversy.
7
🇳 摄影师和网红的涌入引发了这些屋邨居民的复杂反应。
influx of（……的涌入） photographers and influencers（摄影师和网红） elicited mixed reactions from（引起了……的复杂反应） residents（居民）
The influx of photographers and influencers has elicited mixed reactions from the residents of these estates.
8
🇳 一些居民为自己的家因其独特之美而被认可和赞美感到自豪。
take pride in（以……为傲） being recognized and celebrated for（因……被认可和赞扬） unique beauty（独特之美）
Some residents take pride in their homes being recognized and celebrated for their unique beauty.
9
🇳 他们认为这是向更广泛世界展示他们文化和生活方式的机会。
see it as an opportunity to（将其视为一个……的机会） showcase their culture and lifestyle（展示他们的文化和生活方式） wider world（更广阔的世界）
They see it as an opportunity to showcase their culture and lifestyle to the wider world.
10
🇳 相反，另一些人觉得他们的隐私受到了侵犯。
conversely（相反地） feel that their privacy is being compromised（觉得隐私受到侵犯）
Conversely, others feel that their privacy is being compromised.
11
🇳 对他们来说，这些屋邨不仅仅是美学背景，更是他们的家。
not just aesthetic backdrops（不仅仅是美学背景） but their homes（而是他们的家园）
For them, these estates are not just aesthetic backdrops, but their homes.
12
🇳 摄影师和网红的持续存在可能是侵入性的和破坏性的，影响他们的日常生活。
constant presence（持续存在） intrusive and disruptive（侵入性和破坏性的） affecting their daily routines（影响他们的日常生活）
The constant presence of photographers and influencers can be intrusive and disruptive, affecting their daily routines.
13
🇳 这些居民中越来越多的人认为，他们的家正被用于社交媒体影响力的商品化，而完全不考虑他们的隐私和福祉。
growing sentiment（日益增长的情绪） being commodified（被商品化） social media clout（社交媒体影响力） without any consideration for（丝毫不考虑） privacy and wellbeing（隐私与身心健康）
There is a growing sentiment among these residents that their homes are being commodified for social media clout without any consideration for their privacy and wellbeing.
14
🇳 此外，居民还对社区可能的士绅化表示担忧。
moreover（此外） express concerns about（表达对……的担忧） potential gentrification（潜在绅士化）
Moreover, the residents also express concerns about the potential gentrification of their neighborhoods.
15
🇳 他们担心这种人气可能导致租金上涨，最终迫使他们离开家园。
fear that（担心） lead to increased rental prices（导致租金上涨） forcing them out of their homes（迫使他们离开家园）
They fear that the popularity could lead to increased rental prices, ultimately forcing them out of their homes.
16
🇳 总之，虽然香港公共屋邨转变为Ins热门打卡点反映了城市空间与数字文化之间不断变化的动态，但它也引发了关于隐私、尊重以及将住宅区变成公共景观的伦理影响的关键问题。
in conclusion（总之） transformation into（转变为） reflects the evolving dynamics between（反映……之间不断演变的动态） raises critical questions about（提出关于……的关键问题） ethical implications（伦理影响） turning residential areas into public spectacles（将住宅区变成公共景观）
In conclusion, while Hong Kong's housing estates' transformation into Instagram hotspots reflects the evolving dynamics between urban spaces and digital culture, it also raises critical questions about privacy, respect, and the ethical implications of turning residential areas into public spectacles.
17
🇳 随着越来越多的屋邨吸引Instagram用户，必须在追求审美满足和维护居民权利与隐私之间取得平衡。
as more... attract...（随着更多……吸引……） it is essential to（……必不可少） strike a balance between（在……间取得平衡） pursuit of aesthetic gratification（审美满足的追求） preservation of residents' rights and privacy（保护居民权利和隐私）
As more housing estates attract Instagrammers, it is essential to strike a balance between the pursuit of aesthetic gratification and the preservation of residents' rights and privacy.
18
🇳 在这些空间中采取尊重、体贴的拍照方式可以确保它们继续首先作为家，其次才是Ins打卡点。
respectful, considerate approach（尊重体贴的方式） ensure that（确保） serve as homes first, and Instagram spots second（首先是家其次是Instagram打卡点）
A respectful, considerate approach towards photography in these spaces can ensure that they continue to serve as homes first, and Instagram spots second. ---

📋 2023 Q4 Part B Learning English through Debating
The following topic was discussed at a debate workshop: 'Some employers use cameras and computer software to monitor what employees are doing in the workplace. How do you think this affects productivity and job satisfaction?' Write an essay about the pros and cons of monitoring employees in the workplace.
1
🇳 在当代世界，技术的出现极大地改变了工作场所监控员工的传统方式。
in the contemporary world（在当代世界） advent of technology（科技的出现） drastically altered（极大地改变了） traditional ways of monitoring employees（监控员工的传统方式）
In the contemporary world, the advent of technology has drastically altered the traditional ways of monitoring employees in the workplace.
2
🇳 许多雇主越来越多地采用摄像头和电脑软件等监控机制来监督员工的活动。
increasingly adopting（越来越多地采用） surveillance mechanisms（监控机制） oversee employees' activities（监督员工的活动）
Many employers are increasingly adopting surveillance mechanisms such as cameras and computer software to oversee their employees' activities.
3
🇳 这一新兴趋势当然有其优点和缺点，在几个方面影响生产力和工作满意度。
emerging trend（新兴趋势） has its advantages and disadvantages（有其优点和缺点） affecting productivity and job satisfaction（影响生产力和工作满意度）
This emerging trend certainly has its advantages and disadvantages, affecting productivity and job satisfaction in several ways.
4
🇳 从积极的方面来看，在工作场所实施监控可以显著提高生产力。
on the positive side（从积极的一面来看） implementation of surveillance（监控的实施） considerably enhance productivity（显著提高生产力）
On the positive side, the implementation of surveillance in the workplace can considerably enhance productivity.
5
🇳 它确保员工在工作时间不从事与工作无关的活动，从而减少浪费的时间并提高效率。
ensures that（确保） not engaged in（没有从事） non-work-related activities（与工作无关的活动） during working hours（在工作时间内） reducing wasted time（减少浪费的时间） enhancing efficiency（提高效率）
It ensures that employees are not engaged in non-work-related activities during working hours, thus reducing wasted time and enhancing efficiency.
6
🇳 雇主还可以识别和纠正程序上的低效问题，因为他们可以密切监控工作流程并识别瓶颈。
identify and rectify（识别并纠正） procedural inefficiencies（程序上的低效） closely monitor the workflow（密切监控工作流程） identify bottlenecks（识别瓶颈）
Employers can also identify and rectify procedural inefficiencies, as they can closely monitor the workflow and identify bottlenecks.
7
🇳 此外，监控系统可以阻止不当行为和盗窃，促进诚信和问责文化。
furthermore（而且） discourage misconduct and theft（遏制不当行为和盗窃） promoting a culture of integrity and accountability（促进诚信和问责文化）
Furthermore, surveillance systems can discourage misconduct and theft, promoting a culture of integrity and accountability.
8
🇳 使用监控系统对员工也有好处。
use of monitoring systems（监控系统的使用） can also be advantageous for employees（对员工也可能有利）
The use of monitoring systems can also be advantageous for employees.
9
🇳 监控可以提供安全感，因为它阻止有害行为并确保安全的工作环境。
provide a sense of security（提供安全感） discourages harmful behavior（遏制有害行为） ensures a safe work environment（确保安全的工作环境）
Surveillance can provide a sense of security, as it discourages harmful behavior and ensures a safe work environment.
10
🇳 它还可以使绩效评估公平，因为它允许雇主准确评估每位员工的表现和贡献，防止偏见和偏袒。
lead to fairness in appraisals（使评估更公平） accurately assess（准确评估） performance and contributions（表现和contributions） preventing bias and favoritism（防止偏见和偏袒）
It can also lead to fairness in appraisals, as it allows employers to accurately assess the performance and contributions of each employee, preventing bias and favoritism.
11
🇳 然而，工作场所监控也可能产生负面影响。
however（然而） can also have negative implications（也可能产生负面影响）
However, surveillance in the workplace can also have negative implications.
12
🇳 其主要缺点是它可能破坏雇主和雇员之间的信任。
primary downside（主要缺点） potential to erode trust（有可能侵蚀信任） between employers and employees（雇主与雇员之间）
Its primary downside is its potential to erode trust between employers and employees.
13
🇳 持续监控可能造成多疑感，导致员工认为他们的隐私受到侵犯并且不被信任。
constant monitoring（持续监控） create a sense of paranoia（制造一种偏执感） leading employees to perceive（使员工感到） privacy is being invaded（隐私被侵犯） not trusted（不被信任）
Constant monitoring can create a sense of paranoia, leading employees to perceive that their privacy is being invaded and that they are not trusted.
14
🇳 这种看法可能对士气产生负面影响，导致工作满意度降低和潜在的更高离职率。
perception（感知） negatively impact morale（对士气产生负面影响） leading to（导致） lower job satisfaction（较低的工作满意度） higher turnover rates（更高的员工流失率）
This perception can negatively impact morale, leading to lower job satisfaction and potentially higher turnover rates.
15
🇳 此外，监控可能导致过度的压力和紧张，因为员工可能觉得自己不断被监视和评估。
moreover（此外） lead to excessive pressure and stress（导致过度压力和紧张） being continuously watched and evaluated（被持续监控评估）
Moreover, surveillance can lead to excessive pressure and stress, as employees may feel they are being continuously watched and evaluated.
16
🇳 这可能导致创造力和创新能力下降，因为员工可能害怕冒险或尝试新方法。
lead to a decrease in（导致……下降） creativity and innovation（创造力与创新） fear taking risks（害怕冒险） trying new approaches（尝试新方法）
This can lead to a decrease in creativity and innovation, as employees may fear taking risks or trying new approaches.
17
🇳 此外，过度依赖技术进行员工监控可能导致雇主忽视人际沟通和反馈的重要性，而这些对于培养积极高效的工作环境至关重要。
in addition（此外） over-reliance on technology（过度依赖科技） result in（导致） overlooking the importance of（忽视……的重要性） interpersonal communication and feedback（人际沟通与反馈） essential for（对……必不可少） fostering a positive and productive work environment（营造积极高效的工作环境）
In addition, an over-reliance on technology for employee monitoring can result in employers overlooking the importance of interpersonal communication and feedback, which are essential for fostering a positive and productive work environment.
18
🇳 总之，虽然使用摄像头和电脑软件监控员工可以提高生产力并提供安全感，但由于感知到的隐私侵犯和压力增加，它也可能导致工作满意度和创造力下降。
in conclusion（总之） while the use of... can enhance...（虽然使用……可以提升……） it can also lead to... due to（也可能导致……由于） perceived privacy invasion（被感知的隐私侵犯） increased stress（增加的压力）
In conclusion, while the use of cameras and computer software for monitoring employees can enhance productivity and provide a sense of security, it can also lead to a decrease in job satisfaction and creativity due to perceived privacy invasion and increased stress.
19
🇳 因此，雇主必须取得平衡，确保监控被用作改进和安全的工具，而不是控制和不信任的机制。
therefore（因此） it is crucial for（对……至关重要） strike a balance（取得平衡） ensuring that（确保） used as a tool for improvement and safety（用作改进和安全的工具） rather than（而不是） mechanism for control and mistrust（控制和不信任的机制）
Therefore, it is crucial for employers to strike a balance, ensuring that surveillance is used as a tool for improvement and safety, rather than a mechanism for control and mistrust.
20
🇳 这样，在现代工作场所中，生产力和工作满意度都可以最大化。
this way（这样） both... and... can be maximized（……和……都能最大化） modern workplace（现代职场）
This way, both productivity and job satisfaction can be maximized in the modern workplace. ---

Argumentative essay 议论文（共 6 篇）

2021 年 — 网红vs传统媒体广告：信任视角（双边对比）

共23句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q5 Part B Learning English through Debating
A social media influencer is a person who is paid by a company to promote goods and services through their social media networks. Surveys show that a majority of millennials trust the advice of social media influencers over traditional media advertisements. Write an argumentative essay. Discuss whether social media influencers are more trustworthy than traditional media advertisements. Give reasons to support your point of view.
1
🇳 在当今数字时代，广告格局不断演变。
in today's digital age（在当今数字时代） advertising landscape（广告格局） constantly evolving（不断演变）
In today's digital age, the advertising landscape is constantly evolving.
2
🇳 最显著的转变之一是社交媒体网红的日益普及，他们被付费向粉丝推广产品和服务。
most notable shifts（最显著的变化之一） rising prevalence of（……日益普及） social media influencers（社交媒体网红） paid to promote（被付费推广） products and services（产品和服务） followers（粉丝、关注者）
One of the most notable shifts is the rising prevalence of social media influencers, who are paid to promote products and services to their followers.
3
🇳 调查显示，大多数千禧一代更信任社交媒体网红的建议，而非传统媒体广告。
surveys indicate that（调查表明） most millennials（大多数千禧一代） trust the advice of（信任……的建议） over（超过） traditional media advertisements（传统媒体广告）
Surveys indicate that most millennials trust the advice of social media influencers over traditional media advertisements.
4
🇳 虽然情况可能如此，但重要的是要考虑这种信任是否恰当。
while this might be the case（尽管情况可能如此） it is important to consider（重要的是要考虑） whether such trust is well-placed（这种信任是否恰得其所）
While this might be the case, it is important to consider whether such trust is well-placed.
5
🇳 在我看来，虽然社交媒体网红可以提供更个性化的感觉，但他们并不一定比传统媒体广告更值得信赖。
in my perspective（在我看来） offer a more personal touch（提供更个人化的触感） not necessarily more trustworthy than（不一定比……更值得信赖）
In my perspective, while social media influencers can offer a more personal touch, they are not necessarily more trustworthy than traditional media advertisements.
6
🇳 首先，社交媒体网红通常与他们的受众有更私人的联系。
firstly（首先） personal connection with their audience（与观众的个人联系）
Firstly, social media influencers often have a more personal connection with their audience.
7
🇳 他们经常分享日常生活的方方面面，让粉丝感觉更亲近、更有参与感。
share aspects of their daily lives（分享日常生活的各个方面） making their followers feel（让粉丝感到） more connected and engaged（更紧密连接和参与）
They regularly share aspects of their daily lives, making their followers feel more connected and engaged.
8
🇳 这种个人联系可以使他们的产品推荐看起来更真实、更值得信赖。
personal connection（个人联系） product recommendations（产品推荐） seem more authentic and trustworthy（看起来更真实可信）
This personal connection can make their product recommendations seem more authentic and trustworthy.
9
🇳 此外，网红通常被视为其领域的专家，无论是时尚、健身还是美食。
furthermore（而且） seen as experts in their fields（被视为各自领域的专家） whether it's fashion, fitness, or food（无论是时尚、健身还是饮食）
Furthermore, influencers are often seen as experts in their fields, whether it's fashion, fitness, or food.
10
🇳 这种专业水平可以带来粉丝的高度信任。
level of expertise（专业水平） lead to（导致） high level of trust from followers（粉丝的高度信任）
This level of expertise can lead to a high level of trust from followers.
11
🇳 然而，这种感知到的真实性可能具有误导性。
however（然而） perceived authenticity（被感知的真实性） can be misleading（可能误导人）
However, this perceived authenticity can be misleading.
12
🇳 社交媒体网红被付费推广产品，这可能导致有偏见的评论和推荐。
are paid to promote products（被付费推广产品） lead to（导致） biased reviews and recommendations（有偏见的评价和推荐）
Social media influencers are paid to promote products, which can lead to biased reviews and recommendations.
13
🇳 这种商业关系可能并不总是被披露，导致粉丝认为网红真的喜欢某个产品，而实际上他们可能只是为了经济利益而推广。
business relationship（商业关系） may not always be disclosed（可能不总是被披露） leading followers to believe（使粉丝相信） genuinely loves a product（真心喜爱某个产品） for financial gain（为了经济利益）
This business relationship may not always be disclosed, leading followers to believe that the influencer genuinely loves a product when they may simply be promoting it for financial gain.
14
🇳 另一方面，传统媒体广告受到更多监管。
on the other hand（另一方面） traditional media advertisements（传统媒体广告） more regulated（更规范的）
On the other hand, traditional media advertisements are more regulated.
15
🇳 它们必须遵守某些标准和规定，这些广告中提出的任何主张都必须有根据。
required to（要求） adhere to（遵守） standards and regulations（标准和规定） any claims made（所提出的任何主张） must be substantiated（必须有依据）
They are required to adhere to certain standards and regulations, and any claims made in these advertisements must be substantiated.
16
🇳 虽然这些广告可能缺乏网红帖子的个人风格，但由于这些严格的规定，它们通常更可靠。
while（虽然） lack the personal touch（缺乏人情味） due to these strict regulations（由于这些严格的规定） often more reliable（往往更可靠）
While these advertisements might lack the personal touch of an influencer's post, they are often more reliable due to these strict regulations.
17
🇳 此外，传统媒体广告通常提供有关产品或服务的更全面信息。
moreover（此外） provide more comprehensive information about（提供关于……的更全面信息）
Moreover, traditional media advertisements often provide more comprehensive information about a product or service.
18
🇳 它们旨在告知潜在客户产品的特性、好处和潜在缺点。
designed to inform（旨在告知） potential customers（潜在顾客） features, benefits, and potential drawbacks（特点、好处和潜在缺点）
They are designed to inform potential customers about the product's features, benefits, and potential drawbacks.
19
🇳 这种详细程度可以帮助消费者做出明智的决定，使这些广告成为更值得信赖的信息来源。
level of detail（详细程度） help consumers make an informed decision（帮助消费者做出明智决定） trustworthy source of information（值得信赖的信息来源）
This level of detail can help consumers make an informed decision, making these advertisements a more trustworthy source of information.
20
🇳 总之，虽然社交媒体网红具有与粉丝建立个人联系的优势，但这并不一定使他们比传统媒体广告更值得信赖。
in conclusion（总之） have the advantage of（具有……的优势） personal connection with their followers（与粉丝的个人联系） does not necessarily make them more trustworthy than（不一定使他们比……更值得信赖）
In conclusion, while social media influencers have the advantage of a personal connection with their followers, this does not necessarily make them more trustworthy than traditional media advertisements.
21
🇳 偏见的可能性和缺乏监管可能会损害其推荐的可靠性。
potential for bias（偏见可能性） lack of regulation（缺乏监管） compromise the reliability of（损害……的可靠性）
The potential for bias and lack of regulation can compromise the reliability of their recommendations.
22
🇳 传统媒体广告虽然可能不那么吸引人，但提供更全面的信息并受到严格监管，增强了其可信度。
while perhaps less engaging（虽然可能不那么吸引人） offer more comprehensive information（提供更全面的信息） subject to strict regulations（受严格规定约束） enhancing their trustworthiness（增强其可信度）
Traditional media advertisements, while perhaps less engaging, offer more comprehensive information and are subject to strict regulations, enhancing their trustworthiness.
23
🇳 因此，消费者必须批判性地评估呈现给他们的信息，无论来源如何。
therefore（因此） it is crucial for（对……至关重要） critically evaluate（批判性地评估） regardless of the source（无论来源如何）
Therefore, it is crucial for consumers to critically evaluate the information presented to them, regardless of the source. ---

2020 年 — Zoe Kwan：HKTV最佳新人的迅速崛起（人物特写）

共23句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2020 Q7 Part B Learning English through Poems and Songs
You are a reporter for Do-Re-Mi, a music magazine. You interviewed Zoe Kwan, who has just won 'Best New Artist' at the HKTV Music Awards. Write a feature article based on your interview. Report on Zoe's sudden rise to fame and where the ideas behind her songs came from.
1
🇳 在不断演变的音乐世界中，新面孔不断涌现，在行业中留下独特印记。
in the ever-evolving world of（在……不断变化的世界中） fresh faces continually emerge（新面孔不断涌现） leaving their unique imprints on（在……上留下独特的印记）
In the ever-evolving world of music, fresh faces continually emerge, leaving their unique imprints on the industry.
2
🇳 在最新一批人中，有一个名字比其他人都响亮——横扫HKTV音乐奖、俘获数百万人心的Zoe Kwan。
amongst the latest cohort（在最新一批中） echoing louder than others（比其他声音更响亮） sweeping the awards（横扫奖项） charming the hearts of millions（俘获百万人的心）
Amongst the latest cohort, one name has been echoing louder than others, sweeping the HKTV Music Awards, and charming the hearts of millions - Zoe Kwan.
3
🇳 享有盛誉的"最佳新人奖"得主Zoe Kwan以其深情的嗓音和唤起回忆的歌词席卷了音乐界。
recipient of the prestigious（……荣誉的获得者） Best New Artist（最佳新人奖） taken the music industry by storm（席卷了音乐界） soulful voice（深情的嗓音） evocative lyrics（唤起共鸣的歌词）
Zoe Kwan, the recipient of the prestigious 'Best New Artist' award, has taken the music industry by storm with her soulful voice and evocative lyrics.
4
🇳 她的迅速成名证明了她非凡的才华和不懈的决心。
sudden rise to fame（突然成名） a testament to（……的证明） extraordinary talent（非凡的才华） relentless determination（不懈的决心）
Her sudden rise to fame is a testament to her extraordinary talent and relentless determination.
5
🇳 Zoe在繁华的香港出生长大，一直对音乐情有独钟。
born and raised in（土生土长于） bustling city（繁华城市） always inclined towards music（一直倾向音乐）
Born and raised in the bustling city of Hong Kong, Zoe was always inclined towards music.
6
🇳 她很小就开始写歌，用音乐作为日记来记录她的经历。
began writing songs at a young age（从小开始写歌） using music as a diary（把音乐当日记） document her experiences（记录她的经历）
She began writing songs at a young age, using her music as a diary to document her experiences.
7
🇳 "我总能在音乐中找到慰藉；它是我的出口，是我理解和表达情感的方式，"她在采访中透露。
found solace in music（在音乐中找到慰藉） my outlet（我的宣泄渠道） my way of understanding and expressing my feelings（我理解和表达感受的方式） confided（倾诉）
"I've always found solace in music; it's my outlet, my way of understanding and expressing my feelings," she confided during our interview.
8
🇳 Zoe的歌曲是原始情感与歌词叙事的美妙结合。
beautiful amalgamation of（……的美丽融合） raw emotions（原始情感） lyrical storytelling（诗意的叙事）
Zoe's songs are a beautiful amalgamation of raw emotions and lyrical storytelling.
9
🇳 她说，歌曲背后的想法源于她的个人经历和观察。
ideas behind（……背后的想法） stem from（源于） personal experiences and observations（个人经历和观察）
The ideas behind her songs, she said, stem from her personal experiences and observations.
10
🇳 "我的歌是我生活的反映，我的喜悦、我的悲伤、我的挣扎和我的胜利，"她分享道。
reflections of my life（我人生的写照） my joys, my sorrows, my struggles, and my triumphs（我的喜悦、悲伤、挣扎与胜利）
"My songs are reflections of my life, my joys, my sorrows, my struggles, and my triumphs," she shared.
11
🇳 "我希望我的音乐能引起共鸣，与听众产生共鸣，让他们感到被看见和被理解。"
want my music to be relatable（希望我的音乐能引起共鸣） resonate with my listeners（引起听众的共鸣） make them feel seen and understood（让他们感到被看见和被理解）
"I want my music to be relatable, to resonate with my listeners and make them feel seen and understood."
12
🇳 她的首支单曲《短暂的爱》就是这一理念的证明。
debut single（首支单曲） a testament to this philosophy（这一理念的证明）
Her debut single, "Ephemeral Love," is a testament to this philosophy.
13
🇳 这首歌讲述了一段短暂爱情的辛酸故事，引起了听众的共鸣，将她推向了聚光灯下。
poignant tale of（……的凄美故事） fleeting romance（短暂的浪漫） struck a chord with（引起……的共鸣） propelling her into the limelight（将她推向聚光灯下）
The song, a poignant tale of fleeting romance, struck a chord with listeners, propelling her into the limelight.
14
🇳 这首曲子真挚的歌词加上Zoe有力的演绎，创造了一种迷人的听觉体验，与粉丝产生了深刻共鸣。
heartfelt lyrics（真挚的歌词） coupled with（加上） powerful delivery（有力的表达） created a captivating sonic experience（创造了引人入胜的声音体验） resonated deeply with（深深引起……共鸣）
The track's heartfelt lyrics, coupled with Zoe's powerful delivery, created a captivating sonic experience that resonated deeply with fans.
15
🇳 尽管迅速成名，Zoe仍然脚踏实地。
despite her sudden rise to fame（尽管突然成名） remains grounded（保持脚踏实地）
Despite her sudden rise to fame, Zoe remains grounded.
16
🇳 "我只是一个热爱做音乐的普通女孩，"她说。"名气是次要的。对我来说重要的是我的音乐能触动人们的心灵。"
just a regular girl who loves making music（只是一个热爱创作音乐的普通女孩） fame is secondary（名利是次要的） what matters to me（对我而言重要的是） touches people's hearts（触动人们的心）
"I'm just a regular girl who loves making music," she said. "The fame is secondary. What matters to me is that my music touches people's hearts."
17
🇳 Zoe的成功故事有力地提醒我们，音乐的核心是真实的表达。
success story（成功故事） powerful reminder（有力的提醒） at its core（本质上） authentic expression（真实的表达）
Zoe's success story is a powerful reminder that music, at its core, is about authentic expression.
18
🇳 她能够挖掘自己的情感并将其转化为引人入胜的音乐叙事，这使她在拥挤的音乐行业中脱颖而出。
ability to tap into her emotions（能够触动她的情感） translate them into（将它们转化为） compelling musical narratives（引人入胜的音乐叙事） sets her apart from（使她与众不同） crowded landscape（拥挤的格局）
Her ability to tap into her emotions and translate them into compelling musical narratives sets her apart in the crowded landscape of the music industry.
19
🇳 当她站在HKTV音乐奖的舞台上，紧握着"最佳新人奖"奖杯时，Zoe Kwan证明了她不仅仅是行业中的又一张新面孔。
stood on the stage（站在舞台上） clutching her trophy（紧握奖杯） proved that she's not just another new face（证明了她不只是又一张新面孔）
As she stood on the stage at the HKTV Music Awards, clutching her 'Best New Artist' trophy, Zoe Kwan proved that she's not just another new face in the industry.
20
🇳 她是一股不可忽视的力量，一位音乐特立独行者，她的旅程才刚刚开始。
a force to be reckoned with（不可忽视的力量） musical maverick（音乐独行侠） only just begun her journey（才刚刚开始她的旅程）
She's a force to be reckoned with, a musical maverick who has only just begun her journey.
21
🇳 用她的话说："这只是开始。我还有更多音乐等待分享。"
this is just the beginning（这仅仅是个开始） so much more music waiting to be shared（还有更多音乐等待被分享）
In her words, "This is just the beginning. There's so much more music in me waiting to be shared."
22
🇳 凭借她的才华、热情和韧性，毫无疑问Zoe Kwan这个名字我们会在未来很多年听到。
with her talent, passion, and resilience（凭借她的才华、热情与韧性） there's no doubt that（毫无疑问） for many years to come（在今后的许多年里）
With her talent, passion, and resilience, there's no doubt that Zoe Kwan is a name we'll be hearing for many years to come.
23
🇳 她的迅速成名只是她未写交响曲的第一乐章，我们热切期待即将到来的旋律。
meteoric rise to fame（声名鹊起） just the first verse of her unwritten symphony（只是她未完成交响曲的第一乐章） eagerly await（热切期待） melodies that are yet to come（尚未到来的旋律）
Her meteoric rise to fame is just the first verse of her unwritten symphony, and we eagerly await the melodies that are yet to come. ---

Article 文章（共 9 篇）

2022 年 — Nine Dragons乐队介绍（介绍型）

共19句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2022 Q6 Part B Learning English through Poems and Songs
The musical group Nine Dragons has asked you to help promote them by writing a bio for their website. The bio should include background information about the group, style of music and plans for the future.
1
🇳 Nine Dragons不仅仅是一个音乐团体；它是一段进入香港充满活力音乐场景核心的旋律之旅。
more than just（不仅仅是） melodic journey into（进入……的旋律之旅） vibrant music scene（充满活力的音乐圈）
Nine Dragons is more than just a musical group; it's a melodic journey into the heart of Hong Kong's vibrant music scene.
2
🇳 该乐团成立于2012年，已成长为创新和热情的象征，将中国传统音乐元素与现代风格融合，创造出独特的声音。
formed in（成立于） grown to become a symbol of（已成长为……的象征） blending traditional Chinese musical elements with contemporary styles（将传统中国音乐元素与当代风格融合） uniquely their own（独属于他们自己）
Formed in 2012, the ensemble has grown to become a symbol of innovation and passion, blending traditional Chinese musical elements with contemporary styles to create a sound that is uniquely their own.
3
🇳 Nine Dragons由五位才华横溢的音乐家组成，每位都为乐队带来独特的风格。
comprises five talented musicians（由五位才华横溢的音乐家组成） each bring a distinct flavor to（各自为……带来独特的味道）
Nine Dragons comprises five talented musicians who each bring a distinct flavor to the group.
4
🇳 他们不同的背景和音乐影响造就了定义乐队的折衷声音。
diverse backgrounds and musical influences（多元的背景和音乐影响） contribute to（促成、导致） eclectic sound that defines（定义了……的折衷音乐风格）
Their diverse backgrounds and musical influences contribute to the eclectic sound that defines the band.
5
🇳 成员包括主唱Chan——情感与能量的 powerhouse；吉他手Li——灵巧的手指从琴弦中召唤魔法；键盘手Wong——旋律大师；贝斯手Ho——节奏大师；以及鼓手Feng——乐队的心跳。
lead vocalist（主唱） powerhouse of emotion and energy（情感和能量的动力站） guitarist（吉他手） nimble fingers（灵巧的手指） coax magic from the strings（从琴弦中召唤魔力） keyboardist（键盘手） maestro of melody（旋律大师） bassist（贝斯手） rhythm guru（节奏大师） drummer（鼓手） heartbeat of the band（乐队的心跳）
The members include lead vocalist Chan, a powerhouse of emotion and energy; guitarist Li, whose nimble fingers coax magic from the strings; keyboardist Wong, the maestro of melody; bassist Ho, the rhythm guru; and drummer Feng, the heartbeat of the band.
6
🇳 他们的音乐是东西方、新旧的融合。
fusion of East and West, old and new（东西方、新旧融合）
Their music is a fusion of East and West, old and new.
7
🇳 在这里，二胡萦绕的音符与合成器的电子脉冲相遇；中国鼓的节奏节拍与电吉他的共鸣和弦无缝融合。
haunting notes of the erhu（二胡那令人萦绕的音符） electric pulse of the synthesizer（合成器的电子脉冲） rhythmic beats of Chinese drums（中国鼓的节奏节拍） blend seamlessly with（与……无缝融合） resonating chords of the electric guitar（电吉他的共鸣和弦）
It's where the haunting notes of the erhu meet the electric pulse of the synthesizer; where the rhythmic beats of the Chinese drums blend seamlessly with the resonating chords of the electric guitar.
8
🇳 这是一种超越界限、挑战传统的音乐探索，产生了令人兴奋、唤起回忆和深深感动的声音。
musical exploration（音乐探索） transcends boundaries（超越界限） challenges conventions（挑战常规） resulting in（导致） exciting, evocative, and deeply moving（激动人心、唤起共鸣且深深触动的）
It's a musical exploration that transcends boundaries and challenges conventions, resulting in a sound that is exciting, evocative, and deeply moving.
9
🇳 但Nine Dragons不仅仅是他们的音乐；更是他们共同的热情、友谊和对技艺的投入。
more than just their music（不仅仅是他们的音乐） shared passion（共同热情） camaraderie（同袍情谊） commitment to their craft（对技艺的投入）
But Nine Dragons is more than just their music; it's their shared passion, their camaraderie, and their commitment to their craft.
10
🇳 这是在录音室度过的无数小时，是现场表演的兴奋冲刺，是看到演奏时粉丝脸上洋溢喜悦的快乐。
countless hours spent in the recording studio（在录音室度过的无数小时） exhilarating rush of performing live（现场表演的兴奋快感） joy of seeing fans' faces light up（看到粉丝脸上绽放光芒的喜悦）
It's the countless hours spent in the recording studio, the exhilarating rush of performing live, the joy of seeing their fans' faces light up as they play.
11
🇳 多年来，Nine Dragons对香港音乐界产生了重大影响。
over the years（这些年来） made a significant impact on（对……产生了重大影响）
Over the years, Nine Dragons has made a significant impact on Hong Kong's music scene.
12
🇳 他们在众多音乐节和活动中演出，以充满活力的表演和独特的声音吸引观众。
performed at numerous music festivals and events（在众多音乐节和活动中演出） captivating audiences with（以……吸引观众） energetic performances（充满活力的表演）
They have performed at numerous music festivals and events, captivating audiences with their energetic performances and unique sound.
13
🇳 他们的首张专辑《龙息》在评论界和商业上都取得了成功，为他们赢得了忠实的粉丝群并巩固了他们在香港音乐界的地位。
debut album（首张专辑） critical and commercial success（评论界和商业上的双丰收） earning them a loyal fan base（为他们赢得了忠实粉丝群） solidifying their place（巩固他们的地位）
Their debut album, "Dragon's Breath," was a critical and commercial success, earning them a loyal fan base and solidifying their place in Hong Kong's music industry.
14
🇳 展望未来，Nine Dragons必将飞得更高。
looking ahead（展望未来） set to soar even higher（准备飞得更高）
Looking ahead, Nine Dragons is set to soar even higher.
15
🇳 他们目前正在制作第二张专辑，承诺推出一波创新曲目，推动其音乐风格的界限。
working on their second album（制作第二张专辑） promising a fresh wave of innovative tracks（预示着新一轮创新曲目的到来） push the boundaries of（突破……的界限）
They are currently working on their second album, promising a fresh wave of innovative tracks that push the boundaries of their musical style.
16
🇳 他们还计划将影响力扩展到香港以外，旨在与全球观众分享他们的音乐。
plan to expand their reach beyond（计划将影响力扩展到……之外） aiming to share their music with a global audience（旨在与全球观众分享音乐）
They also plan to expand their reach beyond Hong Kong, aiming to share their music with a global audience.
17
🇳 本质上，Nine Dragons证明了音乐的力量——它连接、启发和超越的能力。
in essence（本质上） testament to the power of music（音乐力量的证明） its ability to connect, to inspire, and to transcend（它连接、激发和超越的能力）
In essence, Nine Dragons is a testament to the power of music - its ability to connect, to inspire, and to transcend.
18
🇳 他们不仅仅是音乐家；他们是讲故事的人，通过歌曲编织爱、失落、希望和梦想的故事。
not just musicians（不仅仅是音乐家） storytellers（讲故事的人） weaving tales of love, loss, hope, and dreams（编织着关于爱、失去、希望和梦想的故事）
They are not just musicians; they are storytellers, weaving tales of love, loss, hope, and dreams through their songs.
19
🇳 他们是Nine Dragons——传统与创新的融合，一曲吸引感官、触动灵魂的声音交响曲。
a fusion of tradition and innovation（传统与创新的融合） symphony of sounds（声音的交响乐） captivates the senses（俘获感官） stirs the soul（触动灵魂）
They are Nine Dragons - a fusion of tradition and innovation, a symphony of sounds that captivates the senses and stirs the soul. ---

2023 年 — 发现太极：古老艺术形式的现代益处（旅游杂志风格）

共19句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2023 Q2 Part B Learning English through Sports Communication
While tai chi is a popular activity in Hong Kong, it is less known in some parts of the world. Write an article for International Travel magazine introducing the benefits of tai chi to tourists.
1
🇳 太极是中国古老的武术，在香港是一项受欢迎的练习，提供温和体育锻炼与精神放松的独特结合。
ancient Chinese martial art（中国传统武术） popular practice（流行的做法） unique blend of（……的独特融合） gentle physical exercise（温和的体育锻炼） mental relaxation（精神放松）
Tai Chi, an ancient Chinese martial art, is a popular practice in Hong Kong, offering a unique blend of gentle physical exercise and mental relaxation.
2
🇳 虽然它在全球可能不那么知名，但太极可以提供众多健康益处，使其成为任何游客访问香港行程中的绝佳补充。
while it may not be as well-known globally（虽然它在全球可能不那么知名） provide numerous health benefits（提供许多健康益处） excellent addition to（……的极佳补充） tourist's itinerary（游客的行程）
While it may not be as well-known globally, Tai Chi is an activity that can provide numerous health benefits, making it an excellent addition to any tourist's itinerary when visiting Hong Kong.
3
🇳 太极起源于一千多年前的中国，最初是一种自卫形式。
originating from China over a millennium ago（起源于一千多年前的中国） initially a form of self-defense（最初是一种自卫形式）
Originating from China over a millennium ago, Tai Chi was initially a form of self-defense.
4
🇳 此后它演变为一种整体运动，融合了身体运动、精神集中和有控制的呼吸。
has since evolved into（此后已演变为） holistic exercise（整体性锻炼） integrates physical movement, mental concentration, and controlled breathing（融合身体运动、精神专注和控制呼吸）
It has since evolved into a holistic exercise that integrates physical movement, mental concentration, and controlled breathing.
5
🇳 今天，太极已成为许多香港人的日常惯例，通常在清晨在公园练习，创造出标志性的文化景观。
daily routine for many（许多人的日常） often practiced in parks during the early morning hours（常在清晨的公园里练习） creating an iconic cultural landscape（创造标志性的文化景观）
Today, Tai Chi has become a daily routine for many Hong Kong locals, often practiced in parks during the early morning hours, creating an iconic cultural landscape.
6
🇳 对游客来说，参加太极课不仅提供沉浸式文化体验，还提供旅行时保持健康的方式。
for tourists（对于游客） participating in a Tai Chi class（参加太极课） not only an immersive cultural experience（不仅是一次沉浸式文化体验） stay fit while traveling（旅行中保持健康）
For tourists, participating in a Tai Chi class offers not only an immersive cultural experience but also a way to stay fit while traveling.
7
🇳 太极最显著的好处之一是它减轻压力和焦虑的潜力。
one of the most significant benefits（最显著的好处之一） potential to reduce stress and anxiety（减轻压力和焦虑的潜力）
One of the most significant benefits of Tai Chi is its potential to reduce stress and anxiety.
8
🇳 动作的冥想性质加上深沉、有节奏的呼吸，可以平静心灵并创造放松感。
meditative nature of the movements（动作的冥想性） coupled with（加上） deep, rhythmic breathing（深沉有节奏的呼吸） calm the mind（平静心灵） create a sense of relaxation（营造放松感）
The meditative nature of the movements, coupled with deep, rhythmic breathing, can calm the mind and create a sense of relaxation.
9
🇳 在香港快节奏、充满活力的环境中，一次太极课可以提供急需的宁静绿洲。
amid the fast-paced, energetic environment（在快节奏活力四射的环境中） much-needed oasis of tranquility（急需的宁静绿洲）
Amid the fast-paced, energetic environment of Hong Kong, a Tai Chi session can provide a much-needed oasis of tranquility.
10
🇳 除了精神上的好处，太极还提供身体上的益处。
in addition to its mental benefits（除了精神层面的益处） offers physical advantages（提供体格上的优势）
In addition to its mental benefits, Tai Chi also offers physical advantages.
11
🇳 众所周知，练习可以增强平衡和协调，每个动作都需要一定程度的专注，促进身体稳定和身体意识。
known to enhance balance and coordination（以增强平衡和协调能力而闻名） requires a degree of focus（需要一定程度的专注） promotes physical stability and body awareness（促进身体稳定性和身体意识）
It is known to enhance balance and coordination, with each movement requiring a degree of focus that promotes physical stability and body awareness.
12
🇳 这是一项低冲击运动，适合所有年龄和健康水平的游客，提供了保持活跃的好方法，而没有高强度锻炼的压力。
low-impact exercise（低冲击运动） suitable for tourists of all ages and fitness levels（适合各年龄和体能水平的游客） great way to stay active（保持活跃的好方法） without the strain of high-intensity workouts（无需高强度锻炼的压力）
It's a low-impact exercise, making it suitable for tourists of all ages and fitness levels, providing a great way to stay active without the strain of high-intensity workouts.
13
🇳 此外，定期练习太极可以促进整体健康。
moreover（此外） regular Tai Chi practice（定期的太极练习） boost overall wellness（提升整体健康）
Moreover, regular Tai Chi practice can boost overall wellness.
14
🇳 研究表明，它可以改善心血管健康、增加灵活性、增强肌肉，甚至增强免疫系统。
it has been shown to（已被证明） improve cardiovascular health（改善心血管健康） increase flexibility（增加柔韧性） strengthen muscles（增强肌肉） enhance the immune system（增强免疫系统）
It has been shown to improve cardiovascular health, increase flexibility, strengthen muscles, and even enhance the immune system.
15
🇳 缓慢、有控制的动作还促进更好的姿势，可以缓解常见的疼痛——这对花长时间探索城市的旅行者来说是个受欢迎的好处。
slow, controlled movements（缓慢有控制的动作） promote better posture（改善姿势） alleviate common aches and pains（缓解常见疼痛） welcome benefit for travelers（对旅行者来说是受欢迎的益处）
The slow, controlled movements also promote better posture, which can alleviate common aches and pains - a welcome benefit for travelers spending long hours exploring the city.
16
🇳 本质上，太极不仅仅是运动；它是一种滋养身心的练习。
in essence（本质上） more than just exercise（不仅仅是锻炼） practice that nurtures both body and mind（滋养身心的练习）
In essence, Tai Chi is more than just exercise; it's a practice that nurtures both body and mind.
17
🇳 对游客来说，它提供了与当地文化互动的独特机会，同时促进健康和福祉。
provides a unique opportunity to（提供独特的机会） engage with local culture（接触本地文化） promoting their health and well-being（促进他们的身心健康）
For tourists, it provides a unique opportunity to engage with local culture while promoting their health and well-being.
18
🇳 所以，当你规划香港旅行行程时，考虑加入太极课。
when planning your travel itinerary（规划旅行行程时） consider including a Tai Chi class（考虑加入太极课程）
So, when planning your Hong Kong travel itinerary, consider including a Tai Chi class.
19
🇳 这是一次难忘的体验，体现了香港的精髓，在一个套餐中提供文化丰富和健康益处。
memorable experience（难忘的经历） encapsulates the essence of（概括了……的精髓） cultural enrichment and health benefits in one package（文化熏陶与健康益处集于一体）
It's a memorable experience that encapsulates the essence of Hong Kong, providing cultural enrichment and health benefits in one package. ---
