2019 年 — 驾驭数字浪潮：我获取流行文化趋势的首选来源（信息分享型）

共20句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q5 Part B Learning English through Popular Culture
This week's question in the Young Post's Over to You column is: 'Where do you get information about the latest trends in pop culture? Do you turn to newspapers and magazines or do you prefer blogs and videos on social media?' Write an article for the Over to You column. Choose one or two areas of pop culture from the chart and tell readers where you like to get information about the latest trends. Provide the name of the sources you recommend. Give your article a title.
1
🇳 流行文化一直是一个迷人的领域，不断演变并反映我们时代的精神。
fascinating realm（迷人的领域） constantly evolving（不断演变） reflecting the zeitgeist of our times（反映我们时代的时代精神）
Pop culture has always been a fascinating realm, constantly evolving and reflecting the zeitgeist of our times.
2
🇳 从音乐和音乐会到科技和游戏，了解最新趋势通常感觉像是一份全职工作。
from music and concerts to tech and games（从音乐演唱会到科技和游戏） staying updated with the latest trends（紧跟最新潮流） feel like a full-time job（感觉像一份全职工作）
From music and concerts to tech and games, staying updated with the latest trends can often feel like a full-time job.
3
🇳 虽然有些人仍然依赖报纸和杂志等传统媒体，但我发现博客和社交媒体提供更实时和沉浸式的体验。
while some people still rely on（虽然有些人仍然依赖） traditional media（传统媒体） real-time and immersive experience（实时沉浸式体验）
While some people still rely on traditional media like newspapers and magazines, I have found that blogs and social media provide a more real-time and immersive experience.
4
🇳 说到音乐和音乐会，我的首选来源是Pitchfork，一个在线音乐刊物。
when it comes to（当谈到……时） my go-to source is（我的首选来源是） online music publication（在线音乐刊物）
When it comes to music and concerts, my go-to source is Pitchfork, an online music publication.
5
🇳 Pitchfork以其对主流和地下音乐场景的广泛报道而闻名。
renowned for（以……闻名） extensive coverage of（对……的广泛报道） mainstream and underground music scenes（主流和地下音乐圈）
Pitchfork is renowned for its extensive coverage of both mainstream and underground music scenes.
6
🇳 它提供专辑评论、艺术家采访以及关于音乐节和音乐会的最新消息。
provides album reviews, artist interviews, and the latest news about（提供专辑评论、艺术家访谈和最新消息） music festivals and concerts（音乐节和演唱会）
It provides album reviews, artist interviews, and the latest news about music festivals and concerts.
7
🇳 该网站还包括一个名为"最佳新音乐"的部分，突出杰出的发行，让我了解最新鲜的曲调。
includes a section called（包含一个名为……的板块） highlights standout releases（重点介绍突出的作品） keeping me updated with the freshest tunes（让我听到最新鲜的音乐）
The site also includes a section called "Best New Music," which highlights standout releases, keeping me updated with the freshest tunes.
8
🇳 对于科技和游戏，我求助于TechCrunch和IGN，它们就像是科技和游戏新闻的圣杯。
for tech and games（科技和游戏方面） turn to（转向） Holy Grails of technology and gaming news（科技和游戏新闻的圣杯）
For tech and games, I turn to TechCrunch and IGN, which are like the Holy Grails of technology and gaming news.
9
🇳 TechCrunch提供关于科技创新、初创公司和行业趋势的最新消息。
provides the latest news on（提供最新消息） tech innovations, start-ups, and industry trends（科技创新、初创企业和行业趋势）
TechCrunch provides the latest news on tech innovations, start-ups, and industry trends.
10
🇳 其简单而全面的方法使其成为任何对快节奏科技世界感兴趣的人的可靠来源。
simple yet comprehensive approach（简单而全面的方法） reliable source for（……的可靠来源） fast-paced world of technology（快节奏的科技世界）
Its simple yet comprehensive approach makes it a reliable source for anyone interested in the fast-paced world of technology.
11
🇳 另一方面，IGN是游戏爱好者的宝库。
on the other hand（另一方面） treasure trove for gaming enthusiasts（游戏爱好者的宝库）
IGN, on the other hand, is a treasure trove for gaming enthusiasts.
12
🇳 从游戏评论和预告片到开发者采访和游戏大会，IGN涵盖了一切。
from game reviews and trailers to（从游戏评测和预告片到） developer interviews and gaming conventions（开发者访谈和游戏展会） covers it all（应有尽有）
From game reviews and trailers to developer interviews and gaming conventions, IGN covers it all.
13
🇳 它还有强大的社区元素，有活跃的论坛，用户可以在那里讨论最新游戏和游戏趋势。
strong community element（强大的社区元素） active forums（活跃的论坛） discuss the latest games and gaming trends（讨论最新游戏和游戏趋势）
It also has a strong community element, with active forums where users can discuss the latest games and gaming trends.
14
🇳 社交媒体平台在我的流行文化沉浸中也起着至关重要的作用。
play a crucial role in（在……中发挥关键作用） pop culture immersion（流行文化沉浸）
Social media platforms also play a crucial role in my pop culture immersion.
15
🇳 例如，Twitter非常适合实时更新，特别是在音乐会或游戏发布等现场活动期间。
for instance（例如） great for real-time updates（很适合实时更新） during live events like concerts or game releases（在音乐会或游戏发布等现场活动中）
Twitter, for instance, is great for real-time updates, especially during live events like concerts or game releases.
16
🇳 同时，Instagram是视觉趋势的中心，特别是在时尚、美容和餐饮方面。
meanwhile（与此同时） hub for visual trends（视觉趋势的中心） style, beauty, and food and drink（时尚、美容和饮食）
Instagram, meanwhile, is a hub for visual trends, especially in style, beauty, and food and drink.
17
🇳 对于深度内容，我求助于YouTube，那里有众多视频博主和内容创作者涵盖广泛的流行文化主题。
for in-depth content（对于深度内容） turn to YouTube（转向YouTube） numerous vloggers and content creators（众多视频博主和内容创作者） wide range of pop culture topics（广泛的流行文化话题）
For in-depth content, I turn to YouTube, where numerous vloggers and content creators cover a wide range of pop culture topics.
18
🇳 总之，数字景观提供了大量来源来了解最新流行文化趋势。
in conclusion（总之） digital landscape（数字格局） vast array of sources（广泛的来源） stay updated with（与……保持同步）
In conclusion, the digital landscape provides a vast array of sources to stay updated with the latest pop culture trends.
19
🇳 虽然传统媒体仍有其优点，但在线刊物和社交媒体平台提供了更直接、更吸引人的方式来驾驭快节奏的流行文化世界。
while traditional media still have their merits（虽然传统媒体仍有其优点） online publications and social media platforms（在线出版物和社交媒体平台） more immediate and engaging way（更即时和吸引人的方式） navigate the fast-paced world（驾驭快节奏的世界）
While traditional media still have their merits, online publications and social media platforms provide a more immediate and engaging way to navigate the fast-paced world of pop culture.
20
🇳 所以，无论你是音乐爱好者还是游戏迷，数字浪潮都提供了丰富、多样和不断演变的信息来源。
whether you're a music enthusiast or a gaming aficionado（无论你是音乐爱好者还是游戏迷） digital wave（数字化浪潮） rich, diverse, and ever-evolving source of information（丰富多样且不断演变的信息来源）
So, whether you're a music enthusiast or a gaming aficionado, the digital wave offers a rich, diverse, and ever-evolving source of information. ---

2018 年 — 运动休闲风的兴起：模糊健身与时尚的界限（分析/评论型）

共22句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q6 Part B Learning English through Popular Culture
'Athleisure' is currently one of the biggest trends in the fashion industry. This is a term for clothes that can be worn both for exercise and as everyday wear. Write an article for the local newspaper explaining possible reasons for the rise in popularity of athleisure.
1
🇳 近年来，一股新趋势席卷时尚界——"运动休闲风"。
in recent years（近年来） taken the fashion world by storm（席卷了时尚界） Athleisure（运动休闲风）
In recent years, a new trend has taken the fashion world by storm - 'Athleisure'.
2
🇳 这个词是"运动"和"休闲"的合成词，指为锻炼设计但也适合日常穿着的服装。
portmanteau of（……的组合词） refers to（指的是） designed for workouts（为健身设计） suitable for everyday wear（适合日常穿着）
This term, a portmanteau of 'athletic' and 'leisure', refers to clothing designed for workouts, but which is also suitable for everyday wear.
3
🇳 从瑜伽裤到运动鞋，这一趋势重新定义了我们看待和穿着服装的方式。
from yoga pants to sneakers（从瑜伽裤到运动鞋） redefined how we perceive and wear our clothes（重新定义了我们对服装的认知和穿着方式）
From yoga pants to sneakers, this trend has redefined how we perceive and wear our clothes.
4
🇳 那么，运动休闲风迅速崛起背后的驱动因素是什么？
what are the driving factors behind（背后的驱动因素是什么） meteoric rise（流星般的崛起）
So, what are the driving factors behind the meteoric rise of athleisure?
5
🇳 首先，我们生活在一个注重健康的时代。
firstly（首先） health-conscious era（注重健康的时代）
Firstly, we live in a health-conscious era.
6
🇳 随着越来越多人拥抱健康和健身的生活方式，他们的服装选择也随之演变以反映这一转变。
as more and more people embrace（随着越来越多人接受） lifestyle of wellness and fitness（健康与健身的生活方式） clothing choices have evolved（着装选择已演变） reflect this shift（反映这一转变）
As more and more people embrace a lifestyle of wellness and fitness, their clothing choices have evolved to reflect this shift.
7
🇳 运动休闲风融合舒适与时尚，完美迎合了这一需求。
fusion of comfort and style（舒适与风格的融合） perfectly caters to this need（完美满足这一需求）
Athleisure, with its fusion of comfort and style, perfectly caters to this need.
8
🇳 这些服装功能性强，设计用于支持体育活动，但也很时尚，让人们可以从锻炼无缝过渡到休闲外出。
functional（功能性的） designed to support physical activity（设计来支持身体活动） fashionable（时尚的） transition seamlessly from（从……无缝过渡到） workout session to casual outing（从健身到休闲外出皆宜）
The clothes are functional, designed to support physical activity, but they are also fashionable, allowing individuals to transition seamlessly from a workout session to a casual outing.
9
🇳 此外，远程工作和弹性工作时间的兴起也显著影响了我们的衣橱。
moreover（此外） rise of remote working（远程工作的兴起） flexible work schedules（灵活的工作时间） significantly influenced our wardrobes（显著影响了我们的衣橱）
Moreover, the rise of remote working and flexible work schedules has significantly influenced our wardrobes.
10
🇳 随着我们花更多时间在家工作，舒适成为首要考虑。
as we spend more time working from home（随着花更多时间在家工作） comfort has become a priority（舒适已成为优先考虑）
As we spend more time working from home, comfort has become a priority.
11
🇳 运动休闲风强调舒适和活动自如，提供了完美的解决方案。
with its emphasis on（以对……的强调） comfort and ease of movement（舒适与活动自如） offers the perfect solution（提供完美解决方案）
Athleisure, with its emphasis on comfort and ease of movement, offers the perfect solution.
12
🇳 它让人们在视频通话中保持专业形象的同时，享受运动服的舒适。
allows individuals to（使个人能够） maintain a professional appearance（保持专业形象） video calls（视频通话） enjoying the comfort of workout wear（享受运动装的舒适）
It allows individuals to maintain a professional appearance for video calls while enjoying the comfort of workout wear.
13
🇳 社交媒体也在普及运动休闲风方面发挥了重要作用。
social media（社交媒体） played a significant role in（在……中发挥了重要作用） popularizing athleisure（推广运动休闲风）
Social media, too, has played a significant role in popularizing athleisure.
14
🇳 健身网红和名人经常分享自己穿着时尚运动装备的照片，推广既活跃又时尚的生活方式。
fitness influencers and celebrities（健身网红和名人） share photos of（分享……的照片） stylish workout gear（时尚运动装备） promoting a lifestyle that is both active and fashionable（推广既活跃又时尚的生活方式）
Fitness influencers and celebrities often share photos of themselves in stylish workout gear, promoting a lifestyle that is both active and fashionable.
15
🇳 这些帖子不仅提供时尚灵感，还影响消费者行为，促使粉丝投资类似服装。
not only provide fashion inspiration（不仅提供时尚灵感） influence consumer behavior（影响消费者行为） prompting followers to invest in（促使粉丝购买）
These posts not only provide fashion inspiration but also influence consumer behavior, prompting followers to invest in similar clothing.
16
🇳 最后，时尚品牌本身也推动了运动休闲风的兴起。
finally（最后） fashion brands themselves（时尚品牌本身） contributed to the rise（促成了……的崛起）
Finally, fashion brands themselves have contributed to the rise of athleisure.
17
🇳 认识到不断增长的需求，从高端设计师到高街零售商的许多品牌都推出了自己的运动休闲系列。
recognizing the growing demand（认识到日益增长的需求） from high-end designers to high-street retailers（从高端设计师到高街零售商） launched their own athleisure lines（推出了自己的运动休闲产品线）
Recognizing the growing demand, many brands, from high-end designers to high-street retailers, have launched their own athleisure lines.
18
🇳 他们经常与名人或运动员合作，进一步提升这一趋势的人气和影响力。
collaborate with celebrities or athletes（与名人或运动员合作） further boosting the trend's popularity and reach（进一步推动这一潮流的流行度和影响力）
They often collaborate with celebrities or athletes, further boosting the trend's popularity and reach.
19
🇳 总之，运动休闲风的兴起可归因于多种因素的结合，从生活方式和工作模式的转变到社交媒体的影响和时尚品牌的战略营销。
in conclusion（总之） can be attributed to（可归因于） combination of factors（多种因素组合） shifts in lifestyle and work patterns（生活方式和工作模式的转变） influence of social media（社交媒体的影响） strategic marketing（战略营销）
In conclusion, the rise of athleisure can be attributed to a combination of factors, from shifts in lifestyle and work patterns to the influence of social media and strategic marketing by fashion brands.
20
🇳 随着我们继续寻求舒适与时尚的平衡，以及运动服与日常服装之间的界限继续模糊，运动休闲风很可能在可预见的未来继续主导我们的衣橱。
as we continue to seek（在我们继续探索之际） balance between comfort and style（舒适与时尚的平衡） lines between... continue to blur（……之间的界限继续模糊） for the foreseeable future（在可预见的未来） dominate our wardrobes（主导我们的衣橱）
As we continue to seek a balance between comfort and style, and as the lines between workout wear and everyday clothing continue to blur, it is likely that athleisure will continue to dominate our wardrobes for the foreseeable future.
21
🇳 在拥抱运动休闲风时，我们拥抱的是一种反映我们不断演变的生活方式和价值观的时尚趋势。
in embracing athleisure（在拥抱运动休闲风方面） fashion trend that reflects（反映……的时尚潮流） evolving lifestyles and values（不断演变的生活方式和价值观）
In embracing athleisure, we are embracing a fashion trend that reflects our evolving lifestyles and values.
22
🇳 那么看来，运动休闲风不仅仅是一种趋势，而是时代的反映。
it seems then（那么看来） not just a trend（不只是潮流） reflection of the times（时代的反映）
It seems, then, that athleisure is not just a trend, but a reflection of the times. ---

2018 年 — 舞台剧录像能否吸引更多观众？（分析/评论型）

共18句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q7 Part B Learning English through Drama
The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) wants to encourage more people to watch stage plays. To do this, they want to show video-recordings of live drama performances from theatres all over the world. You have just watched one of these recordings. Write an article for Showbiz magazine discussing whether these recordings are a good way to attract more people to watch stage plays.
1
🇳 最近，香港演艺学院（HKAPA）启动了一项激动人心的举措：放映来自全球各地剧院的现场戏剧表演录像。
recently（最近） embarked on an exciting initiative（启动了一项令人兴奋的计划） showing video-recordings of（播放……的录像） live drama performances（现场戏剧表演） from theatres around the globe（来自全球各地的剧院）
Recently, the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) has embarked on an exciting initiative: showing video-recordings of live drama performances from theatres around the globe.
2
🇳 作为刚看过其中一场录像的人，我想分享我对这种方式能否吸引更多人进入舞台剧世界的看法。
as someone who's just watched one of these recordings（作为刚看过其中一场录像的人） share my thoughts on（分享我对……的想法） whether this approach can draw more people into（这种方法能否吸引更多人） world of stage plays（舞台剧的世界）
As someone who's just watched one of these recordings, I want to share my thoughts on whether this approach can draw more people into the world of stage plays.
3
🇳 首先，这一举措使戏剧获取民主化，使其更实惠、更容易接触。
first and foremost（首先且最重要的是） democratizes access to theatre（使戏剧观赏大众化） more affordable and accessible（更实惠和可及）
First and foremost, this initiative democratizes access to theatre, making it more affordable and accessible.
4
🇳 对许多人来说，现场戏剧的费用和地点可能令人望而却步。
for many（对很多人来说） cost and location of live theatre（现场戏剧的成本和地点） prohibitive（高昂得令人望而却步的）
For many, the cost and location of live theatre can be prohibitive.
5
🇳 通过提供录像，HKAPA正在打破这些障碍，让更广泛的观众体验戏剧的魔力。
by offering video-recordings（通过提供录像） breaking down these barriers（打破这些障碍） allowing a wider audience to（让更广泛观众能……） experience the magic of theatre（体验戏剧的魔力）
By offering video-recordings, HKAPA is breaking down these barriers and allowing a wider audience to experience the magic of theatre.
6
🇳 这无疑可以吸引更多人接触这门艺术，甚至可能激励他们将来去看现场表演。
could undoubtedly attract more people to（无疑能吸引更多人） might even inspire them to（甚至可能激励他们） see live performances in the future（将来观看现场表演）
This could undoubtedly attract more people to the art form and might even inspire them to see live performances in the future.
7
🇳 其次，这些录像提供了展示来自世界各地各种风格和传统的机会。
secondly（其次） provide an opportunity to showcase（提供展示……的机会） variety of styles and traditions（多样的风格和传统） from around the world（来自世界各地）
Secondly, these recordings provide an opportunity to showcase a variety of styles and traditions from around the world.
8
🇳 它们让观众接触到戏剧的多样性，从百老汇音乐剧和伦敦西区戏剧到小型独立剧院的前卫表演。
expose viewers to（让观众接触到） diversity of theatre（戏剧的多样性） Broadway musicals（百老汇音乐剧） London's West End dramas（伦敦西区戏剧） avant-garde performances（前卫表演） small independent theatres（小型独立剧院）
They expose viewers to the diversity of theatre, from Broadway musicals and London's West End dramas to avant-garde performances from small independent theatres.
9
🇳 这种全球视角可以拓宽观众对戏剧的理解和欣赏，可能引发对舞台剧更深的兴趣。
global perspective（全球视野） broaden the audience's understanding and appreciation（拓宽观众的理解与欣赏） sparking a deeper interest in（激发对……更深兴趣）
This global perspective can broaden the audience's understanding and appreciation of theatre, potentially sparking a deeper interest in stage plays.
10
🇳 然而，值得注意的是，虽然录像有其优点，但它们无法完全复制观看现场表演的体验。
however（然而） it's worth noting that（值得指出的是） while video-recordings have their merits（虽然视频录像有其优点） cannot fully replicate（无法完全复制） experience of watching a live performance（观看现场表演的体验）
However, it's worth noting that while video-recordings have their merits, they cannot fully replicate the experience of watching a live performance.
11
🇳 戏剧是一种独特的艺术形式，依靠即时性和互动而蓬勃发展。
unique art form（独特的艺术形式） thrives on（靠……蓬勃发展） immediacy and interaction（即时性与互动）
Theatre is a unique art form that thrives on immediacy and interaction.
12
🇳 现场演员的能量、观众的共同反应、每晚可能不同的表演细微差别——这些是使戏剧特别的元素，在录像中可能会丢失。
energy of live actors（现场演员的能量） shared reactions of the audience（观众的共同反应） subtle nuances of performance（表演的细微差别） can change from night to night（每场都可能不同） elements that make theatre special（使戏剧独特的元素） can be lost in a recording（在录像中可能丢失）
The energy of live actors, the shared reactions of the audience, the subtle nuances of performance that can change from night to night - these are elements that make theatre special and they can be lost in a recording.
13
🇳 此外，存在人们用这些更方便、更便宜的录像代替观看现场表演的风险，这可能损害本地剧院。
moreover（此外） there's a risk that（存在……的风险） substitute watching live performances with（用……替代观看现场演出） more convenient and less expensive recordings（更方便更便宜的录像） hurt local theatres（伤害本地剧院）
Moreover, there's a risk that people might substitute watching live performances with these more convenient and less expensive recordings, which could hurt local theatres.
14
🇳 对HKAPA来说，取得平衡很重要：用这些录像作为激发兴趣的工具，但也要强调参加现场表演不可替代的价值和体验。
it's important for... to strike a balance（对……来说取得平衡很重要） use these recordings as a tool to（把这些录像用作……的工具） pique interest（激起兴趣） emphasize the irreplaceable value and experience of（强调……不可替代的价值和体验） attending live performances（观看现场演出）
It's important for HKAPA to strike a balance: use these recordings as a tool to pique interest, but also emphasize the irreplaceable value and experience of attending live performances.
15
🇳 总之，舞台剧录像可以成为吸引更多人接触戏剧的有力工具。
in conclusion（总之） powerful tool for attracting more people to theatre（吸引更多人走进剧院的强大工具）
In conclusion, video-recordings of stage plays can be a powerful tool for attracting more people to theatre.
16
🇳 它们提供可及性、可负担性和全球视角。
offer access, affordability, and a global perspective（提供可达性、可负担性和全球视野）
They offer access, affordability, and a global perspective.
17
🇳 然而，必须记住它们不是现场戏剧的替代品，而是通往现场戏剧的门户。
however（然而） it's essential to remember（必须记住） not a replacement for（不是……的替代品） but rather a gateway to（而是通往……的门户）
However, it's essential to remember that they are not a replacement for live theatre but rather a gateway to it.
18
🇳 所以，让我们赞扬HKAPA的举措，但也让我们继续庆祝和推广只有现场戏剧才能提供的独特、激动人心的体验。
let's applaud（让我们为……鼓掌） let's also continue to celebrate and promote（让我们也继续庆祝和推广） unique, thrilling experience that only live theatre can provide（只有现场戏剧才能提供的独特刺激体验）
So, let's applaud HKAPA's initiative, but let's also continue to celebrate and promote the unique, thrilling experience that only live theatre can provide. ---

2023 年 — 童话与寓言中的人生教训（反思议论文）

共23句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2023 Q5 Part B Learning English through Short Stories
Fairy tales and fables teach us how to find love, survive family conflicts, defeat the rich and powerful and live happily ever after. Write an essay to explain how reading these kinds of stories has taught you important lessons about life.
1
🇳 童话和寓言常被视为简单的儿童文学，但实际上是深刻的智慧宝库，提供宝贵的人生教训。
often dismissed as（常被贬为） simple children's literature（简单的儿童文学） in fact（事实上） profound reservoirs of wisdom（深邃的智慧宝库） offering valuable life lessons（提供宝贵的人生教训）
Fairy tales and fables, often dismissed as simple children's literature, are in fact profound reservoirs of wisdom, offering valuable life lessons.
2
🇳 这些迷人的叙事教会了我关于爱、家庭冲突、权力动态和追求幸福。
enchanting narratives（迷人的叙事） taught me about（教会我关于） love, family conflicts, power dynamics, and the pursuit of happiness（爱情、家庭冲突、权力动态和对幸福的追求）
These enchanting narratives have taught me about love, family conflicts, power dynamics, and the pursuit of happiness.
3
🇳 它们不仅仅是娱乐故事；更是我早期的人生导师。
more than just entertaining tales（不仅仅是娱乐故事） early life mentors（早期的人生导师）
They've been more than just entertaining tales; they've been my early life mentors.
4
🇳 这些故事教给我的第一个教训是爱的复杂性和力量。
first lesson（第一课） complexities and power of love（爱的复杂与力量）
The first lesson these stories taught me is about the complexities and power of love.
5
🇳 像《美女与野兽》这样的故事表明，爱超越外表，深深植根于灵魂之美。
tales like Beauty and the Beast（像《美女与野兽》这样的故事） love transcends physical appearances（爱超越外表） deeply rooted in（深深植根于） beauty of one's soul（灵魂之美）
Tales like Beauty and the Beast have shown that love transcends physical appearances and is deeply rooted in the beauty of one's soul.
6
🇳 爱的变革力量也很明显，因为它能激发出个人最好的一面。
transformative power of love（爱的转化力量） evident（明显的） brings out the best in individuals（激发个人最佳状态）
The transformative power of love is also evident, as it brings out the best in individuals.
7
🇳 同时，《青蛙王子》强调了在关系中遵守承诺和尊重约定的重要性，塑造了我对爱和关系动态的理解。
meanwhile（与此同时） highlighted the importance of（强调了……的重要性） keeping promises（信守承诺） respecting commitments in relationships（尊重关系中的承诺） molding my understanding of（塑造我对……的理解）
Meanwhile, The Frog Prince highlighted the importance of keeping promises and respecting commitments in relationships, molding my understanding of love and relationship dynamics.
8
🇳 在家庭冲突中生存是这些叙事传授的另一个关键教训。
surviving family conflicts（在家庭冲突中生存） another crucial lesson（另一重要教训） imparted through these narratives（通过这些叙事传授的）
Surviving family conflicts is another crucial lesson imparted through these narratives.
9
🇳 例如，灰姑娘以善良和优雅应对与继母和继姐妹的困难。
for instance（例如） Cinderella（灰姑娘） navigates through difficulties with（以……应对困难） stepmother and stepsisters（继母和继姐妹） kindness and grace（善意与优雅）
Cinderella, for instance, navigates through her difficulties with her stepmother and stepsisters with kindness and grace.
10
🇳 这个故事教会了我在逆境中保持正直和同情的重要性。
taught me the importance of（教会了我……的重要性） maintaining one's integrity and compassion（保持正直和同情心） in the face of adversity（面对逆境）
This story taught me the importance of maintaining one's integrity and compassion in the face of adversity.
11
🇳 它强化了善良和勇气可以战胜残忍和恶意的观念，为处理家庭关系提供了宝贵指导。
reinforced the idea that（强化了……的观念） kindness and courage could triumph over（善良和勇气能战胜） cruelty and malice（残忍与恶意） providing invaluable guidance on（在……方面提供宝贵的指导） navigating familial relationships（处理家庭关系）
It reinforced the idea that kindness and courage could triumph over cruelty and malice, providing invaluable guidance on navigating familial relationships.
12
🇳 此外，这些故事呈现了弱者与有权者（通常是富有的反派）之间的经典斗争。
in addition（此外） classic battle between（……之间的经典对决） underdog and the powerful（弱者和强者） often rich antagonist（往往富有的反派）
In addition, these stories present the classic battle between the underdog and the powerful, often rich antagonist.
13
🇳 例如，《杰克与魔豆》讲述了一个贫穷男孩战胜富有而强大的巨人的故事。
for example（例如） Jack and the Beanstalk（杰克与魔豆） tells the tale of（讲述了……的故事） poor boy who overcomes（克服困难的穷男孩） wealthy and powerful giant（富有且强大的巨人）
Jack and the Beanstalk, for example, tells the tale of a poor boy who overcomes a wealthy and powerful giant.
14
🇳 它教会我，无论一个人的社会或经济地位如何，勇气和聪明可以战胜强权。
taught me that（让我明白） courage and cleverness can defeat might（勇气和智慧可以战胜蛮力） regardless of（无论） social or economic status（社会或经济地位）
It taught me that courage and cleverness can defeat might, regardless of one's social or economic status.
15
🇳 这个故事和许多其他故事一起，让我坚信韧性和足智多谋的力量。
along with many others（与许多其他人一起） instilled in me（在我心中植入了） firm belief in（对……的坚定信念） power of resilience and resourcefulness（韧性和机智的力量）
This story, along with many others, has instilled in me a firm belief in the power of resilience and resourcefulness.
16
🇳 最后，对幸福的追求——通常包含在"从此幸福地生活在一起"这句话中——是这些故事中反复出现的主题。
lastly（最后） pursuit of happiness（对幸福的追求） often encapsulated in the phrase（常被概括为这句话） "happily ever after"（「从此幸福快乐」） recurring theme（反复出现的主题）
Lastly, the pursuit of happiness, often encapsulated in the phrase "happily ever after," is a recurring theme in these tales.
17
🇳 它们教会我，幸福通常是个人成长、善良和爱的结果。
taught me that（让我明白） happiness is often a result of（幸福往往是……的结果） personal growth, kindness, and love（个人成长、善良和爱）
They taught me that happiness is often a result of personal growth, kindness, and love.
18
🇳 灰姑娘的"从此幸福"是在她的磨难之后到来的，表明幸福通常跟在逆境之后。
Cinderella's "happily ever after"（灰姑娘的「从此幸福快乐」） came after her trials and tribulations（历经磨难后才到来） demonstrating that（表明） happiness often follows adversity（幸福往往紧随逆境而来）
Cinderella's "happily ever after" came after her trials and tribulations, demonstrating that happiness often follows adversity.
19
🇳 这些叙事塑造了我对幸福的理解：幸福来自内心，通常是努力得来的。
shaped my understanding of happiness as（塑造了我对幸福的理解） comes from within（来自内心） usually hard-earned（通常来之不易）
These narratives have shaped my understanding of happiness as something that comes from within and is usually hard-earned.
20
🇳 总之，童话和寓言极大地帮助了我理解生活及其各个方面。
in conclusion（总之） significantly contributed to my understanding of（显著加深了我对……的理解） life and its various aspects（生活及其各个方面）
In conclusion, fairy tales and fables have significantly contributed to my understanding of life and its various aspects.
21
🇳 它们教会了我关于爱、冲突解决、权力动态和追求幸福。
taught me about（教会我关于） love, conflict resolution, power dynamics, and the pursuit of happiness（爱情、冲突解决、权力动态和对幸福的追求）
They have taught me about love, conflict resolution, the power dynamics, and the pursuit of happiness.
22
🇳 这些故事中蕴含的智慧继续指引我的人生旅程，提醒我它们包含的永恒教训。
wisdom encapsulated in these tales（这些故事中蕴含的智慧） continues to guide me through（继续指引我度过） life's journey（人生旅程） reminding me of（提醒着我） timeless lessons（永恒的教训）
The wisdom encapsulated in these tales continues to guide me through life's journey, reminding me of the timeless lessons they contain.
23
🇳 这些叙事以其简单而深刻的信息，对我的人生观产生了不可磨灭的影响，使我成为一个更明智、更有同情心的人。
with their simple yet profound messages（以简单而深刻的信息） left an indelible impact on（在……留下不可磨灭的影响） perception of life（对人生的看法） making me a wiser, more compassionate individual（让我成为一个更明智、更有同情心的人）
These narratives, with their simple yet profound messages, have left an indelible impact on my perception of life, making me a wiser, more compassionate individual. ---

2018 年 — 我的第一次香港马拉松：耐力与赋权之旅（叙事型）

共24句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q2 Part B Learning English through Sports Communication
You recently ran the Hong Kong Marathon for the first time. Write a blog to be posted on the Hong Kong Marathon's website to encourage other young people to take part in the next marathon.
1
🇳 作为第一次参加香港马拉松的人，我必须承认，跑42公里的前景相当令人生畏。
as a first-time participant in（作为……首次参与者） prospect of running 42 kilometers（跑42公里的前景） quite intimidating（相当令人生畏）
As a first-time participant in the Hong Kong Marathon, I must admit, the prospect of running 42 kilometers was quite intimidating.
2
🇳 然而，我获得的经验是无法估量的回报，我会全心全意鼓励所有年轻人考虑参加下一次马拉松。
however（然而） experience I gained（我获得的经验） immeasurably rewarding（无比有收获的） wholeheartedly encourage（全心全意鼓励） all young people to consider participating in（所有年轻人都考虑参与）
However, the experience I gained was immeasurably rewarding and I would wholeheartedly encourage all young people to consider participating in the next marathon.
3
🇳 首先，马拉松训练教会了我纪律和毅力的价值。
to begin with（首先） training for the marathon（为马拉松训练） taught me the value of（教会我……的价值） discipline and perseverance（纪律和perseverance）
To begin with, training for the marathon taught me the value of discipline and perseverance.
4
🇳 我必须坚持严格的训练惯例，每天跑几公里，逐渐增加距离，并保持健康饮食。
had to stick to（不得不坚持） strict training routine（严格的训练日程） running several kilometers each day（每天跑数公里） gradually increasing the distance（逐渐增加距离） maintaining a healthy diet（保持健康饮食）
I had to stick to a strict training routine, running several kilometers each day, gradually increasing the distance, and maintaining a healthy diet.
5
🇳 有些日子我想放弃，肌肉酸痛，怀疑自己完成比赛的能力。
days when I wanted to give up（那些我想放弃的日子） muscles ached（肌肉酸痛） doubted my ability to complete the race（怀疑自己能否完成比赛）
There were days when I wanted to give up, when my muscles ached and I doubted my ability to complete the race.
6
🇳 然而，这些挑战只会增强我的决心。
yet（然而） these challenges only strengthened my resolve（这些挑战只坚定了我的决心）
Yet, these challenges only strengthened my resolve.
7
🇳 我学会了在痛苦中坚持，即使终点线看起来遥不可及也要继续前进。
learned to push through the pain（学会了忍痛坚持） keep going even when（即使……也要继续） finish line seemed impossibly far away（终点线似乎遥不可及）
I learned to push through the pain, to keep going even when the finish line seemed impossibly far away.
8
🇳 马拉松那天，我被一群热情的跑者包围，大家都有同一个目标。
on the day of the marathon（在马拉松当天） engulfed in a sea of（被一片……的海洋吞没） enthusiastic runners（热情的跑者） all sharing the same goal（都怀着同一目标）
On the day of the marathon, I was engulfed in a sea of enthusiastic runners, all sharing the same goal.
9
🇳 那种能量具有感染力。
energy was infectious（能量感染了所有人）
The energy was infectious.
10
🇳 人群的每一次欢呼，跑友的每一个鼓励微笑，都激励我继续前进。
every cheer from the crowd（人群的每一声欢呼） every encouraging smile from a fellow runner（跑友的每一个鼓励的微笑） fueled me to keep going（激励我继续前行）
Every cheer from the crowd, every encouraging smile from a fellow runner, fueled me to keep going.
11
🇳 我感受到的社区意识是压倒性的，非常激励人心。
sense of community I felt（我感受到的社群归属感） overwhelming and incredibly motivating（势不可挡且无比激励人心）
The sense of community I felt was overwhelming and incredibly motivating.
12
🇳 冲过终点线是一个激动人心的时刻。
crossing the finish line（冲过终点线） emotional moment（动人的时刻）
Crossing the finish line was an emotional moment.
13
🇳 这是数月努力、清晨和酸痛肌肉、克服怀疑和突破极限的顶点。
culmination of（……的高潮） months of hard work（数月的努力） early mornings and sore muscles（清晨和肌肉酸痛） doubts overcome and limits pushed（克服疑虑突破极限）
It was the culmination of months of hard work, of early mornings and sore muscles, of doubts overcome and limits pushed.
14
🇳 我感到一种前所未有的成就感。
sense of accomplishment（成就感） I'd never experienced before（我从未体验过的）
I felt a sense of accomplishment that I'd never experienced before.
15
🇳 这是我将永远珍藏的时刻，证明了当我下定决心时我能实现什么。
moment I will cherish forever（我将永远珍藏的时刻） testament to（……的证明） what I can achieve when I set my mind to it（当我下定决心时能取得的成就）
It was a moment I will cherish forever, a testament to what I can achieve when I set my mind to it.
16
🇳 但马拉松不仅仅是个人成就。
but the marathon was more than just（但马拉松远不止是） personal achievement（个人成就）
But the marathon was more than just a personal achievement.
17
🇳 它也是为更伟大事业做贡献的机会。
also an opportunity to（也是一个……的机会） contribute to a greater cause（为更伟大的事业做贡献）
It was also an opportunity to contribute to a greater cause.
18
🇳 许多跑者，包括我自己，将马拉松作为为各种慈善机构筹款的平台。
many runners, myself included（许多跑者包括我自己） used the marathon as a platform to（以马拉松为平台） raise funds for various charities（为各种慈善机构筹款）
Many runners, myself included, used the marathon as a platform to raise funds for various charities.
19
🇳 知道我的努力正在帮助他人，为这次经历增添了额外的意义。
knowing that my efforts were helping others（知道我的努力在帮助他人） added an extra layer of meaning to（为……增添更深含义）
Knowing that my efforts were helping others added an extra layer of meaning to the experience.
20
🇳 总之，跑香港马拉松是一次变革性的经历。
in conclusion（总之） running the Hong Kong Marathon（参加香港马拉松） transformative experience（转化性的体验）
In conclusion, running the Hong Kong Marathon was a transformative experience.
21
🇳 它教会了我纪律和毅力的价值，让我成为支持性社区的一部分，并使我能够为更伟大的事业做贡献。
taught me the value of（教会我……的价值） allowed me to be part of（让我成为……的一部分） supportive community（支持的社群） enabled me to contribute to（使我能够为……做贡献）
It taught me the value of discipline and perseverance, allowed me to be a part of a supportive community, and enabled me to contribute to a greater cause.
22
🇳 对所有年轻人，我说：参加下一次马拉松吧。
to all young people out there（致所有的年轻人） take part in the next marathon（参加下一次马拉松）
To all young people out there, I say this: take part in the next marathon.
23
🇳 它会挑战你，推动你，但最重要的是，它会赋予你力量。
it will challenge you（它会挑战你） it will push you（它会推动你） but most importantly（但最重要的是） it will empower you（它会赋予你力量）
It will challenge you, it will push you, but most importantly, it will empower you.
24
🇳 42公里的旅程从一步开始。所以系好跑鞋，迈出那一步。我向你保证，这是值得的。
journey of 42 kilometers begins with a single step（42公里的旅程始于第一步） lace up your running shoes（系好跑鞋） take that step（迈出那一步） I assure you（我向您保证） it will be worth it（它将是值得的）
The journey of 42 kilometers begins with a single step. So lace up your running shoes and take that step. I assure you, it will be worth it. ---

2021 年 — 新旧友谊的黄金价值：Joseph Parry诗歌分析（文学分析）

共22句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q8 Part B Learning English through Poems and Songs
You read this poem in class and your teacher has asked you to write an essay on the theme of friendship. (Poem: 'New Friends and Old Friends' by Joseph Parry, 1841-1903) What is the difference between old and new friendships? Do you agree that older friendships are better than new ones?
1
🇳 友谊是文学中常见的主题，在Joseph Parry的诗《新朋友与老朋友》中得到了优美呈现。
theme commonly explored in literature（文学中常探讨的主题） beautifully presented in（精美呈现在） poem（诗）
Friendship, a theme commonly explored in literature, is beautifully presented in Joseph Parry's poem "New Friends and Old Friends".
2
🇳 Parry将新友谊和旧友谊分别比作银和金，强调各自的独特价值。
compares... to... respectively（将……分别与……比较） emphasizing the unique value of each（强调每个人的独特价值）
Parry compares new and old friendships to silver and gold respectively, emphasizing the unique value of each.
3
🇳 虽然我同意旧友谊在我们心中占有特殊位置，但我也相信新友谊同样丰富，对我们的个人成长至关重要。
although I agree that（尽管我同意） hold a special place in our hearts（在我们心中占有特殊位置） equally enriching（同样丰富的） essential for our personal growth（对我们的个人成长至关重要）
Although I agree that old friendships hold a special place in our hearts, I also believe that new friendships are equally enriching and essential for our personal growth.
4
🇳 这首诗将旧友谊描绘为黄金，象征其持久的价值和珍贵。
characterizes old friendships as gold（将旧友谊比作黄金） symbolizing their enduring value and preciousness（象征它们持久的价值和珍贵）
The poem characterizes old friendships as gold, symbolizing their enduring value and preciousness.
5
🇳 这些友谊经受了时间和变化的考验，变得更强大、更有价值。
have weathered the trials of time and change（经受住了时间和变迁的考验） emerging stronger and more valuable（变得更强大更有价值）
These friendships have weathered the trials of time and change, emerging stronger and more valuable.
6
🇳 老朋友通常深刻理解我们的过去、我们的成长和我们的怪癖，形成难以复制的纽带。
hold a deep understanding of（持有对……的深刻理解） our past, our growth, and our quirks（我们的过去、成长和独特之处） forming a bond that is hard to replicate（形成难以复制的联系）
Old friends often hold a deep understanding of our past, our growth, and our quirks, forming a bond that is hard to replicate.
7
🇳 他们是我们的支柱，在不断变化的世界中提供安慰和熟悉感。
pillars of support（支柱、支持力量） offering comfort and familiarity（提供舒适和熟悉感） in an ever-changing world（在不断变化的世界中）
They are our pillars of support, offering comfort and familiarity in an ever-changing world.
8
🇳 另一方面，新友谊被比作银，暗示其新鲜闪亮的魅力。
on the other hand（另一方面） likened to silver（被比作银） suggesting their fresh and shiny allure（暗示着它们新鲜闪耀的诱惑）
On the other hand, new friendships are likened to silver, suggesting their fresh and shiny allure.
9
🇳 新朋友为我们的生活带来清新空气，介绍新视角、新体验和新文化。
bring a breath of fresh air into our lives（为生活带来清新之风） introducing us to new perspectives, experiences, and cultures（为我们引入新视角、体验和文化）
New friends bring a breath of fresh air into our lives, introducing us to new perspectives, experiences, and cultures.
10
🇳 他们挑战我们的信念，帮助我们走出舒适区，刺激我们的个人成长。
challenge our beliefs（挑战我们的信念） help us step out of our comfort zone（帮助我们走出舒适区） stimulate our personal growth（激励个人成长）
They challenge our beliefs, help us step out of our comfort zone and stimulate our personal growth.
11
🇳 虽然Parry断言"旧的最好"，但我相信友谊的价值——无论新旧——不应被排名，而应因其独特贡献而被欣赏。
while Parry asserts that（虽然Parry主张） I believe（我相信） should not be ranked（不应该被排名） but rather appreciated for（而是被欣赏） unique contributions（独特贡献）
While Parry asserts that 'old is best,' I believe the value of friendships, old or new, should not be ranked but rather appreciated for their unique contributions.
12
🇳 旧友谊有共同历史和深厚情感纽带，提供归属感和稳定感。
with their shared history and deep emotional bond（以他们共同的历史和深厚的情感纽带） provide a sense of belonging and stability（提供归属感和稳定感）
Older friendships, with their shared history and deep emotional bond, provide a sense of belonging and stability.
13
🇳 当我们需要回忆往事或向真正理解我们旅程的人寻求建议时，他们是我们求助的对象。
the ones we turn to when（当……时我们求助的人） need to reminisce（需要回忆） seek advice from someone who truly understands our journey（向真正理解我们旅程的人寻求建议）
They are the ones we turn to when we need to reminisce or seek advice from someone who truly understands our journey.
14
🇳 相反，新友谊刺激个人成长并拓宽我们的视野。
conversely（相反地） stimulate personal growth（激励个人成长） broaden our horizons（拓宽视野）
Conversely, new friendships stimulate personal growth and broaden our horizons.
15
🇳 他们鼓励我们发展、适应并变得更开放。
encourage us to evolve, adapt, and become more open-minded（鼓励我们进化、适应并变得更开放）
They encourage us to evolve, adapt, and become more open-minded.
16
🇳 我们交的每个新朋友都是更好理解周围多元世界的一步。
each new friend we make（我们结识的每个新朋友） a step towards understanding the diverse world around us（朝理解周围多元世界迈出的一步）
Each new friend we make is a step towards understanding the diverse world around us a little better.
17
🇳 因此，我主张新旧友谊都以各自的方式必不可少且有价值。
therefore（因此） I contend that（我主张） both old and new friendships（新旧友谊） essential and valuable in their own ways（各自以不同的方式重要而有价值）
Therefore, I contend that both old and new friendships are essential and valuable in their own ways.
18
🇳 问题不是哪个更好，而是认识到每个带入我们生活的独特价值。
it's not about which is better（不是关于哪个更好） but about recognizing（而是关于认识到） unique value each brings into our lives（各自带给我们生活的独特价值）
It's not about which is better, but about recognizing the unique value each brings into our lives.
19
🇳 正如Parry在诗中暗示的，关键是珍惜两者——交新朋友，不忘老朋友。
as Parry implies in his poem（正如Parry诗中暗示的） the key is to cherish both（关键是珍惜两者） make new friends and keep the old（结交新朋友珍惜老朋友）
As Parry implies in his poem, the key is to cherish both - to make new friends and keep the old.
20
🇳 总之，虽然Parry的诗《新朋友与老朋友》赞扬了旧友谊的持久价值，但它也承认了建立新纽带的重要性。
in conclusion（总之） pays tribute to（向……致敬） enduring value of old friendships（旧友谊的持久价值） acknowledges the importance of（承认……的重要性） forming new bonds（建立新的联系）
In conclusion, while Parry's poem "New Friends and Old Friends" pays tribute to the enduring value of old friendships, it also acknowledges the importance of forming new bonds.
21
🇳 新旧友谊就像金和银，在我们的生活中各有独特价值和光芒。
like gold and silver（如黄金和白银） have their unique value and shine in our lives（各自有独特的价值并在我们生活中闪耀）
Both old and new friendships, like gold and silver, have their unique value and shine in our lives.
22
🇳 通过珍惜两者，我们可以享受丰富的人际关系挂毯，这些关系支持、挑战并丰富我们。
by cherishing both（通过珍惜两者） rich tapestry of relationships（丰富的人际关系画卷） support, challenge, and enrich us（支持、挑战和丰富我们）
By cherishing both, we can enjoy a rich tapestry of relationships that support, challenge, and enrich us. ---

Yearbook entry 毕业纪念册条目（共 1 篇）

2019 年 Part A — 物理学科回顾与班级生活怀念

共11句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q1 Part A Yearbook Entry (1.1: ACADEMIC LIFE)
The Yearbook Committee is putting together a book for all graduating students. The yearbook is a collection of photos and comments about school life, written and submitted by students. When read several years later, the yearbook will remind students of their time at secondary school. You are a student in Class 6C at Kowloon Secondary School. Complete the yearbook entry. (Section 1.1: ACADEMIC LIFE) Write about one subject that you enjoyed studying or found challenging.
1
🇳 在九龙中学的整个时光里，有一门学科始终既挑战我又吸引我，那就是物理。
throughout my time at（在我在……的整段时间里） one subject that consistently challenged me yet intrigued me（一门一直挑战我却令我着迷的科目）
Throughout my time at Kowloon Secondary School, one subject that consistently challenged me yet intrigued me was Physics.
2
🇳 这门学科需要对我们周围世界有深刻理解，常常推动我超越显而易见的事物去思考。
required a profound understanding of（需要对……有深刻理解） pushed me to think beyond the obvious（推动我超越表面思考）
It was a subject that required a profound understanding of the world around us and often pushed me to think beyond the obvious.
3
🇳 我发现电磁学和量子物理等主题特别有挑战性，因为它们引入了日常生活中不易观察到的概念。
found topics like... particularly challenging（发现……等主题特别有挑战性） concepts that were not easily observable in our daily life（日常生活中不易观察的概念）
I found topics like electromagnetism and quantum physics particularly challenging, as they introduced concepts that were not easily observable in our daily life.
4
🇳 然而，这些主题的复杂性和内在奥秘也吸引了我，激发了我的好奇心。
complexity and the inherent mystery（复杂性与固有的神秘感） captivated me（深深吸引了我） fueled my curiosity（激发了我的好奇心）
However, the complexity and the inherent mystery of these topics also captivated me and fueled my curiosity.
5
🇳 我喜欢那些顿悟时刻——经过数小时学习，一个复杂概念终于豁然开朗。
moments of revelation（启示的时刻） a complex concept finally made sense（一个复杂概念终于豁然开朗） after hours of study（数小时学习之后）
I enjoyed the moments of revelation when a complex concept finally made sense after hours of study.
6
🇳 克服这门学科带来的挑战是一段有回报的旅程，教会了我毅力的价值和学习的乐趣。
overcoming the challenges this subject posed（克服这门科目带来的挑战） rewarding journey（收获丰厚的旅程） taught me the value of perseverance（教会了我坚持不懈的价值） joy of learning（学习的乐趣）
Overcoming the challenges this subject posed has been a rewarding journey that has taught me the value of perseverance and the joy of learning.
7
🇳 当我准备告别6C班的学生时光时，我最怀念的将是那种同志情谊和共同经历。
as I prepare to bid farewell to（准备告别……时） what I will miss the most（我最怀念的） sense of camaraderie and shared experiences（友谊和共同体验的感觉）
As I prepare to bid farewell to my time as a student in Class 6C, what I will miss the most is the sense of camaraderie and shared experiences.
8
🇳 从一起攻克艰难作业到在体育比赛中为彼此加油，从课堂讨论中的激烈辩论到闲暇时的共同欢笑，我们建立了超越同学关系的纽带。
from tackling tough assignments together to（从一起应对困难作业到） cheering for each other in sports competitions（在比赛中为彼此加油） heated debates in classroom discussions（课堂讨论中的激烈辩论） built a bond that goes beyond just being classmates（建立超越同学关系的情谊）
From tackling tough assignments together to cheering for each other in sports competitions, from heated debates in classroom discussions to shared laughter in our leisure time, we've built a bond that goes beyond just being classmates.
9
🇳 6C班相互尊重、支持和合作的氛围使我的学校旅程丰富而愉快。
environment of mutual respect, support, and collaboration（相互尊重、支持和协作的环境） made my school journey enriching and enjoyable（让我的学校旅程充实而愉快）
The environment of mutual respect, support, and collaboration in Class 6C has made my school journey enriching and enjoyable.
10
🇳 我会怀念那些热烈的讨论、对突击测验的集体抱怨、对我们成就的共同喜悦，最重要的是，那种归属感。
lively discussions（热烈的讨论） collective groans at surprise tests（突击测验时的集体哀叹） shared joy at our achievements（为我们成就共同欢欣） sense of belonging（归属感）
I will miss the lively discussions, the collective groans at surprise tests, the shared joy at our achievements, and most importantly, the sense of belonging.
11
🇳 当我们踏入人生的下一阶段时，我会深情地怀念并非常想念成为6C班一员的时光。
as we step into the next phase of our lives（步入人生下一阶段时） fondly remember and greatly miss（深情回忆并深深怀念） being a part of（成为……的一部分）
As we step into the next phase of our lives, I will fondly remember and greatly miss being a part of Class 6C. ---

Debate speech 辩论稿（共 1 篇）

2018 年 — 支持废除学生班级排名政策

共26句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q5 Part B Learning English through Debating
You are representing your school at an inter-school debating competition. The motion is: 'The policy of reporting students' class position should be abolished.' Write a debate speech arguing for OR against the motion.
1
🇳 女士们先生们，晚上好。
Ladies and Gentlemen（女士们先生们） Good evening（晚上好）
Ladies and Gentlemen, Good evening.
2
🇳 我今天作为学校代表站在你们面前，支持"废除报告学生班级排名政策"这一动议。
stand before you today as a representative of（今天作为……代表站在你们面前） argue in favor of the motion that（支持……的动议） policy of reporting students' class position should be abolished（报告学生班级排名的政策应该废除）
I stand before you today as a representative of my school, to argue in favor of the motion that "the policy of reporting students' class position should be abolished".
3
🇳 首先，让我们思考教育的目的。
firstly（首先） consider the purpose of education（思考教育的目的）
Firstly, let's consider the purpose of education.
4
🇳 是为了营造一个竞争环境，让学生根据学业成绩被排名和比较吗？
foster a competitive environment（营造竞争环境） ranked and compared based on their academic performance（根据学业表现进行排名和比较）
Is it to foster a competitive environment where students are ranked and compared based on their academic performance?
5
🇳 还是为了灌输对学习的热爱、好奇心、创造力、批判性思维，以及在实际情况中应用知识的能力？
instill a love for learning, curiosity, creativity, critical thinking（培养对学习的热爱、好奇心、创造力和批判性思维） ability to apply knowledge in practical situations（在实际情境中应用知识）
Or is it to instill a love for learning, curiosity, creativity, critical thinking, and the ability to apply knowledge in practical situations?
6
🇳 我相信是后者。
I believe it is the latter（我相信是后者）
I believe it is the latter.
7
🇳 教育的真正目标应该是让学生具备在生活中蓬勃发展所需的技能和知识，而不仅仅是在考试中胜过同龄人。
true aim of education（教育的真正目标） equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge（让学生具备必要的技能和知识） thrive in life（在生活中茁壮成长） outshine their peers in exams（在考试中超过同龄人）
The true aim of education should be to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge they need to thrive in life, and not just to outshine their peers in exams.
8
🇳 报告班级排名的做法助长了学生之间的不健康竞争。
practice of reporting class position（报告班级排名的做法） promotes unhealthy competition among students（在学生中助长不健康的竞争）
The practice of reporting class position promotes unhealthy competition among students.
9
🇳 它创造了一个有害环境，学生被迫相互超越，导致不必要的压力和焦虑。
creates a toxic environment（制造有害的环境） pressured to outperform each other（被迫互相超越） leading to unnecessary stress and anxiety（导致不必要的压力和焦虑）
It creates a toxic environment where students are pressured to outperform each other, leading to unnecessary stress and anxiety.
10
🇳 它还助长了"不惜一切代价取胜"的心态，这可能鼓励作弊等不道德行为。
fosters a "win at all costs" mentality（助长"不惜一切代价求胜"的心态） encourage unethical behavior such as cheating（鼓励不道德行为如作弊）
It also fosters a "win at all costs" mentality, which can encourage unethical behavior such as cheating.
11
🇳 此外，这一政策制造了一种错觉，即学业能力是学生价值和潜力的唯一决定因素。
creates an illusion that（制造一种……的幻觉） academic prowess（学业成绩） sole determinant of a student's worth and potential（学生价值和潜力的唯一决定因素）
Furthermore, this policy creates an illusion that academic prowess is the sole determinant of a student's worth and potential.
12
🇳 这是一个有缺陷且狭隘的观点。
flawed and narrow viewpoint（有缺陷且狭隘的观点）
This is a flawed and narrow viewpoint.
13
🇳 我们都知道，每个学生都是独特的，拥有标准化考试无法衡量的多样才能和能力。
each student is unique（每个学生都是独特的） diverse talents and abilities（多样化的才能和能力） cannot be measured by a standardised exam（无法用标准化考试衡量）
We all know that each student is unique, with diverse talents and abilities that cannot be measured by a standardised exam.
14
🇳 有些学生可能在体育、艺术、领导力或其他非学术领域表现出色。
excel in sports, arts, leadership, or other non-academic areas（在体育、艺术、领导力或其他非学术领域表现出色）
Some students may excel in sports, arts, leadership, or other non-academic areas.
15
🇳 这些才能和能力同样重要，应该被重视和培养。
equally important（同样重要的） valued and nurtured（被重视和培养）
These talents and abilities are equally important and should be valued and nurtured.
16
🇳 此外，报告班级排名的政策可能损害学生的自尊和动力。
harm students' self-esteem and motivation（损害学生的自尊和动力）
In addition, the policy of reporting class position can harm students' self-esteem and motivation.
17
🇳 那些一直发现自己在班级底部的人可能开始认为自己是失败者，对学习失去兴趣。
find themselves at the bottom of the class（发现自己排在班级末尾） see themselves as failures（把自己视为失败者） lose interest in learning（失去学习兴趣）
Those who consistently find themselves at the bottom of the class may begin to see themselves as failures and lose interest in learning.
18
🇳 另一方面，那些总是名列前茅的人可能产生对失败的恐惧，不愿接受新挑战。
at the top（在顶峰） develop a fear of failure（产生对失败的恐惧） reluctant to take on new challenges（不愿接受新挑战）
On the other hand, those who are always at the top may develop a fear of failure and be reluctant to take on new challenges.
19
🇳 最后，这一政策忽略了一个事实：学习不是一场赛跑，而是一段旅程。
overlooks the fact that（忽视了……事实） learning is not a race, but a journey（学习不是一场赛跑而是一段旅程）
Lastly, this policy overlooks the fact that learning is not a race, but a journey.
20
🇳 每个学生以自己的节奏和方式学习。
at their own pace and in their own way（按自己的节奏和方式）
Each student learns at their own pace and in their own way.
21
🇳 通过将学生相互比较，我们忽视了他们各自的学习旅程和独特进步。
by comparing students with one another（通过互相比较学生） disregard their individual learning journeys（忽视他们的个人学习旅程） unique progress（独特的进步）
By comparing students with one another, we disregard their individual learning journeys and unique progress.
22
🇳 总之，报告学生班级排名的政策应该被废除。
in conclusion（总之） should be abolished（应该废除）
In conclusion, the policy of reporting students' class position should be abolished.
23
🇳 它助长不健康竞争，破坏学生全面发展，损害自尊和动力，并忽视每个学生的个人学习旅程。
promotes unhealthy competition（助长不健康的竞争） undermines the holistic development of students（破坏学生的全面发展） harms self-esteem and motivation（损害自尊和动力） overlooks the individual learning journey（忽视了个人的学习旅程）
It promotes unhealthy competition, undermines the holistic development of students, harms self-esteem and motivation, and overlooks the individual learning journey of each student.
24
🇳 让我们将重心从排名和比较转向培养对学习的热爱和鼓励个人成长。
shift our focus from ranking and comparison to（将关注从排名和比较转向） nurturing a love for learning（培养对学习的热爱） encouraging personal growth（鼓励个人成长）
Let us shift our focus from ranking and comparison to nurturing a love for learning and encouraging personal growth.
25
🇳 毕竟，教育应该是赋予学生成为终身学习者的能力，而不仅仅是考试机器。
after all（毕竟） empowering students to become lifelong learners（培养学生成为终身学习者） exam machines（考试机器）
After all, education should be about empowering students to become lifelong learners and not just exam machines.
26
🇳 谢谢。
Thank you（谢谢）
Thank you. ---

Persuasive letter 说服信（共 3 篇）

2021 年 — 建议修改不换货不退款政策（建议型）

共17句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q3 Part B Learning English through Workplace Communication
You work in the sales department at Fast Fashion, an online company that sells clothes. Recently, you have received a number of complaints from customers about the company's no-exchange/no-refund policy. Write an email to the sales manager. Explain why you think this policy should be changed. Suggest what changes could be made. Discuss ways to prevent customers from taking advantage of the new policy.
1
🇳 尊敬的销售经理，希望您一切顺利。
I hope this message finds you well（希望您收到此信息时一切安好）
Dear Sales Manager, I hope this message finds you well.
2
🇳 我写信是想讨论一个最近通过大量客户投诉引起我注意的问题，关于我们的不换货/不退款政策。
I am writing to discuss an issue（我写信讨论一个问题） brought to my attention through numerous customer complaints（通过大量顾客投诉引起我的注意） no-exchange（不换货） no-refund policy（不退款政策）
I am writing to discuss an issue that has recently been brought to my attention through numerous customer complaints regarding our no-exchange/no-refund policy.
3
🇳 由于我们从事在线零售业务，客户在购买前自然没有机会试穿商品。
as we are in the business of online retail（由于我们从事网上零售业务） it is inherent that（固有的……） do not have the opportunity to try on the items before purchasing（购买前没有机会试穿商品）
As we are in the business of online retail, it is inherent that customers do not have the opportunity to try on the items before purchasing.
4
🇳 如果商品不合身或不符合客户期望，这往往导致不满。
if the item does not fit or meet the customers' expectations（如果商品不合身或未达到顾客期望） leads to dissatisfaction（导致不满）
This often leads to dissatisfaction if the item does not fit or meet the customers' expectations.
5
🇳 目前实施的不换货/不退款政策加剧了这一问题，导致客户投诉增加，并可能降低客户忠诚度和回头客。
currently in place（目前实施的） exacerbates this issue（加剧了这个问题） increase in customer complaints（顾客投诉增加） potential decrease in customer loyalty and repeat business（客户忠诚度和回头生意可能下降）
The no-exchange/no-refund policy currently in place exacerbates this issue, leading to an increase in customer complaints and a potential decrease in customer loyalty and repeat business.
6
🇳 虽然该政策可能防止退货损失，但它可能正在造成对我们公司的负面印象，并从长远影响我们的销售。
while it may prevent losses from returns（虽然它可以防止退货损失） creating a negative perception of（制造对……的负面印象） affecting our sales in the long run（长期影响我们的销售）
The policy, while it may prevent losses from returns, could be creating a negative perception of our company and affecting our sales in the long run.
7
🇳 我建议我们修改这一政策，允许在特定条件下换货和退款。
I propose that we revise this policy（我提议修改这项政策） allow for exchanges and refunds under certain conditions（在一定条件下允许退换货）
I propose that we revise this policy to allow for exchanges and refunds under certain conditions.
8
🇳 我们可以引入一个时间框架，客户可以在其中退货，例如购买后30天内。
introduce a time frame（引入时间框架） within which customers can return items（顾客可在其中退货的期限） within 30 days of purchase（购买后30天内）
We could introduce a time frame within which customers can return items, for example, within 30 days of purchase.
9
🇳 商品应保持原始状态，未使用且所有标签齐全，才有资格换货或退款。
in their original condition（保持原始状态） unused and with all tags attached（未使用且标签完好） qualify for an exchange or refund（符合退换货条件）
The items should be in their original condition, unused and with all tags attached, to qualify for an exchange or refund.
10
🇳 为防止客户利用新政策，我们可以实施一些保障措施。
to prevent customers from taking advantage of（防止顾客滥用） implement some safeguards（实施一些保障措施）
To prevent customers from taking advantage of the new policy, we can implement some safeguards.
11
🇳 我们可以要求客户提供退货或换货的正当理由，并提供购买凭证。
require that customers provide a valid reason（要求顾客提供有效理由） proof of purchase（购买凭证）
We could require that customers provide a valid reason for the return or exchange and provide proof of purchase.
12
🇳 我们还可以保留权利，如果商品显示使用迹象，或客户频繁退货，可以拒绝退货或换货。
reserve the right to refuse（保留拒绝的权利） shows signs of use（有使用痕迹） frequently returns items（频繁退货）
We could also reserve the right to refuse a return or exchange if the item shows signs of use, or if the customer frequently returns items.
13
🇳 此外，我们可以使用详细的产品描述、准确的尺码表和高质量照片来尽量减少退货或换货的需要。
in addition（此外） detailed product descriptions（详细的产品描述） accurate sizing charts（准确的尺码表） high-quality photos（高质量照片） minimise the need for（尽量减少对……的需求）
Additionally, we can use detailed product descriptions, accurate sizing charts and high-quality photos to minimise the need for returns or exchanges.
14
🇳 提前提供更多产品信息可以帮助客户做出更明智的决定，减少不满的可能性。
providing more information about the products upfront（在购前提供更多产品信息） make more informed decisions（做出更明智的决定） reduce the likelihood of dissatisfaction（减少不满意的可能性）
Providing more information about the products upfront could help customers make more informed decisions and reduce the likelihood of dissatisfaction.
15
🇳 以这种方式改变政策不仅会提高客户满意度，还会改善我们公司在客户服务方面的声誉。
changing the policy in this way（以这种方式改变政策） not only enhance customer satisfaction（不仅提高顾客满意度） improve our company's reputation for customer service（提升公司客户服务声誉）
Changing the policy in this way will not only enhance customer satisfaction but also improve our company's reputation for customer service.
16
🇳 这将向我们的客户表明我们重视他们的业务，并致力于为他们提供积极的购物体验。
show our customers that we value their business（向顾客展示我们重视他们的光顾） committed to providing them with a positive shopping experience（致力于为他们提供积极的购物体验）
It will show our customers that we value their business and are committed to providing them with a positive shopping experience.
17
🇳 我期待进一步讨论这一提议，并听取您对此事的看法。
look forward to discussing this proposal further（期待进一步讨论这个建议） hearing your thoughts on this matter（听取你对这件事的想法）
I look forward to discussing this proposal further and hearing your thoughts on this matter. ---

Persuasive letter 说服信（共 3 篇）

2020 年 — 提议龙舟赛入奥（提案型）

共19句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2020 Q5 Part B Learning English through Sports Communication
Some people think that the International Olympic Committee (IOC) should include a greater variety of sports in the Olympic Games. However, for a sport to be considered a new Olympic event, it must meet the following criteria: 1) appeal to young people; 2) promote gender equality; 3) attract media coverage. The IOC is inviting the public to suggest sports to be included in future Olympics. You would like to propose Dragon Boat Racing. Write a letter to the President of the IOC. Give reasons to support your opinion.
1
🇳 尊敬的巴赫先生（国际奥委会主席），希望您身体健康。
I hope this letter finds you in good health（希望您收到此信时身体健康）
Dear Mr. Bach, (President, International Olympic Committee) I hope this letter finds you in good health.
2
🇳 我作为一名体育的热情倡导者和奥运会的忠实粉丝给您写信。
as a fervent advocate of sports（作为体育运动热情倡导者） dedicated fan of the Olympic Games（奥运会的忠实粉丝）
I am writing to you as a fervent advocate of sports and a dedicated fan of the Olympic Games.
3
🇳 奥运会所培养的宏伟和团结一直令我着迷，正因如此，我借此机会提议将一项激动人心的运动——龙舟赛——纳入未来奥运会项目。
grandeur and unity that the Olympic Games foster（奥运会所培育的宏伟与团结） taking this opportunity to propose the inclusion of（借此机会提议将……纳入） into the future line-up of（纳入……的未来阵容）
The grandeur and the unity that the Olympic Games foster have always fascinated me, and it is for this reason that I am taking this opportunity to propose the inclusion of an exhilarating sport - Dragon Boat Racing - into the future line-up of the Olympic Games.
4
🇳 龙舟赛是一项古老的运动，起源于2000多年前的中国，此后在全球获得普及。
ancient sport that originated in China more than 2,000 years ago（起源于两千多年前中国的古老运动） gained popularity worldwide（在全球流行起来）
Dragon Boat Racing is an ancient sport that originated in China more than 2,000 years ago and has since gained popularity worldwide.
5
🇳 这项运动结合了团队精神、策略、力量和耐力，体现了奥林匹克主义的真正精神。
combines team spirit, strategy, strength, and endurance（融合团队精神、策略、力量与耐力） encapsulating the true spirit of Olympism（概括了奥林匹克主义的真正精神）
The sport combines team spirit, strategy, strength, and endurance, encapsulating the true spirit of Olympism.
6
🇳 我坚信这项运动符合国际奥委会为新奥运项目设定的所有标准。
firmly believe that（坚定地认为） meets all the criteria set forth by the IOC for a new Olympic event（符合国际奥委会对新奥运项目的所有标准）
I firmly believe that this sport meets all the criteria set forth by the IOC for a new Olympic event.
7
🇳 首先，龙舟赛对年轻人有显著吸引力。
has a significant appeal to young people（对年轻人有显著吸引力）
Firstly, Dragon Boat Racing has a significant appeal to young people.
8
🇳 这项运动需要体力、协调和团队合作——这些都是年轻人渴望发展和展示的品质。
requires physical strength, coordination, and teamwork（需要体力、协调性和团队合作） qualities that young people are eager to develop and showcase（年轻人渴望培养和展示的品质）
The sport requires physical strength, coordination, and teamwork-qualities that young people are eager to develop and showcase.
9
🇳 骑龙舟的刺激、它提供的肾上腺素飙升以及团队合作的乐趣，使其成为一项年轻人会热情参与的激动人心且具挑战性的运动。
thrill of riding a dragon boat（划龙舟的刺激） adrenaline rush it provides（它带来的肾上腺素飙升） pleasure of teamwork（团队合作的乐趣） exciting and challenging sport（激动人心且富有挑战性的运动） enthusiastically engage in（热情地参与）
The thrill of riding a dragon boat, the adrenaline rush it provides, and the pleasure of teamwork, make it an exciting and challenging sport that young people would enthusiastically engage in.
10
🇳 其次，龙舟赛促进性别平等。
promotes gender equality（促进性别平等）
Secondly, Dragon Boat Racing promotes gender equality.
11
🇳 男性和女性都可以平等参与这项运动，大多数赛事都有男子、女子和混合组。
both men and women can participate equally（男女平等参与） categories for men, women, and mixed teams（男子、女子和混合组别）
Both men and women can participate equally in this sport, with most events having categories for men, women, and mixed teams.
12
🇳 这项运动不仅允许平等参与，还颂扬女性的力量和实力，就像对男性一样。
not only allows equal participation（不仅允许平等参与） celebrates the power and strength of women（赞美女性的力量） just as it does for men（就像对男性一样）
This sport not only allows equal participation but also celebrates the power and strength of women, just as it does for men.
13
🇳 第三，龙舟赛有吸引大量媒体报道的潜力。
has the potential to attract significant media coverage（有潜力吸引大量媒体报道）
Thirdly, Dragon Boat Racing has the potential to attract significant media coverage.
14
🇳 这项运动的视觉吸引力、五彩缤纷的船只、有节奏的鼓声和竞争精神使其成为观众的盛宴。
visual appeal（视觉吸引力） colourful boats（色彩缤纷的船只） rhythmic drumming（有节奏的鼓声） spirit of competition（竞争精神） spectator's delight（观众的乐趣）
The sport's visual appeal, the colourful boats, the rhythmic drumming, and the spirit of competition make it a spectator's delight.
15
🇳 这项运动独特的文化方面也为媒体提供了丰富的讲故事机会。
unique cultural aspect（独特的文化面向） rich storytelling opportunity for the media（为媒体提供的丰富叙事机会）
The unique cultural aspect of the sport also provides a rich storytelling opportunity for the media.
16
🇳 除了这些标准，龙舟赛还体现了卓越、友谊和尊重的奥林匹克价值观。
in addition to these criteria（除了这些标准） embodies the Olympic values of excellence, friendship, and respect（体现了卓越、友谊和尊重的奥林匹克价值观）
In addition to these criteria, Dragon Boat Racing embodies the Olympic values of excellence, friendship, and respect.
17
🇳 这项运动要求通过有纪律的训练追求卓越，通过团队合作培养友谊，并教导尊重竞争及其所代表的文化遗产。
demands the pursuit of excellence through disciplined training（要求通过严格训练追求卓越） fosters friendship through teamwork（通过团队合作培养友谊） teaches respect for the competition and the cultural heritage it represents（教导尊重比赛及其代表的文化遗产）
The sport demands the pursuit of excellence through disciplined training, fosters friendship through teamwork, and teaches respect for the competition and the cultural heritage it represents.
18
🇳 鉴于这些要点，我相信将龙舟赛纳入奥运会不仅会丰富体育多样性，还会维护和促进奥运会所代表的价值观。
given these points（鉴于以上几点） I am confident that（我相信） enrich the diversity of sports（丰富体育的多样性） uphold and promote the values that the Olympics stand for（维护和推广奥运会所代表的价值观）
Given these points, I am confident that the inclusion of Dragon Boat Racing in the Olympic Games would not only enrich the diversity of sports but also uphold and promote the values that the Olympics stand for.
19
🇳 感谢您考虑我的提议。我期待看到龙舟赛成为世界上最负盛名的体育赛事——奥运会的一部分。
thank you for considering my proposal（感谢您考虑我的建议） look forward to seeing（期待看到） world's most prestigious sporting event（世界最负盛名的体育赛事）
Thank you for considering my proposal. I look forward to seeing Dragon Boat Racing become a part of the world's most prestigious sporting event - the Olympic Games. ---

Persuasive letter 说服信（共 3 篇）

2022 年 — 支持四天学制（致校长信）

共19句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2022 Q9 Part B Learning English through Debating
The School Management is considering a four-day school week. Students would only need to attend school four days a week instead of five, but the length of each day would be increased by one hour. You are a member of the Parent-Teacher Association (PTA). Write a letter to the President of the PTA stating your opinion either for or against a four-day school week. Give reasons to support your view.
1
🇳 尊敬的校长，希望您一切顺利。
I hope this letter finds you well（希望您收到此信时一切安好）
Dear [President's Name], I hope this letter finds you well.
2
🇳 我作为家长教师协会的一名关切成员写信，就学校管理层正在考虑的拟议四天学制表达我的看法。
as a concerned member of the Parent-Teacher Association（作为家长教师协会关心的一员） express my views on（表达我对……的看法） proposed four-day school week（提议的四天学制） under consideration（考虑中）
I am writing as a concerned member of the Parent-Teacher Association to express my views on the proposed four-day school week currently under consideration by the School Management.
3
🇳 经过仔细思考和考虑，我发现自己支持这一改变。
after careful thought and consideration（经过深思熟虑） in favor of this change（支持这一改变）
After careful thought and consideration, I find myself in favor of this change.
4
🇳 我理解这可能不是普遍受欢迎的观点，但我相信四天学制的好处大于弊端。
this might not be a universally popular opinion（这可能不是一个普遍受欢迎的观点） benefits... outweigh the drawbacks（利大于弊）
I understand that this might not be a universally popular opinion, but I believe that the benefits of a four-day school week outweigh the drawbacks.
5
🇳 首先，四天学制可能提高学生参与度和学业成绩。
improve student engagement and academic performance（提高学生参与度和学业表现）
Firstly, a four-day school week could potentially improve student engagement and academic performance.
6
🇳 大量研究表明，青少年的认知功能在上午晚些时候更好。
numerous studies indicate that（众多研究表明） adolescents' cognitive functioning improves later in the morning（青少年认知功能在上午较晚时更佳）
Numerous studies indicate that adolescents' cognitive functioning improves later in the morning.
7
🇳 通过晚一小时开学，我们将更好地使学校时间表与学生的自然睡眠模式保持一致，这可能导致更高的警觉性和学业成绩。
starting school an hour later（延后一小时上学） aligning the school schedule with students' natural sleep patterns（将校历与学生自然睡眠模式对齐） increased alertness and academic performance（提高的警觉性和学业表现）
By starting school an hour later, we would be better aligning the school schedule with students' natural sleep patterns, which could lead to increased alertness and academic performance.
8
🇳 其次，四天学制可以减少学生的压力和倦怠。
reduce stress and burnout among students（减少学生的压力和倦怠）
Secondly, a four-day school week could reduce stress and burnout among students.
9
🇳 额外的休息日将给学生更多时间休息、追求爱好或参与课外活动。
extra day off（额外一天休息） pursue hobbies（追求爱好） engage in extracurricular activities（参与课外活动）
The extra day off would give students more time to rest, pursue hobbies, or engage in extracurricular activities.
10
🇳 这可能导致心理健康和整体福祉的改善，这对有效学习至关重要。
improved mental health and overall well-being（改善心理健康和整体幸福感） crucial for effective learning（对有效学习至关重要）
This could result in improved mental health and overall well-being, which are crucial for effective learning.
11
🇳 第三，额外的休息日可用于教师发展项目。
additional day off（额外一天假期） teacher development programs（教师发展项目）
Thirdly, the additional day off could be used for teacher development programs.
12
🇳 教师可以利用这段时间进行备课、专业发展或与同事协作学习。
lesson planning（备课） professional development（职业发展） collaborative learning with their peers（与同伴合作学习）
Teachers could use this time for lesson planning, professional development, or collaborative learning with their peers.
13
🇳 这不仅会提高他们的教学技能，还会减少他们在一周其余时间的工作量，从而提高工作满意度和更好的教学成果。
enhance their teaching skills（提升教学技能） reduce their workload（减少工作量） improved job satisfaction（提高的工作满意度） better teaching outcomes（更好的教学效果）
This would not only enhance their teaching skills but also reduce their workload during the rest of the week, leading to improved job satisfaction and better teaching outcomes.
14
🇳 我承认四天学制需要更长的上学日，这对年幼学生可能有挑战。
I acknowledge that（我承认） require a longer school day（需要更长的上课日） challenging for younger students（对低年级学生有挑战）
I acknowledge that a four-day school week would require a longer school day, which might be challenging for younger students.
15
🇳 然而，这个问题可以通过在白天引入更多休息时间和采用各种教学方法来保持学生参与来缓解。
mitigated by introducing more breaks during the day（通过在一天中加入更多休息时间来缓解） incorporating a variety of teaching methods to keep students engaged（融入多种教学方法让学生保持参与）
However, this issue could be mitigated by introducing more breaks during the day and incorporating a variety of teaching methods to keep students engaged.
16
🇳 考虑对可能难以为额外休息日安排托儿的在职父母的潜在影响也很重要。
it's also important to consider（同样重要的是要考虑） potential impact on working parents（对在职父母的潜在影响） struggle to arrange childcare（难以安排托儿）
It's also important to consider the potential impact on working parents who might struggle to arrange childcare for the extra day off.
17
🇳 为解决这一问题，学校可以考虑在第五天提供有监督的学习课程或课外活动。
to address this（为了解决这个问题） offering supervised study sessions or extracurricular activities on the fifth day（在第五天提供监督自习课程或课外活动）
To address this, the school could consider offering supervised study sessions or extracurricular activities on the fifth day.
18
🇳 总之，虽然过渡到四天学制当然需要仔细规划和考虑，但我相信对学生、教师和更广泛学校社区的潜在好处使其成为一个值得探索的提议。
in conclusion（总之） transition to... would require careful planning and consideration（向……过渡需要仔细规划和考虑） potential benefits for... make it a proposal worth exploring（……的潜在好处使其成为值得探索的提议）
In conclusion, while the transition to a four-day school week would certainly require careful planning and consideration, I believe that the potential benefits for students, teachers, and the broader school community make it a proposal worth exploring.
19
🇳 我期待在下次PTA会议上进一步讨论此事。
look forward to discussing this matter further at our next PTA meeting（期待在下次PTA会议上进一步讨论此事）
I look forward to discussing this matter further at our next PTA meeting. ---

2023 年 Part A — Planet Smart公司与环保购物袋介绍

📋 2023 Q1 Part A Pop-up Shop Application Form
You work for Planet Smart, a company that sells eco-friendly products. Your company wants to set up a pop-up shop inside a shopping centre for three months to promote your products to new customers. Complete the application form. A. Company Profile (Introduce your company). B. Best-selling Product (Describe one of your products that customers love).
1
🇳 Planet Smart是一家创新公司，致力于环保产品的推广和零售。
innovative company（创新的公司） committed to（致力于） promotion and retail of eco-friendly products（环保产品的推广和零售）
Planet Smart is an innovative company committed to the promotion and retail of eco-friendly products.
2
🇳 公司成立于2010年，业务由保护地球、为后代保留地球的迫切需要所驱动。
founded in（成立于） driven by the pressing need to（受……的迫切需求驱动） protect and preserve our planet for future generations（为后代保护和维护我们的星球）
Founded in 2010, our business is driven by the pressing need to protect and preserve our planet for future generations.
3
🇳 我们提供各种可持续、高品质产品，从可重复使用购物袋、有机护肤品到节能家电。
offer a wide array of（提供广泛的） sustainable, high-quality products（可持续的高品质产品） ranging from... to...（从……到……不等）
We offer a wide array of sustainable, high-quality products ranging from reusable shopping bags, organic skincare products, to energy-efficient home appliances.
4
🇳 我们的产品经过精心采购，确保对环境影响最小，并促进可持续生活。
carefully sourced（精心采购） minimal environmental impact（最小的环境影响） promote sustainable living（促进可持续生活）
Our products are carefully sourced, ensuring they have minimal environmental impact and promote sustainable living.
5
🇳 作为一家公司，我们相信不仅要销售产品，还要教育客户了解环保的重要性。
believe in not just selling products but also educating our customers about（坚信不仅要销售产品还要教育客户） importance of eco-friendliness（环保的重要性）
As a company, we believe in not just selling products but also educating our customers about the importance of eco-friendliness.
6
🇳 我们还致力于与其他志同道合的企业建立伙伴关系，以创造更大影响。
committed to fostering partnerships with（致力于与……建立合作关系） like-minded businesses（志同道合的企业） create a larger impact（产生更大的影响）
We're also committed to fostering partnerships with other likeminded businesses to create a larger impact.
7
🇳 凭借对使命的坚定承诺，Planet Smart继续成长并扩大影响范围，旨在让可持续生活对所有人来说都触手可及。
with a strong commitment to our mission（对我们的使命抱着坚定承诺） grow and expand our reach（成长并扩大我们的影响力） make sustainable living accessible and convenient for all（让可持续生活方式对所有人都方便可及）
With a strong commitment to our mission, Planet Smart continues to grow and expand its reach, aiming to make sustainable living accessible and convenient for all.
8
🇳 我们即将在本地购物中心开设的快闪店是这一持续举措的一部分，旨在将环保选择带到人们身边。
upcoming pop-up shop（即将到来的快闪店） part of this ongoing initiative（这一持续倡议的一部分） bring eco-friendly options closer to people（让环保选择更贴近大众）
Our upcoming pop-up shop at the local shopping centre is a part of this ongoing initiative to bring eco-friendly options closer to people.
9
🇳 我们的畅销产品是Planet Smart可重复使用购物袋。
best-selling product（畅销产品） reusable shopping bag（可重复使用购物袋）
Our best-selling product is the Planet Smart Reusable Shopping Bag.
10
🇳 这款耐用袋子由100%回收材料制成，以其时尚设计和实用性深受喜爱。
made from 100% recycled materials（由100%回收材料制成） durable bag（耐用袋子） loved for its stylish design and practicality（因其时尚设计且实用而备受喜爱）
Made from 100% recycled materials, this durable bag is loved for its stylish design and practicality.
11
🇳 它轻便但足够结实，可以装下你的杂货，减少对一次性塑料袋的需要。
lightweight, yet strong enough to（轻便却足够坚固） reducing the need for single-use plastic bags（减少对一次性塑料袋的需求）
It's lightweight, yet strong enough to hold your groceries, reducing the need for single-use plastic bags.
12
🇳 紧凑可折叠，非常适合日常使用。
compact and foldable（小巧可折叠） perfect for everyday use（完美适合日常使用）
Compact and foldable, it's perfect for everyday use.
13
🇳 客户对其质量赞不绝口，以及它让他们迈向更可持续生活方式的小小一步。
rave about its quality（对它的质量赞不绝口） small step it allows them to take towards（它让他们能够朝……迈出的一小步） more sustainable lifestyle（更可持续的生活方式）
Customers rave about its quality and the small step it allows them to take towards a more sustainable lifestyle. ---

📋 2022 Q1 Part A Visitor Information Guide
You work at the Visitor Information Centre at Hong Kong Adventure Farm. Use the map and headings below to help you complete a guide for first-time visitors.
1
🇳 欢迎来到香港冒险农场！
welcome to（欢迎来到）
Welcome to Hong Kong Adventure Farm!
2
🇳 从位于入口西南方的主站开始你的旅程。
start your journey at（从……开始你的旅程） located southwest at the entrance（位于入口西南处）
Start your journey at the Main Station, located southwest at the entrance.
3
🇳 跳上我们迷人的小火车，它沿着环绕农场的铁轨行驶。
hop on our charming train（跳上我们迷人的小火车） runs on a railroad around the farm（沿农场周围的铁轨行驶）
Hop on our charming train that runs on a railroad around the farm.
4
🇳 在东南方的农贸市场站享用美食。
enjoy a bite at（在……吃一口） Farmers' Market Station in the southeast（东南部的农夫市场站）
Enjoy a bite at the Farmers' Market Station in the southeast.
5
🇳 向北前往湖畔站，在我们美丽的湖上享受划船。
head north to（向北前往） enjoy boating on our beautiful lake（在我们美丽的湖上泛舟）
Head north to the Lake Side Station and enjoy boating on our beautiful lake.
6
🇳 不要错过西北方的瀑布站，那里有风景优美的步道和完美的拍照机会。
don't miss the Waterfall Station in the northwest（不要错过西北部的瀑布站） scenic walks and perfect photo-ops（风景如画的步道和完美的拍照机会）
Don't miss the Waterfall Station in the northwest for scenic walks and perfect photo-ops.
7
🇳 最后，在你的旅程中探索各种动物。
explore a variety of animals along your journey（沿途探索各种动物）
Lastly, explore a variety of animals along your journey.
8
🇳 享受你的冒险吧！
enjoy your adventure（享受你的冒险）
Enjoy your adventure!
9
🇳 踏上一段难忘的旅程，探索我们农场的多样乐趣。
embark on an unforgettable journey（踏上难忘的旅程） explore the diverse offerings at our farm（探索我们农场的多样化产品）
Embark on an unforgettable journey as you explore the diverse offerings at our farm.
10
🇳 我们的第一站是位于东方的马场。
first stop is（第一站是） horse ranch situated in the east（位于东部的马场）
Our first stop is the horse ranch situated in the east.
11
🇳 在这里，你可以体验骑马的刺激，无论你是经验丰富的骑手还是初学者。
experience the thrill of horseback riding（体验骑马的激动） whether you are a seasoned rider or a beginner（无论你是资深骑手还是初学者）
Here, you can experience the thrill of horseback riding, whether you are a seasoned rider or a beginner.
12
🇳 我们的马训练有素、友好，准备好在广阔的牧场上提供令人振奋的骑行。
well-trained, friendly（训练有素、友善的） ready to provide an exhilarating ride across the expansive ranch（准备带你驰骋辽阔牧场）
Our horses are well-trained, friendly, and ready to provide an exhilarating ride across the expansive ranch.
13
🇳 这是与这些雄伟动物建立联系并欣赏农场壮丽景色的绝佳机会。
excellent opportunity to（绝佳的机会） connect with these majestic creatures（与这些雄伟生物产生共鸣） take in the stunning views（欣赏壮丽景色）
This is an excellent opportunity to connect with these majestic creatures and take in the stunning views of the farm.
14
🇳 接下来，前往位于北方平静宁静的湖泊。
next, head towards（接下来前往） calm and serene lake located in the north（北部宁静祥和的湖泊）
Next, head towards the calm and serene lake located in the north.
15
🇳 湖泊提供了在宁静水面上划船的完美环境。
offers a perfect setting for a relaxing boat ride（提供完美轻松的划船环境） tranquil waters（宁静的水面）
The lake offers a perfect setting for a relaxing boat ride across its tranquil waters.
16
🇳 当你轻轻滑过水面时，享受周围的风景之美。
enjoy the scenic beauty of the surroundings（欣赏周围的美景） gently glide across the water（在水面上轻盈滑行）
Enjoy the scenic beauty of the surroundings as you gently glide across the water.
17
🇳 对冒险者来说，湖边还提供了理想的露营地点。
for adventure seekers（对于冒险爱好者） lakeside also provides an ideal camping spot（湖边也提供理想的露营地点）
For adventure seekers, the lakeside also provides an ideal camping spot.
18
🇳 你可以搭帐篷、生营火，在繁星点点的夜空下享受夜晚，被大自然抚慰的声音催眠。
pitch a tent（搭帐篷） build a campfire（生篝火） enjoy a night under the star-studded sky（在星空下享受夜晚） lulled by the soothing sounds of nature（被大自然舒缓的声音所抚慰）
You can pitch a tent, build a campfire, and enjoy a night under the star-studded sky, lulled by the soothing sounds of nature.
19
🇳 最后，不要错过位于西北方的瀑布站。
finally, don't miss the Waterfall Station located in the northwest（最后，不要错过位于西北部的瀑布站）
Finally, don't miss the Waterfall Station located in the northwest.
20
🇳 被郁郁葱葱的绿色环绕，这个地点非常适合悠闲散步和摄影。
surrounded by lush greenery（四周环绕郁郁葱葱的绿色） perfect for leisurely walks and photography（完美适合悠闲散步和摄影）
Surrounded by lush greenery, this spot is perfect for leisurely walks and photography.
21
🇳 倾泻而下的瀑布为你的照片提供令人惊叹的背景，也是放松和沉浸于自然之美的宁静空间。
cascading waterfall（飞流直下的瀑布） breathtaking backdrop for your photos（为照片提供绝美背景） calm space to unwind and soak in the beauty of nature（放松沉浸于自然美景）
The cascading waterfall offers a breathtaking backdrop for your photos and a calm space to unwind and soak in the beauty of nature.
22
🇳 这些多样的活动为每个人提供了一些东西，确保你的农场之旅充满冒险。
these diverse activities offer something for everyone（这些多样化的活动让每个人都能找到乐趣） ensuring an adventure-filled visit（确保一次充满冒险的访问）
These diverse activities offer something for everyone, ensuring an adventure-filled visit to our farm. ---
