2019 年 — 《非凡公主》中灰姑娘的大胆重塑（影评）

共20句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q6 Part B Learning English through Drama
You are a reporter for the entertainment section of the Young Post. You have been asked to review a new film called Cinderella which is based on the comic series Princesses of Power. Write a review of the film. Include a brief description of the plot, how the characters are portrayed in this new version of Cinderella and why the director wanted to make this film. Give your review a title.
1
🇳 在一个充满改编和重述的世界里，新片《灰姑娘》基于漫画系列《非凡公主》，提供了对经典童话的清新、大胆重新诠释。
in a world teeming with adaptations and retellings（在一个充满改编和重述的世界里） offers a refreshing, bold reinterpretation of（提供了对……新鲜大胆的重新诠释） classic fairy tale（经典童话）
In a world teeming with adaptations and retellings, the new film "Cinderella," based on the comic series "Princesses of Power," offers a refreshing, bold reinterpretation of the classic fairy tale.
2
🇳 导演Jane Smith进入公主和魔法世界的冒险重塑了灰姑娘的故事，提供了冒险、赋权和魔法的独特融合，使其区别于前作。
venture into the world of（进入……的世界） reimagines Cinderella's story（重新构想灰姑娘的故事） unique blend of adventure, empowerment, and magic（冒险、赋权和魔法的独特混合） distinguishes it from its predecessors（将其与前作区分开来）
Director Jane Smith's venture into the world of princesses and magic reimagines Cinderella's story, providing a unique blend of adventure, empowerment, and magic that distinguishes it from its predecessors.
3
🇳 情节带我们走过熟悉的叙事，但有一个令人兴奋的转折。
takes us through a familiar narrative（带我们经历一个熟悉的故事） with an exciting twist（带着一个激动人心的转折）
The plot takes us through a familiar narrative but with an exciting twist.
4
🇳 灰姑娘，或电影中被称为"Cindy"，不再是等待王子拯救的落难少女。
no longer the damsel in distress（不再是落难少女） waiting for her prince to rescue her（等待王子来救她）
Cinderella, or 'Cindy' as she is known in the film, is no longer the damsel in distress waiting for her prince to rescue her.
5
🇳 相反，她是一个无畏、独立的年轻女性，秘密训练成为战士。
fearless, independent young woman（无所畏惧、独立的年轻女性） training in secret to become a warrior（秘密训练成为一名战士）
Instead, she's a fearless, independent young woman, training in secret to become a warrior.
6
🇳 当她的王国受到黑暗势力威胁时，是Cindy挺身而出，带头夺回她的家园。
when her kingdom is threatened by dark forces（当她的王国受到黑暗势力威胁时） steps up（挺身而出） leading the charge to reclaim her home（带头夺回家园）
When her kingdom is threatened by dark forces, it's Cindy who steps up, leading the charge to reclaim her home.
7
🇳 这个新版本灰姑娘中角色的塑造确实令人耳目一新。
portrayal of the characters（角色的刻画） breath of fresh air（一股清新之风）
The portrayal of the characters in this new version of Cinderella is indeed a breath of fresh air.
8
🇳 由新星Ava Johnson扮演的主角凶猛而坚定，打破了传统、顺从的灰姑娘形象。
played by rising star（由新星饰演） fierce and determined（凶猛而坚定） breaking away from the traditional, submissive representation（摆脱传统顺从的表现方式）
The titular character, played by rising star Ava Johnson, is fierce and determined, breaking away from the traditional, submissive representation of Cinderella.
9
🇳 她聪明、足智多谋，毫不掩饰地做自己。
smart, resourceful, and unapologetically herself（聪明、机智且毫不掩饰地做自己）
She's smart, resourceful, and unapologetically herself.
10
🇳 配角也很丰满和动态，每个都有自己的故事线，为电影丰富的叙事挂毯做出贡献。
supporting characters（配角） well-rounded and dynamic（全面而动态的） each with their own story arc（各有自己的故事弧线） contributes to the film's rich narrative tapestry（为电影丰富的叙事画卷做出了贡献）
The supporting characters, too, are well-rounded and dynamic, each with their own story arc that contributes to the film's rich narrative tapestry.
11
🇳 导演Jane Smith对这部电影的愿景是为现代观众重塑经典故事。
vision for this film（这部电影的愿景） reinvent the classic tale for the modern audience（为现代观众重新演绎经典故事）
Director Jane Smith's vision for this film was to reinvent the classic tale for the modern audience.
12
🇳 在一次采访中，她解释说："我想拍一部灰姑娘拯救自己的电影。我想让小女孩看到她们不需要王子来拯救她们；她们可以成为自己的英雄。"
in an interview（在一次采访中） I wanted to make a film where Cinderella saves herself（想拍一部灰姑娘自救的电影） they don't need a prince to rescue them（他们不需要王子来拯救） they can be their own heroes（他们可以做自己的英雄）
In an interview, she explained, "I wanted to make a film where Cinderella saves herself. I wanted young girls to see that they don't need a prince to rescue them; they can be their own heroes."
13
🇳 这一信息通过电影强大的故事情节和有力的角色发展得到有力传达。
this message is potently delivered through（这一信息通过……有力地传达） powerful storyline and strong character development（强大的故事情节和深厚的角色发展）
This message is potently delivered through the film's powerful storyline and strong character development.
14
🇳 《灰姑娘》不仅仅是一部电影；它是一场挑战传统性别角色和刻板印象的运动。
not just a film（不仅仅是一部电影） a movement that challenges traditional gender roles and stereotypes（一场挑战传统性别角色和刻板印象的运动）
"Cinderella" is not just a film; it's a movement that challenges traditional gender roles and stereotypes.
15
🇳 它是自立和赋权的集结号，包裹在精心制作的电影包装中。
rallying cry for self-reliance and empowerment（自力更生和赋权的战斗口号） wrapped in a beautifully-crafted cinematic package（包装在精心打造的电影外壳中）
It's a rallying cry for self-reliance and empowerment, wrapped in a beautifully-crafted cinematic package.
16
🇳 电影令人惊叹的视觉效果，加上引人入胜的情节和令人信服的表演，使其成为必看之作。
stunning visuals（惊艳的视觉效果） coupled with an engaging plot and compelling performances（加上引人入胜的情节和令人信服的表演） make it a must-watch（让它成为必看之作）
The film's stunning visuals, coupled with an engaging plot and compelling performances, make it a must-watch.
17
🇳 总之，基于《非凡公主》漫画系列的《灰姑娘》是对心爱经典的胜利重塑。
in conclusion（总之） triumphant reimagining of a beloved classic（对经典之作的胜利性重塑）
In conclusion, "Cinderella" based on the "Princesses of Power" comic series is a triumphant reimagining of a beloved classic.
18
🇳 这是一部既赋权又娱乐的电影，为公主成为自己英雄的新时代童话铺平了道路。
empowers as much as it entertains（既娱乐又赋权） paving the way for a new era of fairy tales（为童话的新时代铺路） princesses are their own heroes（公主是自己的英雄）
It's a film that empowers as much as it entertains, paving the way for a new era of fairy tales where princesses are their own heroes.
19
🇳 这个灰姑娘不仅仅是穿上玻璃鞋；她打碎了玻璃天花板。
doesn't just fit into the glass slipper（不仅仅适合那只水晶鞋） shatters the glass ceiling（打破玻璃天花板）
This Cinderella doesn't just fit into the glass slipper; she shatters the glass ceiling.
20
🇳 这部电影有力地证明了公主可以很强大，童话可以是革命性的。
powerful testament to the fact that（有力地证明了） princesses can be powerful（公主可以很强大） fairy tales can be revolutionary（童话可以是革命性的）
This film is a powerful testament to the fact that princesses can be powerful, and fairy tales can be revolutionary. ---

2020 年 Part A — Dim Sum One餐厅测评

共13句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2020 Q1 Part A Restaurant Review (Eat & Drink)
You finally got the chance to eat at Hong Kong's hottest new restaurant, Dim Sum One. Write a review for Eat & Drink, an online food guide that allows users to write their own reviews. Write about what you liked, what you didn't like and if you would recommend this restaurant. You can choose to write about any of the following in your review: Food / Service / Dining environment / Price.
1
🇳 Dim Sum One是香港市中心最新的烹饪热点，对美食爱好者来说绝对是一种享受。
latest culinary sensation（最新的美食风潮） in the heart of Hong Kong（在香港的中心） absolute delight for food enthusiasts（美食爱好者的极致享受）
Dim Sum One, the latest culinary sensation in the heart of Hong Kong, is an absolute delight for food enthusiasts.
2
🇳 它绝对不负众望，在城市繁忙的美食场景中占据了一席之地。
lives up to the hype（名副其实） marking its territory in the city's bustling food scene（在城市繁忙的美食版图中占据一席之地）
It definitely lives up to the hype, marking its territory in the city's bustling food scene.
3
🇳 餐厅提供各种简直出色的点心。
offers a variety of dim sum that is simply outstanding（提供种类繁多简直绝妙的点心）
The restaurant offers a variety of dim sum that is simply outstanding.
4
🇳 虾饺饱满新鲜，充满味道。
Har Gau, shrimp dumplings（虾饺） plump and fresh（饱满新鲜） bursting with flavor（味道浓郁）
The Har Gau, shrimp dumplings, were plump and fresh, bursting with flavor.
5
🇳 烧卖调味恰到好处，咸甜平衡。
Siu Mai, pork and shrimp dumplings（烧卖） seasoned to perfection（调味得恰到好处） well-balanced blend of savory and sweet（咸甜均衡的搭配）
The Siu Mai, pork and shrimp dumplings, were seasoned to perfection, a well-balanced blend of savory and sweet.
6
🇳 个人最喜欢的萝卜糕外脆内软，口感精妙。
Fried Turnip Cake, a personal favorite（萝卜糕，个人最爱） crispy on the outside and soft on the inside（外脆内软） exquisite play of textures（质感上的精美演绎）
The Fried Turnip Cake, a personal favorite, was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, an exquisite play of textures.
7
🇳 然而，叉烧包有点令人失望，因为对我来说馅料太甜了。
Char Siu Bao, roast pork bun（叉烧包） slightly disappointing（略令人失望） filling was a bit too sweet for my liking（馅料对我来说有点太甜了）
However, the Char Siu Bao, roast pork bun, was slightly disappointing as the filling was a bit too sweet for my liking.
8
🇳 Dim Sum One的服务值得称赞，员工礼貌周到，乐于助人。
service was commendable（服务值得赞扬） polite and attentive staff（礼貌周到的员工） quick to help（乐于帮忙）
The service at Dim Sum One was commendable, with polite and attentive staff who were quick to help.
9
🇳 用餐环境优雅干净，提升了整体用餐体验。
dining environment was elegant and clean（用餐环境优雅干净） enhancing the overall dining experience（提升整体用餐体验）
The dining environment was elegant and clean, enhancing the overall dining experience.
10
🇳 一个缺点是价格。
one downside is the price（一个缺点就是价格）
One downside is the price.
11
🇳 食物虽然美味，但与其他本地点心店相比有点贵。
while delicious（虽然好吃） a bit expensive compared to other local dim sum spots（相比其他本地点心店稍贵）
The food, while delicious, is a bit expensive compared to other local dim sum spots.
12
🇳 尽管价格略高，我还是强烈推荐Dim Sum One。
despite the slightly steep pricing（尽管价格略高） highly recommend（强烈推荐）
Despite the slightly steep pricing, I would highly recommend Dim Sum One.
13
🇳 食物的质量和种类，加上出色的服务和氛围，使其成为任何在香港寻求正宗高端点心体验的人的必访之地。
quality and variety of the food（食物的品质和种类） coupled with excellent service and ambiance（加上卓越的服务和氛围） must-visit for anyone seeking（对任何寻求……的人来说是必去之地） authentic and high-end dim sum experience（正宗高端点心体验）
The quality and variety of the food, coupled with the excellent service and ambiance, makes it a must-visit for anyone seeking an authentic and high-end dim sum experience in Hong Kong. ---

1. 2019 年 — 批评的艺术：在艺术俱乐部培养建设性反馈 2. 2021 年 Part A — 学校义卖会通知演讲 3. 2022 年 — 赛季结束队长演讲（第二名）

Speech 演讲稿（共 3 篇）

2019 年 — 批评的艺术：在艺术俱乐部培养建设性反馈

共29句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q7 Part B Learning English through Poems and Songs
Taylor Swift is an award-winning singer-songwriter. In an interview with Parade magazine she said: 'I wrote the song Mean about a critic who kept giving me really bad reviews. I get that, no matter what, people will criticise what you do. But there are different ways to criticise someone... and there's a line that you cross when you just start to attack everything about a person.' You lead an after-school arts club. You would like to instruct members on how to review each other's work. Write a speech to be delivered to club members. Discuss what a critic does, how to give criticism and ways to respond to criticism. Give your speech a title.
1
🇳 大家好。
Hello everyone（大家好）
Hello everyone,
2
🇳 作为课后艺术俱乐部的领导者和参与者，我们都是以自己方式的创作者，无论是通过绘画、写作还是音乐。
as leaders and participants in our after-school arts club（作为课后艺术俱乐部的领导者和参与者） creators in our own right（我们自身的创作者） be it through painting, writing, or music（无论是绘画写作还是音乐）
As leaders and participants in our after-school arts club, we are all creators in our own right, be it through painting, writing, or music.
3
🇳 今天，我想谈谈我们创作旅程中经常忽视的一个方面——批评的艺术。
address an aspect of our creative journey（探讨创作旅程的一个方面） we often overlook（我们常常忽视） the art of critique（critique的art）
Today, I would like to address an aspect of our creative journey that we often overlook - the art of critique.
4
🇳 本质上，批评家不是只指出缺陷或不足的人。
in essence（本质上） not someone who merely points out flaws or shortcomings（不是仅仅指出缺点或不足的人）
A critic, in essence, is not someone who merely points out flaws or shortcomings.
5
🇳 相反，批评家是敏锐的观察者，提供可以帮助艺术家成长的建设性反馈。
rather（更确切地说） keen observer（敏锐的观察者） provides constructive feedback（提供建设性反馈） help an artist grow（帮助艺术家成长）
Rather, a critic is a keen observer who provides constructive feedback that can help an artist grow.
6
🇳 记住，批评的目标不是拆台，而是建设。
remember（记住） goal of criticism is not to tear down, but to build up（批评的目标不是摧毁而是建设）
Remember, the goal of criticism is not to tear down, but to build up.
7
🇳 做得好时，批评可以是改进的有力工具。
when done right（做得对的时候） powerful tool for improvement（改进的强大工具）
When done right, criticism can be a powerful tool for improvement.
8
🇳 那么，我们如何给予批评？这里有几个准则。
so, how do we give criticism?（那么我们如何提出批评？） here are a few guidelines（以下是一些指导原则）
So, how do we give criticism? Here are a few guidelines.
9
🇳 首先，总是从积极的开始。
firstly（首先） always start with a positive（总是以积极开头）
Firstly, always start with a positive.
10
🇳 突出你喜欢或欣赏作品的地方。
highlight what you enjoyed or appreciated about the work（突出你喜欢或欣赏作品的哪些方面）
Highlight what you enjoyed or appreciated about the work.
11
🇳 这设定了积极的基调，显示对艺术家努力的尊重。
sets a positive tone（定下积极的基调） shows respect for the artist's efforts（表现出对艺术家努力的尊重）
This sets a positive tone and shows respect for the artist's efforts.
12
🇳 例如，你可以说："我喜欢你画中鲜艳的颜色，它们真的吸引了我。"
for example（例如） vibrant colors in your painting（画中鲜艳的色彩） they really drew me in（它们真的吸引了我）
For example, you could say, "I loved the vibrant colors in your painting, they really drew me in."
13
🇳 其次，指出改进空间时，要具体并提供建议。
secondly（其次） when pointing out areas for improvement（指出需要改进的地方时） be specific and offer suggestions（具体明确并提供建议）
Secondly, when pointing out areas for improvement, be specific and offer suggestions.
14
🇳 不要说"我不喜欢你的故事"，你可以说："你故事的情节对我来说有点混乱。也许你可以加更多细节来澄清？"
instead of saying（与其说） the plot of your story was a bit confusing to me（your story was a bit confusing to me的plot） perhaps you could add more details to clarify（也许你可以添加更多细节来阐明）
Instead of saying, "I didn't like your story," you could say, "The plot of your story was a bit confusing to me. Perhaps you could add more details to clarify?"
15
🇳 第三，使用"我"陈述来表达你的意见。
thirdly（第三） use "I" statements to express your opinions（用「我」开头的句子表达观点）
Thirdly, use "I" statements to express your opinions.
16
🇳 这有助于避免听起来指责或针对个人。
helps to avoid sounding accusatory or personal（有助于避免听起来像指责或针对个人）
This helps to avoid sounding accusatory or personal.
17
🇳 例如，说"我觉得角色的动机不清楚"，而不是"你没有把角色的动机写清楚"。
for instance（例如） I felt that the character's motivations weren't clear（角色动机不够清晰） instead of（而不是） you didn't make the character's motivations clear（角色动机交代得不够清楚）
For instance, say, "I felt that the character's motivations weren't clear," instead of, "You didn't make the character's motivations clear."
18
🇳 现在，让我们谈谈接受批评。
now, let's talk about receiving criticism（现在我们来谈谈接受批评）
Now, let's talk about receiving criticism.
19
🇳 当我们的作品被批评时，感到防御或受伤是正常的。
it's normal to feel defensive or hurt（感到防御或受伤是正常的） when our work is criticised（当我们的作品被批评时）
It's normal to feel defensive or hurt when our work is criticised.
20
🇳 然而，必须记住批评不是关于你这个人，而是关于你的作品。
however, it's essential to remember（然而重要的是记住） criticism is not about you as a person, but about your work（批评针对的是你的作品而不是你这个人）
However, it's essential to remember that criticism is not about you as a person, but about your work.
21
🇳 这是对特定作品的批评，不是对你整体才能或潜力的评价。
critique of a particular piece（对特定作品的评论） not of your overall talent or potential（不是你整体才华或潜力的评价）
It's a critique of a particular piece, not of your overall talent or potential.
22
🇳 总是以开放的心态倾听，并感谢对方的反馈。
always listen with an open mind（始终以开放心态倾听） thank the person for their feedback（感谢对方给予反馈）
Always listen with an open mind, and thank the person for their feedback.
23
🇳 你不必同意他们说的一切，但一定要考虑他们的观点。
you don't have to agree with everything they say（你不必同意他们说的每句话） do consider their perspective（一定要考虑他们的角度）
You don't have to agree with everything they say, but do consider their perspective.
24
🇳 如果批评苛刻或针对个人，你可以表达你感到受伤并要求更建设性的反馈。
if the criticism is harsh or personal（如果批评严厉或针对个人） it's okay to express that you felt hurt（表达你感到受伤是可以的） request for more constructive feedback（要求更多建设性反馈）
If the criticism is harsh or personal, it's okay to express that you felt hurt and request for more constructive feedback.
25
🇳 记住，正如Taylor Swift所说，人们总是会批评你做的事。
remember, as Taylor Swift said（记住，正如Taylor Swift所说） people will always criticise what you do（人们总会批评你所做的事）
Remember, as Taylor Swift said, people will always criticise what you do.
26
🇳 但正是我们给予和接受批评的方式，可以塑造我们作为艺术家。
but it's how we give and receive that criticism（而是我们如何给予和接受批评） can shape us as artists（塑造我们的艺术人格）
But it's how we give and receive that criticism that can shape us as artists.
27
🇳 当我们继续创作时，让我们在俱乐部培养尊重、开放和建设性批评的环境。
as we continue to create（在我们继续创作之际） let's foster an environment of respect, openness, and constructive critique in our club（让我们在俱乐部营造尊重、开放和建设性批评的环境）
As we continue to create, let's foster an environment of respect, openness, and constructive critique in our club.
28
🇳 让我们把批评不是作为武器，而是作为成长和改进的工具。
let's use criticism not as a weapon, but as a tool for growth and improvement（让我们把批评当作成长和改进的工具而非武器）
Let's use criticism not as a weapon, but as a tool for growth and improvement.
29
🇳 谢谢。
Thank you（谢谢）
Thank you. ---

Speech 演讲稿（共 3 篇）

2021 年 Part A — 学校义卖会通知演讲

共16句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q1 Part A School Fair Announcement
You are helping your school organise the annual school fair. You have been asked to make an announcement about the event during the morning assembly. Use the poster below to help you write your announcement. In your announcement: Introduce the event. Describe some of the activities that will take place. Let students know how they can help out.
1
🇳 大家早上好。
Good morning everyone（大家早上好）
Good morning everyone,
2
🇳 我很兴奋地宣布年度学校义卖会将于2021年5月29日星期六中午12点到下午4点举行。
excited to announce（激动地宣布） annual school fair（年度学校义卖会） taking place on（于……举行）
I am excited to announce the annual school fair taking place on Saturday, 29th May 2021, from 12pm to 4pm.
3
🇳 这个充满乐趣和友谊的活动是我们校历上的亮点。
filled with fun and camaraderie（充满乐趣和友谊） highlight of our school calendar（学校日程的亮点）
This event, filled with fun and camaraderie, is the highlight of our school calendar.
4
🇳 我们计划了多种多样的活动。
planned a diverse range of activities（策划了多样化的活动）
We've planned a diverse range of activities.
5
🇳 你们中好胜的可以期待套袋赛跑和拔河等游戏。
the competitive among you（你们中的竞技爱好者） look forward to games like the sack race and tug of war（期待麻袋赛跑和拔河等游戏）
The competitive among you can look forward to games like the sack race and tug of war.
6
🇳 艺术比赛和烘焙义卖将为我们有创意和烹饪天赋的同学提供发光的平台。
art competition and bake sale（艺术比赛与烘焙义卖） provide a platform for our creative and culinary enthusiasts to shine（为我们的创意和烹饪爱好者提供闪耀平台）
The art competition and bake sale will provide a platform for our creative and culinary enthusiasts to shine.
7
🇳 将有各种摊位出售从书籍到手工艺品、食物到植物的物品。
various stalls selling items from books to handmade crafts, food to plants（售卖从书籍到手工艺品、从食品到植物的各种摊位）
There will be various stalls selling items from books to handmade crafts, food to plants.
8
🇳 文化表演将为活动增添活力，展示我们学校社区的多样性。
cultural performances（文化表演） add vibrancy to the event（为活动增添活力） showcasing the diversity of our school community（展示学校社群的多样性）
Cultural performances will add vibrancy to the event, showcasing the diversity of our school community.
9
🇳 活动门票定价10元，下周起有售。
tickets for the event are priced at $10（活动门票定价为10美元） available from next week（下周起可购）
Tickets for the event are priced at $10 and will be available from next week.
10
🇳 记住，买票不仅确保你的入场，也为活动的成功做出贡献。
remember（记住） buying a ticket not only ensures your entry（买票不仅确保入场） contributes to the event's success（为活动的成功做出贡献）
Remember, buying a ticket not only ensures your entry but also contributes to the event's success.
11
🇳 我们还在寻找志愿者帮助组织活动。
seeking volunteers to help organise the event（招募志愿者协助组织活动）
We are also seeking volunteers to help organise the event.
12
🇳 这是发展你领导和组织能力的绝佳机会。
great opportunity to develop your leadership and organisational skills（发展领导力和组织能力的好机会）
This is a great opportunity to develop your leadership and organisational skills.
13
🇳 如果有兴趣，下周末前到学校办公室报名。
if interested（如果有兴趣） sign up at the school office by the end of next week（在下周末前到学校办公室报名）
If interested, sign up at the school office by the end of next week.
14
🇳 我们的年度学校义卖会是关于庆祝我们的社区、展示我们的才能和加强我们的学校精神。
about celebrating our community（关于庆祝我们的社群） showcasing our talents（展示我们的才华） strengthening our school spirit（增强学校精神）
Our annual school fair is about celebrating our community, showcasing our talents, and strengthening our school spirit.
15
🇳 让我们一起努力，使这次活动成为最好的一次！
let's come together to make this event the best one yet（让我们齐心协力让这次活动成为迄今为止最棒的）
Let's come together to make this event the best one yet!
16
🇳 谢谢，义卖会见！
thank you and see you at the fair（谢谢大家义卖会见）
Thank you and see you at the fair! ---

Speech 演讲稿（共 3 篇）

2022 年 — 赛季结束队长演讲（第二名）

共24句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2022 Q4 Part B Learning English through Sports Communication
You are the captain of the school's basketball team. Your team made it to the inter-school championship final but came second. Write a speech to be delivered to the team at the end-of-season dinner celebration.
1
🇳 女士们先生们。
Ladies and Gentlemen（女士们先生们）
Ladies and Gentlemen,
2
🇳 今晚，当我们聚在一起庆祝一个难忘赛季的结束时，我站在你们面前不是带着沉重的心情，而是带着巨大的自豪和感激。
as we gather to celebrate the end of（齐聚庆祝……结束时） unforgettable season（难忘的赛季） not with a heavy heart, but with immense pride and gratitude（不是怀着沉重的心情而是怀着无比自豪和感激）
Tonight, as we gather to celebrate the end of what has been an unforgettable season, I stand before you not with a heavy heart, but with immense pride and gratitude.
3
🇳 记分牌可能没有反映我们在校际冠军决赛中期望的结果，但它没有也不能反映这支球队整个赛季所展示的坚韧、精神和韧性。
scoreboard may not have reflected the outcome we desired（记分牌可能没有反映我们想要的结果） inter-school championship final（校际冠军赛决赛） does not and cannot reflect（无法也不能反映） tenacity, spirit, and resilience（坚韧、精神和韧性） shown throughout the season（整个赛季中展现的）
The scoreboard may not have reflected the outcome we desired at the inter-school championship final, but it does not and cannot reflect the tenacity, spirit, and resilience this team has shown throughout the season.
4
🇳 第二名不是失败，而是我们战斗精神的证明。
coming second is not a defeat（第二名不是失败） testament to our fighting spirit（我们战斗精神的证明）
Coming second is not a defeat but a testament to our fighting spirit.
5
🇳 记住，这不总是关于赢，而是关于我们如何比赛，我们已经全心全意地比赛了。
remember（记住） it's not always about winning, but about how we play the game（不总是关于赢而是关于我们如何比赛） played with all our hearts（倾尽全力去比赛）
Remember, it's not always about winning, but about how we play the game, and we have played with all our hearts.
6
🇳 那才是真正重要的。
that's what truly counts（那才是真正重要的）
That's what truly counts.
7
🇳 我们向所有人展示了我们的实力，赢得了对手的尊重，作为一个团队变得更强大。
shown everyone what we are made of（向所有人展示了我们的实力） earned the respect of our opponents（赢得了对手的尊重） grown stronger as a team（作为团队变得更强）
We have shown everyone what we are made of, we have earned the respect of our opponents, and we have grown stronger as a team.
8
🇳 这个赛季是一段充满高潮和低谷、胜利和失败、欢笑和泪水的旅程，但通过这一切，我们保持团结。
journey filled with highs and lows, victories and losses, laughter and tears（充满高峰低谷、胜利失利、欢笑和泪水的旅程） through it all（经历了这一切） remained united（保持团结）
This season has been a journey filled with highs and lows, victories and losses, laughter and tears, but through it all, we remained united.
9
🇳 我们互相鼓励，互相扶持，一起战斗每一场战役。
cheered each other on（互相加油） picked each other up（互相扶持） fought every battle together（并肩作战了每一场）
We cheered each other on, picked each other up, and fought every battle together.
10
🇳 我非常自豪能成为这个团队的一员，我想感谢你们每一个人坚定不移的承诺、努力和奉献。
incredibly proud to be a part of this team（无比自豪成为这个团队的一员） thank each one of you for（感谢你们每一个人） unwavering commitment, hard work, and dedication（坚定的承诺、努力和投入）
I am incredibly proud to be a part of this team, and I want to thank each one of you for your unwavering commitment, hard work, and dedication.
11
🇳 让我们不要忘记我们的教练，他们的指导、鼓励和对我们的信念从未动摇。
let us not forget our coaches（让我们不要忘记教练们） whose guidance, encouragement, and faith in us never wavered（他们的指导、鼓励和对我们的信念从未动摇）
Let us not forget our coaches, whose guidance, encouragement, and faith in us never wavered.
12
🇳 他们推动我们成为更好的球员，帮助我们达到我们从未想过可能的高度。
pushed us to become better players（推动我们成为更好的球员） helped us reach heights we never thought possible（帮我们达到了从未想过可能的高度）
They pushed us to become better players and helped us reach heights we never thought possible.
13
🇳 他们宝贵的教训超越了球场，教会我们纪律、团队合作和体育精神的重要性。
invaluable lessons extended beyond the court（宝贵的教训超越了球场） teaching us the importance of discipline, teamwork, and sportsmanship（教我们纪律、团队合作和体育精神的重要性）
Their invaluable lessons extended beyond the court, teaching us the importance of discipline, teamwork, and sportsmanship.
14
🇳 当我们回顾我们的旅程时，让我们记住定义我们的时刻。
as we reflect on our journey（回顾我们的旅程时） remember the moments that defined us（记住那些定义了我们的时刻）
As we reflect on our journey, let's remember the moments that defined us.
15
🇳 最后一刻的胜利、压哨球、支持者为我们加油的声音——这些是带我们走到今天的时刻，是我们余生将携带的时刻。
last-minute victories（最后一刻的胜利） buzzer-beaters（压哨绝杀） sound of our supporters cheering us on（支持者为我们加油的声音） moments that brought us here today（把我们带到今天的那些时刻） carry with us for the rest of our lives（伴随余生）
The last-minute victories, the buzzer-beaters, the sound of our supporters cheering us on - these are the moments that brought us here today, the moments we will carry with us for the rest of our lives.
16
🇳 校际锦标赛获得第二名不是终点，而是起点。
coming second in the inter-school championship（在校际比赛中获得第二） not an end, but a beginning（不是结束而是开始）
Coming second in the inter-school championship is not an end, but a beginning.
17
🇳 这是通往更伟大事物的垫脚石。
stepping stone towards greater things（通往更大成就的垫脚石）
It's a stepping stone towards greater things.
18
🇳 这提醒我们有潜力实现伟大。
reminder that we have the potential to achieve greatness（提醒我们有潜力成就伟大）
It's a reminder that we have the potential to achieve greatness.
19
🇳 我们必须用这次经历作为动力，下赛季更强大、更坚定、更团结地回来。
use this experience as motivation（把这次经历当作动力） come back next season stronger, more determined, and more united than ever（下赛季更强更坚定更团结地回归）
We must use this experience as motivation to come back next season stronger, more determined, and more united than ever.
20
🇳 对我的团队，你们不仅仅是队友；你们是家人。
to my team（致我的团队） you are more than just teammates; you are family（你们不仅是队友更是家人）
To my team, you are more than just teammates; you are family.
21
🇳 我为你们每一个人感到骄傲，我很荣幸成为你们的队长。
proud of each and every one of you（为你们每一个人感到骄傲） honored to be your captain（很荣幸成为你们的队长）
I am proud of each and every one of you, and I am honored to be your captain.
22
🇳 我毫不怀疑我们有潜力下赛季回来并夺得冠军头衔。
have no doubt that（毫不怀疑） potential to come back next season and claim the championship title（下赛季回归并夺得冠军的潜力）
I have no doubt that we have the potential to come back next season and claim the championship title.
23
🇳 但现在，让我们庆祝我们的旅程、我们的成长和我们的成就。
for now（暂时） celebrate our journey, our growth, and our achievements（庆祝我们的旅程成长和成就）
But for now, let's celebrate our journey, our growth, and our achievements.
24
🇳 敬我们，战士、梦想家、成就者。敬我们的旅程和未来更多的旅程。谢谢。
here's to us, the fighters, the dreamers, the achievers（致我们，奋斗者、追梦者、成就者） here's to our journey and to the many more to come（致我们的旅程和未来更多的旅程）
Here's to us, the fighters, the dreamers, the achievers. Here's to our journey and to the many more to come. Thank you. ---

Blog entry 博客（共 3 篇）

2021 年 — 我的21天感恩挑战之旅（个人分享）

共25句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q6 Part B Learning English through Popular Culture
You took part in a social media challenge called 'The 21-day Gratitude Challenge'. For three weeks, you kept a journal about the things you were thankful for on a daily basis. After completing the challenge, participants are invited to share their experience on the 21-day Gratitude Challenge website. Write a blog post. Explain why you accepted this challenge and what you hoped to achieve. Reflect on the 21 days and whether taking on this challenge has changed you in any way.
1
🇳 当我第一次在社交媒体上偶然发现"21天感恩挑战"时，我立刻被吸引了。
when I first stumbled upon（当我第一次偶然发现时） on social media（在社交媒体上） immediately intrigued（立刻被吸引）
When I first stumbled upon "The 21-Day Gratitude Challenge" on social media, I was immediately intrigued.
2
🇳 概念简单但深刻——三周内每天记录我感恩的事情。
concept was simple, yet profound（概念简单却深刻） document things that I was grateful for each day for three weeks（连续三周记录每天感恩的事）
The concept was simple, yet profound - to document things that I was grateful for each day for three weeks.
3
🇳 在日常生活的忙碌中，我希望这个挑战能提醒我欣赏生活中的小事，并培养更积极的人生观。
amidst the hustle and bustle of everyday life（在日常喧嚣中） serve as a reminder to appreciate the small things in life（提醒我们欣赏生活中的小事） foster a more positive outlook（培养更积极的心态）
Amidst the hustle and bustle of everyday life, I hoped this challenge would serve as a reminder to appreciate the small things in life and foster a more positive outlook.
4
🇳 开始这段旅程时，我最初的目标是培养感恩的习惯，将我的焦点从生活中缺少的东西转移到丰富的东西上。
embarking on this journey（踏上这段旅程） initial goal was to（最初的目标是） cultivate a habit of gratitude（培养感恩的习惯） shift my focus from what was lacking to what was abundant（将注意力从缺乏之处转向丰盛之处）
Embarking on this journey, my initial goal was to cultivate a habit of gratitude and to shift my focus from what was lacking in my life to what was abundant.
5
🇳 我渴望将我的大脑重新连接为默认积极和满足，而不是不满或渴望。
aspired to rewire my mind to（希望重塑思维以） default to positivity and contentment（默认倾向于积极和满足） rather than dissatisfaction or longing（而不是不满或渴望）
I aspired to rewire my mind to default to positivity and contentment, rather than dissatisfaction or longing.
6
🇳 挑战的头几天相对容易。
first few days of the challenge（挑战的头几天） relatively easy（相对容易）
The first few days of the challenge were relatively easy.
7
🇳 我发现自己记下明显的方面，比如有爱的家庭、稳定的工作和良好的健康。
found myself noting down obvious aspects（发现自己记下了显而易见的方面） loving family, stable job, good health（有爱的家庭、稳定的工作、健康的身体）
I found myself noting down obvious aspects such as having a loving family, a stable job, and good health.
8
🇳 但随着日子推进，我不得不更深入挖掘。
as the days progressed（随着日子一天天过去） had to dig deeper（不得不更深入挖掘）
But as the days progressed, I had to dig deeper.
9
🇳 我开始注意并欣赏更小的事情——陌生人的善意、新鲜煮好咖啡的香气，甚至阳光照在脸上的感觉。
began to notice and appreciate the smaller things（开始注意欣赏小事） kindness of strangers（陌生人的善意） aroma of freshly brewed coffee（现磨咖啡的香气） feeling of sunshine on my face（阳光照在脸上的感觉）
I began to notice and appreciate the smaller things - the kindness of strangers, the aroma of freshly brewed coffee, or even the feeling of sunshine on my face.
10
🇳 这个挑战迫使我真正睁开眼睛看到日常生活中的美。
forced me to truly open my eyes to（迫使我真正睁开眼去看） beauty in everyday life（日常生活中的美）
This challenge forced me to truly open my eyes to the beauty in everyday life.
11
🇳 回顾过去21天，我可以自信地说这个挑战改变了我的视角。
reflecting on the past 21 days（回顾过去的21天） confidently say（自信地说） transformed my perspective（改变了我的视角）
Reflecting on the past 21 days, I can confidently say that this challenge has transformed my perspective.
12
🇳 我感到一种以前没有的满足感。
sense of contentment that wasn't there before（以前没有的满足感）
I feel a sense of contentment that wasn't there before.
13
🇳 每天记录感恩的习惯创造了我心态的转变，使我更乐观、更欣赏我的生活。
daily habit of recording my gratitude（每天记录感恩的习惯） created a shift in my mindset（让我的心态发生了转变） making me more optimistic and appreciative of my life（让我对自己的人生更乐观和感恩）
The daily habit of recording my gratitude has created a shift in my mindset, making me more optimistic and appreciative of my life.
14
🇳 我意识到即使在我最糟糕的日子里，也总有值得感恩的事情。
realised that even on my worst days（意识到即便在最糟糕的日子里） there's always something to be grateful for（总有一些值得感恩的事）
I've realised that even on my worst days, there's always something to be grateful for.
15
🇳 除了个人改变，这个挑战也影响了我与他人的互动。
in addition to personal change（除了个人改变） influenced my interactions with others（影响了我与他人的互动）
In addition to personal change, this challenge has also influenced my interactions with others.
16
🇳 我在承认和欣赏周围人方面变得更善于表达。
become more expressive in（在……方面更富表现力） acknowledging and appreciating the people around me（认可并感激身边的人）
I've become more expressive in acknowledging and appreciating the people around me.
17
🇳 我意识到简单"谢谢"的力量，以及它如何能照亮某人的一天。
realised the power of a simple 'thank you'（意识到一句简单谢谢的力量） how it can brighten someone's day（它如何照亮他人的一天）
I've realised the power of a simple 'thank you' and how it can brighten someone's day.
18
🇳 然而，我必须承认，保持每天感恩日记并不总是容易的。
however, I must admit（然而我必须承认） maintaining a daily gratitude journal（坚持每天写感恩日记） not always easy（不总是容易的）
However, I must admit, maintaining a daily gratitude journal was not always easy.
19
🇳 有些日子生活变得忙碌，找时间或动力写作是有挑战的。
days when life got hectic（生活变得忙碌的日子） finding the time or the motivation to write was challenging（找到时间或动力来写作是很有挑战的）
There were days when life got hectic, and finding the time or the motivation to write was challenging.
20
🇳 但正是在这些时候，表达感恩的行为最有益。
it was precisely during these times（正是在这些时候） act of expressing gratitude was most beneficial（表达感恩的行为最为有益）
But it was precisely during these times that the act of expressing gratitude was most beneficial.
21
🇳 它作为一种扎根练习，将我带回当下，突出混乱中的美好。
served as a grounding exercise（起到了定心作用） bringing me back to the present（将我拉回现实） highlighting the good amidst the chaos（在混乱中凸显美好）
It served as a grounding exercise, bringing me back to the present and highlighting the good amidst the chaos.
22
🇳 总之，接受21天感恩挑战确实是一次有回报的经历。
in conclusion（总之） accepting the 21-day Gratitude Challenge（接受21天感恩挑战） truly been a rewarding experience（确实是一次收获满满的经历）
In conclusion, accepting the 21-day Gratitude Challenge has truly been a rewarding experience.
23
🇳 它教会我欣赏生活的简单乐趣，让我意识到感恩是一种心态，而不仅仅是一次性行为。
taught me to appreciate life's simple pleasures（教会我欣赏生活中的简单乐趣） made me realise that gratitude is a mindset, not just a one-time act（让我意识到感恩是一种心态而非一次性行为）
It has taught me to appreciate life's simple pleasures and has made me realise that gratitude is a mindset, not just a one-time act.
24
🇳 我鼓励每个人接受这个挑战。
encourage everyone to take up this challenge（鼓励每个人都接受这个挑战）
I encourage everyone to take up this challenge.
25
🇳 这是每天小小的承诺，但它能带给你视角的转变是巨大的。
small commitment each day（每天的小投入） shift it can bring to your perspective is immense（它给你视角带来的转变是巨大的）
It's a small commitment each day, but the shift it can bring to your perspective is immense. ---

2022 年 — Teen Chat YouTube频道：青少年视角的发声平台（个人经历分享）

共19句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2022 Q2 Part B Learning English through Popular Culture
You are the host of 'Teen Chat', a YouTube channel that explores a wide range of topics from a teenage perspective. Write an article for Teen Magazine about why you started this channel and what you have learned in the process.
1
🇳 作为"Teen Chat"的创作者和主持人——一个致力于从青少年视角探索无数话题的YouTube频道——我经历了一段学习、成长和连接的启发性旅程。
as the creator and host of（作为……的创作者和主持人） dedicated to exploring a myriad of topics（致力于探索众多话题） from a teenage perspective（从青少年的视角） enlightening journey of learning, growing and connecting（学习、成长和建立联系的开阔之旅）
As the creator and host of 'Teen Chat', a YouTube channel dedicated to exploring a myriad of topics from a teenage perspective, I've been on an enlightening journey of learning, growing and connecting.
2
🇳 我创办这个频道作为一个平台，为像我这样在主流媒体中常感代表性不足的青少年表达想法、关切和兴趣。
started this channel as a platform to voice（创办这个频道作为发声平台） thoughts, concerns, and interests（想法、关切和兴趣） underrepresented in mainstream media（在主流媒体中代表性不足）
I started this channel as a platform to voice the thoughts, concerns, and interests of teenagers like me, who often feel underrepresented in mainstream media.
3
🇳 我觉得需要一个空间，我们可以讨论从最新时尚潮流和流行文化到心理健康、身体形象和学业压力等更严肃问题的一切。
felt there was a need for a space（觉得需要一个空间） discuss everything from... to...（讨论从……到……的一切） mental health, body image, pressures of academic life（心理健康、身体形象、学业压力）
I felt there was a need for a space where we could discuss everything from the latest fashion trends and pop culture to more serious issues like mental health, body image, and the pressures of academic life.
4
🇳 "Teen Chat"的起源受到我自己经历和观察的启发。
genesis of... was inspired by（……的起源受……启发） my own experiences and observations（我自己的经历和观察）
The genesis of 'Teen Chat' was inspired by my own experiences and observations.
5
🇳 我注意到许多同龄人在应对类似挑战，但缺乏从我们视角解决这些问题的相关内容。
noticed that many of my peers were grappling with similar challenges（注意到我的许多同龄人也在应对类似挑战） lack of relatable content（缺乏能引起共鸣的内容） addressed these issues from our viewpoint（从我们的角度解决这些问题）
I noticed that many of my peers were grappling with similar challenges, yet there was a lack of relatable content that addressed these issues from our viewpoint.
6
🇳 目标是创建一个有趣、吸引人、信息丰富的频道，但最重要的是，一个对青少年感觉真实和相关的地方。
aim was to create a channel that was fun, engaging, and informative（目标是打造有趣引人入胜且信息丰富的频道） most importantly（最重要的是） felt authentic and relevant to teens（感觉真实且与青少年相关）
The aim was to create a channel that was fun, engaging, and informative, but most importantly, a place that felt authentic and relevant to teens.
7
🇳 当我开始这段旅程时，我了解到创作内容和管理YouTube频道需要决心、创造力和韧性。
as I embarked on this journey（踏上这段旅程时） learned that creating content and managing a YouTube channel required（了解到创作内容和管理YouTube频道需要） determination, creativity, and resilience（决心、创造力和韧性）
As I embarked on this journey, I learned that creating content and managing a YouTube channel required determination, creativity, and resilience.
8
🇳 这是关于在创造吸引人但也有意义和有影响力的内容之间取得平衡。
about striking a balance between（关于在……间取得平衡） creating content that was engaging, but also meaningful and impactful（创作既吸引人又有意义和影响力的内容）
It was about striking a balance between creating content that was engaging, but also meaningful and impactful.
9
🇳 这要求我走出舒适区，表达我的意见，并倾听和回应他人的意见。
required me to step out of my comfort zone（需要我走出舒适区） voice my opinions（表达我的观点） listen and respond to those of others（倾听并回应他人的声音）
It required me to step out of my comfort zone, to voice my opinions, and to listen and respond to those of others.
10
🇳 这是关于创造对话，而非独白。
about creating a dialogue, not a monologue（关于创造对话而非独白）
It was about creating a dialogue, not a monologue.
11
🇳 主持"Teen Chat"最有回报的方面之一是能够与世界各地的青少年连接，创建一个分享、支持和互相学习的全球青年社区。
one of the most rewarding aspects of hosting（主持中最有收获的方面之一） ability to connect with teenagers from all over the world（能与全球青少年建立联系） creating a global community of young people（创建一个全球青少年社群） share, support, and learn from each other（互相分享、支持和学习）
One of the most rewarding aspects of hosting 'Teen Chat' has been the ability to connect with teenagers from all over the world, creating a global community of young people who share, support, and learn from each other.
12
🇳 我了解到，尽管我们有不同的背景和文化，我们分享相似的经历、梦想和挑战。
despite our diverse backgrounds and cultures（尽管我们有着不同的背景和文化） share similar experiences, dreams, and challenges（分享相似经历、梦想和挑战）
I have learned that despite our diverse backgrounds and cultures, we share similar experiences, dreams, and challenges.
13
🇳 这种共同理解和同志情谊的感觉有力地提醒了青少年经历的普遍性。
sense of shared understanding and camaraderie（共同理解和友谊的感觉） powerful reminder of（有力地提醒……） universality of the teenage experience（青少年体验的普遍性）
This sense of shared understanding and camaraderie has been a powerful reminder of the universality of the teenage experience.
14
🇳 通过"Teen Chat"，我了解到每个声音都重要，与众不同是可以的，有独特的兴趣和意见是可以的。
through 'Teen Chat'（通过Teen Chat） learned that every voice matters（明白了每个声音都很重要） it's okay to be different（与众不同没关系） to have unique interests and opinions（拥有独特的兴趣和观点）
Through 'Teen Chat', I have learned that every voice matters, that it's okay to be different, to have unique interests and opinions.
15
🇳 我学会了倾听他人、同理心和理解的重要性。
learned the importance of listening to others（学会了倾听他人的重要性） empathy and understanding（empathy和理解）
I've learned the importance of listening to others, of empathy and understanding.
16
🇳 但最重要的是，我了解到作为青少年，我们有能力塑造我们周围的话语，去质疑、去学习、去实现改变。
but most importantly（但最重要的是） as teenagers（作为青少年） have the power to shape the discourse around us（有能力塑造我们周围的论述） to question, to learn, and to effect change（去质疑、去学习、去带来改变）
But most importantly, I've learned that as teenagers, we have the power to shape the discourse around us, to question, to learn, and to effect change.
17
🇳 主持"Teen Chat"是一段自我发现和成长的旅程。
hosting 'Teen Chat'（主持Teen Chat） journey of self-discovery and growth（自我发现和成长之旅）
Hosting 'Teen Chat' has been a journey of self-discovery and growth.
18
🇳 它教会了我沟通的力量、代表性的重要性和社区的价值。
taught me about the power of communication（教会了我沟通的力量） importance of representation（代表性的重要性） value of community（社区的价值）
It has taught me about the power of communication, the importance of representation, and the value of community.
19
🇳 它加强了我的信念：每个青少年都有值得被听到的声音，我致力于使"Teen Chat"成为一个这些声音可以被放大的平台。
reinforced my belief that（坚定了我的信念） every teenager has a voice that deserves to be heard（每个青少年都有值得被倾听的声音） committed to making 'Teen Chat' a platform where those voices can be amplified（致力于让Teen Chat成为放大那些声音的平台）
It has reinforced my belief that every teenager has a voice that deserves to be heard, and I am committed to making 'Teen Chat' a platform where those voices can be amplified. ---

Blog entry 博客（共 3 篇）

2020 年 — 戏曲中心之夜：意外爱上中国戏曲（旅游博客）

共27句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2020 Q9 Part B Learning English through Drama
You are visiting Hong Kong. Last night, a friend took you to the new Xiqu Centre in West Kowloon Cultural District to watch Chinese Opera. You didn't think you would like it, but after watching the performance, you changed your mind. Write a blog post for World Passport, a travel blog about different places and cultures. Describe your experience and the impact it had on you.
1
🇳 各位旅行爱好者好！
Greetings, fellow globetrotters（各位旅行者们，大家好）
Greetings, fellow globetrotters!
2
🇳 昨晚，我有了一次既令人惊讶又迷人的经历。
had an experience that was as surprising as it was enchanting（有一段既惊喜又迷人的经历）
Last night, I had an experience that was as surprising as it was enchanting.
3
🇳 我发现自己在香港充满活力的西九文化区中心，在新开业的戏曲中心，准备沉浸在中国戏曲的宏伟中。
found myself in the heart of（发现自己在……的中心） vibrant West Kowloon Cultural District（充满活力的西九文化区） newly opened Xiqu Centre（新开放的戏曲中心） immerse myself in the grandeur of Chinese Opera（沉浸在中国戏曲的宏伟中）
I found myself in the heart of Hong Kong's vibrant West Kowloon Cultural District, at the newly opened Xiqu Centre, ready to immerse myself in the grandeur of Chinese Opera.
4
🇳 诚然，我持怀疑态度。
admittedly, I was skeptical（说实话我曾怀疑）
Admittedly, I was skeptical.
5
🇳 我对中国戏曲的理解有限，文化细微差别似乎需要消化很多。
understanding of Chinese opera was limited（对中国戏曲的了解有限） cultural nuances seemed like a lot to take in（文化细微差异似乎信息量很大）
My understanding of Chinese opera was limited, and the cultural nuances seemed like a lot to take in.
6
🇳 然而，俗话说，"入乡随俗"。
as the saying goes（俗话说） 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do'（「入乡随俗」）
However, as the saying goes, 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do.'
7
🇳 所以我把疑虑放在一边，开始了这段有趣的旅程。
put my apprehensions aside（将顾虑放一边） embarked on this intriguing journey（踏上了这段引人入胜的旅程）
So I put my apprehensions aside and embarked on this intriguing journey.
8
🇳 戏曲中心是一座现代建筑奇迹，是城市尊重文化遗产的证明。
modern architectural marvel（现代建筑奇迹） testament to the city's respect for its cultural heritage（这座城市尊重文化遗产的证明）
The Xiqu Centre, a modern architectural marvel, is a testament to the city's respect for its cultural heritage.
9
🇳 其设计受传统中国灯笼启发，是新旧的融合。
design, inspired by traditional Chinese lanterns（设计灵感来自中国传统灯笼） fusion of the old and new（新与旧的融合）
Its design, inspired by traditional Chinese lanterns, is a fusion of the old and new.
10
🇳 我踏入的那一刻，就被卷入一个传统与现代相遇的世界。
the moment I stepped inside（我踏进去的那一刻） swept into a world where tradition meets modernity（被带入一个传统与现代交汇的世界）
The moment I stepped inside, I was swept into a world where tradition meets modernity.
11
🇳 演出是《紫钗记》——一个浪漫与悲剧的经典故事。
performance was 'The Legend of the Purple Hairpin'（演出是《紫钗记》） classic tale of romance and tragedy（经典浪漫悲剧）
The performance was 'The Legend of the Purple Hairpin' - a classic tale of romance and tragedy.
12
🇳 当灯光变暗、幕布升起时，我立刻被吸引了。
as the lights dimmed, and the curtain rose（灯光渐暗幕布升起时） immediately captivated（立刻被迷住）
As the lights dimmed, and the curtain rose, I was immediately captivated.
13
🇳 精致的服装、复杂的化妆和精美装饰的舞台是视觉盛宴。
elaborate costumes（精美的服装） intricate makeup（精致的妆容） beautifully decorated stage（装饰精美的舞台） feast for the eyes（视觉盛宴）
The elaborate costumes, the intricate makeup, and the beautifully decorated stage were a feast for the eyes.
14
🇳 但真正让我着迷的是音乐、歌唱和讲故事的独特融合。
unique blend of music, singing, and storytelling（音乐、歌唱和叙事的独特结合） truly mesmerized me（真正使我着迷）
But it was the unique blend of music, singing, and storytelling that truly mesmerized me.
15
🇳 中国传统乐器的每个音符都充满期待地弥漫在空气中，而演员富有表现力的歌唱讲述了一个超越语言障碍的故事。
each note from the traditional Chinese instruments（传统中国乐器的每一个音符） filled the air with anticipation（让空气中充满期待） actors' expressive singing（演员富有表现力的演唱） told a story that transcended language barriers（讲述了一个超越语言障碍的故事）
Each note from the traditional Chinese instruments filled the air with anticipation, while the actors' expressive singing told a story that transcended language barriers.
16
🇳 杂技表演和演员优雅、有目的的动作简直令人着迷。
acrobatic displays（杂技表演） elegant, purposeful movements of the performers（表演者优雅而有目的的动作） nothing short of spellbinding（绝对是令人着迷的）
The acrobatic displays and the elegant, purposeful movements of the performers were nothing short of spellbinding.
17
🇳 我发现自己被拉入叙事，体验角色的喜悦、悲伤，最终他们凄美爱情故事。
found myself drawn into the narrative（发现自己被故事吸引） experiencing the characters' joys, sorrows（体验角色的喜悦和悲伤） poignant love story（凄美的爱情故事）
I found myself drawn into the narrative, experiencing the characters' joys, sorrows, and ultimately, their poignant love story.
18
🇳 最让我震撼的是戏曲传达的情感深度。
what struck me most（最打动我的是） emotional depth that the opera conveyed（戏曲所传达的情感深度）
What struck me most was the emotional depth that the opera conveyed.
19
🇳 每个元素——音乐、表演、服装，甚至精心编排的动作——和谐地共同作用，将故事带入生活。
every element - the music, the acting, the costumes（每一个元素——音乐、表演、服装） carefully choreographed movements（精心编排的动作） worked in harmony to bring the story to life（和谐协作呈现故事）
Every element - the music, the acting, the costumes, even the carefully choreographed movements - worked in harmony to bring the story to life.
20
🇳 我发现自己以我没有预料到的方式被感动。
found myself moved in ways I hadn't anticipated（以我未曾预料的方式被打动）
I found myself moved in ways I hadn't anticipated.
21
🇳 演出后，我带着对中国戏曲的新欣赏离开了戏曲中心。
after the performance（演出结束后） left the Xiqu Centre with a newfound appreciation for Chinese Opera（带着对中国戏曲的全新欣赏离开戏曲中心）
After the performance, I left the Xiqu Centre with a newfound appreciation for Chinese Opera.
22
🇳 我曾经视为令人生畏的文化体验，已经转变为美丽、沉浸式的旅程。
what I once viewed as an intimidating cultural experience（我曾视之为令人生畏的文化体验的） transformed into a beautiful, immersive journey（转变为一段美丽沉浸的旅程）
What I once viewed as an intimidating cultural experience had transformed into a beautiful, immersive journey.
23
🇳 它提醒了艺术和文化超越界限、触动心灵和改变观念的力量。
served as a reminder of（提醒了……） power of art and culture to transcend boundaries, touch hearts, and change perceptions（艺术和文化超越界限、触动心灵和改变认知的力量）
It served as a reminder of the power of art and culture to transcend boundaries, touch hearts, and change perceptions.
24
🇳 所以，对我所有的旅行同伴，我强烈推荐在香港时参观戏曲中心。
to all my fellow travelers（致我所有的旅伴） highly recommend a visit to the Xiqu Centre when in Hong Kong（强烈推荐来香港时到访戏曲中心）
So, to all my fellow travelers, I highly recommend a visit to the Xiqu Centre when in Hong Kong.
25
🇳 让自己被中国戏曲的魔力带走。
allow yourself to be swept away by the magic of Chinese Opera（让自己沉醉于戏曲魅力）
Allow yourself to be swept away by the magic of Chinese Opera.
26
🇳 你可能像我一样，发现自己惊喜并深受感动。
you may, like me, find yourself pleasantly surprised and profoundly moved（你可能也像我一样惊喜感动）
You may, like me, find yourself pleasantly surprised and profoundly moved.
27
🇳 下次见，继续探索，继续发现，记住——世界充满惊喜，只要我们向它们敞开心扉。
until next time（下次再见） keep exploring, keep discovering（继续探索继续发现） world is full of surprises, if only we open ourselves to them（世界充满惊喜，只要敞开心扉）
Until next time, keep exploring, keep discovering, and remember - the world is full of surprises, if only we open ourselves to them. ---

建议专栏回信 / Advice Column — 2018 年 — 给J.C.：追求兽医梦想还是听从父母

共25句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q4 Part B Learning English through Social Issues
You write an advice column for Teen magazine and you have received the following letter: 'I've been thinking about my future. I love animals and I've always wanted to be a vet. But when I told my parents, the first thing they said was No. I feel really frustrated. What should I do? — J.C., 16 years old' Write a letter of advice.
1
🇳 亲爱的J.C.，感谢你联系我们并分享你的困境。
thank you for reaching out and sharing your dilemma with us（感谢你联系我们并分享你的困惑）
Dear J.C., Thank you for reaching out and sharing your dilemma with us.
2
🇳 这是勇敢的事，我为此称赞你。
it's a brave thing to do（这是一件勇敢的事） I commend you for it（我为此赞扬您）
It's a brave thing to do and I commend you for it.
3
🇳 我理解你处境困难，在对动物的热情和父母期望之间左右为难。
in a difficult situation（在困境中） torn between your passion for animals and your parents' expectations（在对动物的热爱和父母期望之间纠结）
I understand that you're in a difficult situation, torn between your passion for animals and your parents' expectations.
4
🇳 但记住，你并不孤单。许多青少年面临类似挑战。
but remember, you're not alone（但记住，你不孤单） many teenagers face similar challenges（许多青少年面临类似挑战）
But remember, you're not alone. Many teenagers face similar challenges.
5
🇳 首先，承认你对动物的热情和成为兽医的志向很重要。
firstly（首先） acknowledge your passion for animals and your aspiration to become a vet（认可你对动物的热爱和成为兽医的志向）
Firstly, it's important to acknowledge your passion for animals and your aspiration to become a vet.
6
🇳 你对想追求什么有清晰想法，这很好。
wonderful that you have a clear idea of what you want to pursue（很高兴你有清晰的追求方向）
It's wonderful that you have a clear idea of what you want to pursue.
7
🇳 不是每个人都像你这么早发现热情，这种清晰在你规划未来时可能是很大的优势。
not everyone discovers their passion as early as you have（不是每个人都像你一样早发现自己的热情） this clarity could be a great advantage（这种清晰度可能是一个巨大优势） as you plan your future（规划未来时）
Not everyone discovers their passion as early as you have, and this clarity could be a great advantage as you plan your future.
8
🇳 说到与父母打交道，沟通是关键。
when it comes to dealing with your parents（至于如何与父母打交道） communication is key（沟通是关键）
When it comes to dealing with your parents, communication is key.
9
🇳 他们最初可能说了"不"，但那不意味着他们不会听你的道理。
might have said 'No' initially（最初可能说了不） doesn't mean they won't listen to your reasoning（不意味着他们不会听你的理由）
They might have said 'No' initially, but that doesn't mean they won't listen to your reasoning.
10
🇳 安排时间与他们认真谈一谈。
set up a time to have a serious discussion with them（安排时间与他们认真讨论）
Set up a time to have a serious discussion with them.
11
🇳 你诚实冷静地表达感受很重要。
important that you express your feelings honestly and calmly（重要的是诚实地、平静地表达你的感受）
It's important that you express your feelings honestly and calmly.
12
🇳 解释你为什么想成为兽医、这对你意味着什么，以及你计划如何实现目标。
explain why you want to become a vet（解释为什么你想成为兽医） what it means to you（它对���意味着什么） how you plan to achieve your goal（你计划如何实现目标）
Explain why you want to become a vet, what it means to you, and how you plan to achieve your goal.
13
🇳 你父母可能对你选择的职业道路有担忧。
possible that your parents have concerns about your chosen career path（父母可能对你选择的职业道路有顾虑）
It's possible that your parents have concerns about your chosen career path.
14
🇳 他们可能担心成为兽医所需的漫长而苛刻的学习年数，或担心工作的情感代价。
worried about the long and demanding years of study required（担心漫长艰苦的学习年限） emotional toll of the job（工作的情感代价）
They might be worried about the long and demanding years of study required to become a vet, or they might have concerns about the emotional toll of the job.
15
🇳 如果是这样，做些研究。
if this is the case（如果是这种情况） do some research（做些研究）
If this is the case, do some research.
16
🇳 向他们展示你理解成为兽医需要什么，你愿意付出努力。
show them that you understand what it takes to become a vet（向他们展示你理解成为兽医所需的条件） willing to put in the hard work（愿意付出努力）
Show them that you understand what it takes to become a vet and that you're willing to put in the hard work.
17
🇳 你可能想考虑邀请父母与职业顾问或在职兽医见面。
consider inviting your parents to meet with a career counselor or a working vet（考虑邀请父母与职业顾问或在职兽医见面）
You might want to consider inviting your parents to meet with a career counselor or a working vet.
18
🇳 这可以让他们更好地理解这个职业及其要求，也向他们展示你对职业选择是认真的。
give them a better understanding of the profession and its demands（让他们更好地了解这个职业及其要求） show them that you're serious about your career choice（向他们展示你对职业选择是认真的）
This could give them a better understanding of the profession and its demands and also show them that you're serious about your career choice.
19
🇳 记住，你父母最初的反应可能源于对你的关心和爱。
remember（记住） parents' initial reaction might stem from a place of concern and love for you（父母最初的反应可能源于对你的关心和爱）
Remember, your parents' initial reaction might stem from a place of concern and love for you.
20
🇳 他们想要最好的给你，他们的"不"可能是因为担心你可能面临的挑战。
want the best for you（想给你最好的） their 'No' might be because they're worried about the challenges you might face（他们说不可能是因为担心你可能面临的挑战）
They want the best for you, and their 'No' might be because they're worried about the challenges you might face.
21
🇳 最终，这是你的生活，你有权追求你热爱的职业。
in the end（最后） it's your life（这是你的人生） you have the right to pursue a career that you're passionate about（你有权追求热爱的职业）
In the end, it's your life and you have the right to pursue a career that you're passionate about.
22
🇳 这可能需要时间和耐心，但我相信你可以帮助父母理解和支持你的梦想。
might take some time and patience（可能需要一些时间和耐心） help your parents understand and support your dreams（帮助父母理解并支持你的梦想）
It might take some time and patience, but I believe you can help your parents understand and support your dreams.
23
🇳 保持积极，相信自己，继续朝着目标努力。
stay positive（保持积极） believe in yourself（相信自己） keep striving towards your goal（继续朝着你的目标努力）
Stay positive, believe in yourself, and keep striving towards your goal.
24
🇳 记住，每个伟大的梦想都始于一个梦想家。
every great dream begins with a dreamer（每一个伟大的梦想都始于一个追梦者）
And remember, every great dream begins with a dreamer.
25
🇳 祝你旅程一切顺利。
wishing you all the best in your journey（祝你旅途一切顺利）
Wishing you all the best in your journey, ---

建议信 / Advice Letter — 2022 年 — 给Kam Chai：开cafe还是接受升职

共26句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2022 Q3 Part B Learning English through Workplace Communication
You write an advice column for Jobs Online magazine. A reader submitted the following question: 'My dream is to open a café with a few friends, but I've just been offered a promotion at my company. The pay is good, but I'm not that interested in the work. Should I leave now or wait a few years? — Kam Chai, 25 years old' Write a reply to Kam Chai offering your advice.
1
🇳 亲爱的Kam Chai，你的困境是我们许多人在人生某个时刻面临的：追求梦想还是坚持稳定工作之间的选择。
your dilemma is one many of us face at some point in our lives（你的困境是许多人都会面临的） choice between pursuing a dream or sticking with a secure job（追求梦想还是坚持稳定工作的抉择）
Dear Kam Chai, Your dilemma is one many of us face at some point in our lives: the choice between pursuing a dream or sticking with a secure job.
2
🇳 两个选择都有其优点和潜在陷阱。
both options have their merits and potential pitfalls（两种选择各有利弊和潜在风险）
Both options have their merits and potential pitfalls.
3
🇳 首先，重要的是认识到你与朋友开cafe的梦想是一项需要热情、奉献和大量努力的事业。
firstly（首先） important to recognize that（重要的是要认识到） dream of opening a cafe with your friends（梦想和朋友一起开咖啡馆） venture that requires passion, dedication, and a great deal of hard work（需要热情、投入和大量努力的事业）
Firstly, it's important to recognize that your dream of opening a cafe with your friends is a venture that requires passion, dedication, and a great deal of hard work.
4
🇳 这不只是关于供应咖啡和糕点；它涉及了解业务运营、管理财务、与供应商打交道、营销和客户服务。
not just about serving coffee and pastries（不仅仅是提供咖啡和糕点） involves understanding business operations, managing finances, dealing with suppliers, marketing, and customer service（涉及理解业务运营、管理财务、与供应商打交道、营销和客户服务）
It's not just about serving coffee and pastries; it involves understanding business operations, managing finances, dealing with suppliers, marketing, and customer service.
5
🇳 这是一个全职承诺，无疑会带来自己的挑战和不确定性。
full-time commitment（全职投入） come with its own set of challenges and uncertainties（伴随一系列挑战和不确定性）
It's a full-time commitment that will undoubtedly come with its own set of challenges and uncertainties.
6
🇳 另一方面，你当前公司的升职提供财务稳定和职业发展潜力。
on the other hand（另一方面） promotion at your current company（在现公司的晋升） offers financial stability and the potential for career progression（提供财务稳定性和职业发展潜力）
On the other hand, the promotion at your current company offers financial stability and the potential for career progression.
7
🇳 然而，你提到你对工作不太感兴趣。
however（然而） you mention that you're not particularly interested in the work（你提到对工作并非特别感兴趣）
However, you mention that you're not particularly interested in the work.
8
🇳 这种缺乏热情可能导致不满和倦怠，影响你的表现和整体快乐。
lack of passion can lead to dissatisfaction and burnout over time（缺乏热情可能导致长期的不满和倦怠） impact your performance and overall happiness（影响你的表现和整体幸福感）
This lack of passion can lead to dissatisfaction and burnout over time, which can impact your performance and overall happiness.
9
🇳 在做决定之前，我建议你考虑几件事。
before making a decision（做决定前） I would suggest you consider a few things（建议您考虑几点）
Before making a decision, I would suggest you consider a few things.
10
🇳 首先，评估你的财务状况。
first（首先） evaluate your financial situation（评估你的财务状况）
First, evaluate your financial situation.
11
🇳 创业需要资金，盈利可能需要时间。
starting a business requires capital（创业需要资金） can take time before it becomes profitable（可能需要时间才能盈利）
Starting a business requires capital, and it can take time before it becomes profitable.
12
🇳 你有足够的储蓄维持生活方式和业务初始成本吗？
do you have enough savings to sustain your lifestyle and the initial costs of the business（你是否有足够储蓄维持生活方式并承担创业初始成本）
Do you have enough savings to sustain your lifestyle and the initial costs of the business?
13
🇳 如果没有，可能值得再坚持工作一段时间来存钱。
if not（如果不是） might be worth sticking with your job for a little while longer to save up（可能值得多坚持一段时间工作攒点钱）
If not, it might be worth sticking with your job for a little while longer to save up.
14
🇳 第二，做些研究。
second（第二） do some research（做些研究）
Second, do some research.
15
🇳 了解cafe行业、竞争、涉及成本、潜在收入和你可能面临的挑战。
learn about the cafe industry, the competition, the costs involved, potential earnings, and the challenges you might face（了解咖啡馆行业、竞争、涉及的成本、潜在收益和可能面临的挑战）
Learn about the cafe industry, the competition, the costs involved, potential earnings, and the challenges you might face.
16
🇳 这会让你更清楚自己在进入什么，可能影响你的决定。
give you a clearer picture of what you're getting into（让你更清楚自己将要面对什么） could influence your decision（可能影响你的决定）
This will give you a clearer picture of what you're getting into and could influence your decision.
17
🇳 第三，考虑你对cafe想法的热情和承诺。
third（第三） consider your passion and commitment to the cafe idea（考虑你对开咖啡馆想法的热情和投入度）
Third, consider your passion and commitment to the cafe idea.
18
🇳 这是你看到自己长期做的事吗？你准备好迎接努力和可能的挫折了吗？
something you see yourself doing long term（你能看到自己长期做的事） prepared for the hard work and possible setbacks（为艰苦工作和可能的挫折做好准备）
Is this something you see yourself doing long term? Are you prepared for the hard work and possible setbacks?
19
🇳 如果答案是肯定的，那么可能值得冒险。
if the answer is yes（如果答案是肯定的） might be worth taking the risk（可能值得冒这个险）
If the answer is yes, then it might be worth taking the risk.
20
🇳 最后，和你的朋友谈谈。
lastly（最后） talk to your friends（和朋友谈谈）
Lastly, talk to your friends.
21
🇳 他们和你一样投入吗？他们能在财务和运营上做出贡献吗？
are they as committed as you are（他们是否和你一样投入） able to contribute financially and operationally（能在财务和运营上做出贡献）
Are they as committed as you are? Will they be able to contribute financially and operationally?
22
🇳 记住，和朋友一起做生意可能使关系紧张，尤其是在困难时期。
remember（记住） going into business with friends can strain relationships（和朋友合伙做生意可能使关系紧张） especially when things get tough（尤其是当事情变得困难时）
Remember, going into business with friends can strain relationships, especially when things get tough.
23
🇳 最终，决定由你来做，只有你能决定什么对你的职业和快乐最好。
in the end（最后） the decision is yours to make（决定由你来做） only you can determine what's best for your career and happiness（只有你能决定什么对你的职业和幸福最有利）
In the end, the decision is yours to make, and only you can determine what's best for your career and happiness.
24
🇳 向导师、家人或职业顾问寻求指导可能有帮助。
may be helpful to seek guidance from mentors, family, or a career counselor（寻求导师、家人或职业顾问的指导可能会有帮助）
It may be helpful to seek guidance from mentors, family, or a career counselor.
25
🇳 最后一个想法：你的职业是马拉松，不是短跑。
one final thought（最后一个想法） your career is a marathon, not a sprint（职业生涯是马拉松而非短跑）
One final thought: your career is a marathon, not a sprint.
26
🇳 有时，绕道探索可能带来更大工作满足和个人成就的机会是值得的。
sometimes worth taking detours to explore opportunities（有时值得绕道去探索机会） lead to greater job satisfaction and personal fulfillment（带来更高的工作满意度和个人成就感）
Sometimes, it's worth taking detours to explore opportunities that could lead to greater job satisfaction and personal fulfillment. ---

提案信 / Proposal Letter — 2021 年 — 电视剧《同一片天空下》提案

共19句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2021 Q9 Part B Learning English through Drama
You want to be a screenwriter and have an idea for a TV drama series about three generations of a family. Write a letter to the production manager at TV-Station X. Introduce the characters, plot and setting of your TV drama. Explain why you think this idea would be popular with viewers.
1
🇳 尊敬的先生/女士，希望您一切顺利。
I hope this letter finds you well（希望您收到此信时一切安好）
Dear Sir/Madam, I hope this letter finds you well.
2
🇳 我是一名有抱负的编剧，热爱讲故事，写信是为了提议一个新电视剧系列的想法，我相信它会吸引观众并产生高收视率。
aspiring screenwriter with a passion for storytelling（怀揣讲故事热情的编剧新秀） writing to propose an idea for a new TV drama series（写信提议新电视剧构思） captivate viewers and generate high ratings（吸引观众创造高收视）
I am an aspiring screenwriter with a passion for storytelling, and I am writing to propose an idea for a new TV drama series that I believe will captivate viewers and generate high ratings.
3
🇳 暂定名为《同一片天空下》的系列讲述Harper一家三代人的生活。
tentatively titled（暂定名为） follows the lives of（讲述……的生活） spanning over three generations（跨越三代）
The series, tentatively titled "Beneath the Same Sky," follows the lives of the Harper family, spanning over three generations.
4
🇳 中心人物是老家长Margaret Harper、她中年的儿子Daniel Harper和他十几岁的女儿Emily Harper。
central characters（核心角色） elderly matriarch（年迈的女族长） middle-aged son（中年儿子） teenage daughter（十几岁的女儿）
The central characters are the elderly matriarch, Margaret Harper, her middle-aged son, Daniel Harper, and his teenage daughter, Emily Harper.
5
🇳 Margaret Harper是意志坚强的女人，强硬外表下藏着对家人的深爱。
strong-willed woman（意志坚强的女人） tough exterior hides a deep love for her family（坚硬的外表下藏着对家庭的深爱）
Margaret Harper is a strong-willed woman, whose tough exterior hides a deep love for her family.
6
🇳 Daniel Harper是单身父亲，在父母责任和要求高的职业之间周旋。
single father（单亲父亲） juggling his responsibilities as a parent and a demanding career（兼顾为人父母的责任和高要求的职业）
Daniel Harper is a single father, juggling his responsibilities as a parent and a demanding career.
7
🇳 另一方面，Emily Harper是聪明有抱负的青少年，在身份认同和成长挑战中挣扎。
on the other hand（另一方面） bright and ambitious teenager（聪明有抱负的青少年） struggles with her identity and the challenges of growing up（与身份认同和成长挑战作斗争）
Emily Harper, on the other hand, is a bright and ambitious teenager, who struggles with her identity and the challenges of growing up.
8
🇳 情节围绕他们个人和集体的挣扎、成功以及关系动态展开。
plot revolves around（剧情围绕……展开） individual and collective struggles, successes, and the dynamics of their relationships（个人和集体的挣扎、成功以及他们关系的动态）
The plot revolves around their individual and collective struggles, successes, and the dynamics of their relationships.
9
🇳 每集将深入角色的复杂性，揭示他们的希望、恐惧和秘密。
each episode will dive into the complexity of their characters（每集将深入探讨他们角色的复杂性） revealing their hopes, fears, and secrets（揭示他们的希望、恐惧和秘密）
Each episode will dive into the complexity of their characters, revealing their hopes, fears, and secrets.
10
🇳 随着故事推进，观众将见证Harper一家面临的考验和磨难，以及他们的纽带如何随时间演变和加强。
as the story progresses（随着故事发展） viewers will witness the trials and tribulations（观众将见证艰辛与磨难） how their bonds evolve and strengthen over time（他们的纽带如何随时间演变和加强）
As the story progresses, viewers will witness the trials and tribulations that the Harpers face, and how their bonds evolve and strengthen over time.
11

1
🇳 在凸显代际差距扩大的最新发现中，一项新调查显示，香港60多岁人口的大多数希望工作超过传统65岁退休年龄。

🇳 许多人将希望保持精神活跃、社交参与和财务独立列为这一偏好背后的主要原因。
cited the desire to stay mentally active, socially engaged, and financially independent（表示希望保持思维活跃社交参与和经济独立） primary reasons behind this preference（这种偏好的主要原因）

on the other side of the generational divide（在代沟的另一边） increasing number of young people are aspiring to retire early（越来越多的年轻人渴望提前退休）
On the other side of the generational divide, an increasing number of young people are aspiring to retire early.

contrasting viewpoints reflect a broader shift in attitudes towards work and retirement（对比鲜明的观点反映了对工作和退休态度更广泛的转变） changing economic landscape（不断变化的经济格局）

for the older generation（对于老一辈） longer life expectancies, higher living costs, and a desire for purpose and social engagement（更长的寿命预期、更高的生活成本和追求目标与社交参与的愿望） contributing factors towards their wish to extend their working years（促使他们希望延长工作年限的因素）

these findings underline the need for more flexible retirement policies（这些发现凸显了更灵活退休政策的必要性） acknowledge and cater to these diverse retirement goals（承认并满足多样化退休目标） providing opportunities for flexible or part-time work（提供灵活或兼职工作机会） financial education and planning tools can play a crucial role（金融教育和规划工具可以发挥关键作用）

🇳 然而，对这些本地文具店来说并非全盘皆输。
however（然而） all is not lost for these local stationery shops（本地文具店并非全无希望）
However, all is not lost for these local stationery shops.

growing niche market of stationery enthusiasts and collectors（不断增长的文具爱好者和收藏家利基市场） drawn to unique, high-quality products（被独特高品质的产品吸引）
There is a growing niche market of stationery enthusiasts and collectors who are drawn to unique, high-quality products.

value the personal touch, expert advice, and the tactile shopping experience（珍视个人化触感、专业建议和触觉购物体验） independent stationery shops offer（独立文具店提供）

several shops have managed to tap into this market and adapt to the changing retail environment（几家店铺成功进入这一市场并适应了变化的零售环境）
Several shops have managed to tap into this market and adapt to the changing retail environment.

diversified their product range to include（将产品范围多样化以包含） bespoke and artisanal stationery items（定制手工文具产品） not readily available in mainstream stores（在主流商店不易找到的）

some have also started offering workshops and classes（一些还开始提供工作坊和课程） engage with their customers on a deeper level（与顾客建立更深层次的联系） transforming their shops into community hubs（将店铺转型为社区中心）

🇳 此外，这些店越来越多地利用社交媒体和电商来接触更广泛受众。
moreover（此外） increasingly utilizing social media and e-commerce to reach a wider audience（越来越多地利用社交媒体和电子商务触达更广泛的受众）
Moreover, these shops are increasingly utilizing social media and e-commerce to reach a wider audience.

creating online platforms that replicate the personalized shopping experience（创建复制个性化购物体验的在线平台） offering detailed product descriptions, high-quality images, and customer reviews（提供详细的产品描述、高质量图片和客户评价）

despite these innovations（尽管有这些创新） survival of independent stationery shops remains precarious（独立文具店的生存仍然岌岌可危）
Despite these innovations, the survival of independent stationery shops remains precarious.

🇳 政府可以通过提供财务支持或激励（如租金补贴或税收减免）在它们的生存中发挥重要作用。
government could play a significant role in their survival（政府可以在它们的生存中扮演重要角色） offering financial support or incentives, such as rent subsidies or tax breaks（提供财务支持或激励，如租金补贴或税收减免）

additionally（此外） fostering a culture of supporting local businesses among consumers（在消费者中培养支持本地企业的文化） contribute to their longevity（有助于它们的持久）
Additionally, fostering a culture of supporting local businesses among consumers can also contribute to their longevity.

with strategic adaptations and supportive policies（通过战略性调整和支持性政策） continue to be a cherished part of Hong Kong's retail landscape（继续成为香港零售景观中备受珍视的一部分） offering a unique shopping experience that large chains and online platforms cannot replicate（提供连锁店和在线平台无法复制���独特购物体验）

活动报道 / Event Report — 2023 年 — 动漫展：香港流行文化庆典

📋 2023 Q3 Part B Learning English through Popular Culture
Anime Expo, Hong Kong's biggest anime, manga and video game exhibition, was held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre last weekend. As a school reporter, you attended the event and interviewed some people dressed in cosplay. Write an article for your school magazine.
1
🇳 香港最大的动漫、漫画和电子游戏展览——动漫展上周末在香港会议展览中心描绘了一幅多彩的流行文化画卷。
Hong Kong's largest anime, manga, and video game exhibition（香港最大动漫游戏展） painted a colorful picture of pop culture（描绘了流行文化的多彩画卷） at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre（在香港会议展览中心）
The Anime Expo, Hong Kong's largest anime, manga, and video game exhibition, painted a colorful picture of pop culture last weekend at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.
2
🇳 作为我们学校的记者，我有机会沉浸在这个充满活力的世界中，并与将这些角色带入生活的cosplayer互动。
as our school's reporter（作为我校记者） had the opportunity to immerse myself in this vibrant world（有机会沉浸在这个充满活力的世界中） interact with the cosplayers who bring these characters to life（与让这些角色活起来的角色扮演者互动）
As our school's reporter, I had the opportunity to immerse myself in this vibrant world and interact with the cosplayers who bring these characters to life.
3
🇳 你踏入展览的那一刻，就被传送到另一个宇宙。
the moment you stepped into the expo（你踏入展览的那一刻） transported into a different universe（被传送到一个不同的宇宙）
The moment you stepped into the expo, you were transported into a different universe.
4
🇳 到处都是展示最新动漫漫画、游戏试玩和周边的摊位。
everywhere you looked（无论看向哪里） booths showcasing the latest anime and manga, video game demos, and merchandise（展示最新动漫游戏试玩和周边的展位）
Everywhere you looked, there were booths showcasing the latest anime and manga, video game demos, and merchandise.
5
🇳 然而，真正抢镜的是cosplayer——穿着精致服装的粉丝，扮演来自各种动漫、漫画和电子游戏的喜爱角色。
yet, what truly stole the show were the cosplayers（然而真正抢镜的是角色扮演者们） fans dressed in elaborate costumes, embodying their favorite characters from various animes, mangas, and video games（穿着精美服装化身来自各类动漫、漫画和游戏中喜爱角色的粉丝）
Yet, what truly stole the show were the cosplayers, fans dressed in elaborate costumes, embodying their favorite characters from various animes, mangas, and video games.
6
🇳 Cosplay是"costume play"的缩写，是一种表演艺术形式，参与者穿上服装和配饰来代表特定角色。
short for 'costume play'（costume play的缩写） form of performance art where participants don costumes and accessories to represent a specific character（一种表演艺术形式，参与者穿戴服装和配饰来代表特定角色）
Cosplay, short for 'costume play', is a form of performance art where participants don costumes and accessories to represent a specific character.
7
🇳 它是动漫展等流行文化活动的组成部分。
integral part of pop culture events like the Anime Expo（动漫展等流行文化活动不可或缺的一部分）
It's an integral part of pop culture events like the Anime Expo.
8
🇳 我有机会与几位cosplayer交谈，每位都有自己独特的故事和与角色的联系。
had the chance to speak with several cosplayers（有机会与几位角色扮演者交谈） each with their own unique story and connection to their character（各有与角色相关的独特故事）
I had the chance to speak with several cosplayers, each with their own unique story and connection to their character.
9
🇳 一位cosplayer装扮成热门动漫《火影忍者》中的漩涡鸣人，分享了他进入cosplay世界的旅程。
one cosplayer, dressed as Naruto Uzumaki from the popular anime series "Naruto"（一位cosplayer穿着《火影忍者》中漩涡鸣人的服装） shared his journey into the world of cosplay（分享了进入角色扮演世界的旅程）
One cosplayer, dressed as Naruto Uzumaki from the popular anime series "Naruto," shared his journey into the world of cosplay.
10
🇳 "我认同鸣人的决心和永不放弃的态度，"他说，"cosplay他让我表达这些特质，并与欣赏同一角色的其他粉丝联系。"
I relate to Naruto's determination and never-give-up attitude（我认同鸣人的决心和永不放弃的态度） cosplaying him allows me to express these traits and connect with other fans who appreciate the same character（扮演他让我能够表达这些特质并与其他欣赏同一角色的粉丝建立联系）
"I relate to Naruto's determination and never-give-up attitude," he said, "Cosplaying him allows me to express these traits and connect with other fans who appreciate the same character."
11
🇳 另一位cosplayer穿着吉卜力工作室电影《幽灵公主》的精致服装，说："cosplay是暂时踏入另一个世界的方式。它有趣、有创意，是结识志同道合者的好方法。"
another cosplayer, adorned in the intricate costume of Princess Mononoke from the Studio Ghibli film（另一位cosplayer身穿吉卜力幽灵公主精致服装） a way to step into another world for a while（一种暂时走进另一个世界的方式） fun, creative, and a great way to meet people with the same interests（有趣、有创意、结识志同道合之人的好方法）
Another cosplayer, adorned in the intricate costume of Princess Mononoke from the Studio Ghibli film, said, "Cosplaying is a way to step into another world for a while. It's fun, creative, and a great way to meet people with the same interests."
12
🇳 动漫展不仅是庆祝动漫、漫画和电子游戏；它也是这些cosplayer表达创意、分享热情和形成社区感的平台。
not just about celebrating anime, manga, and video games（不仅仅是庆祝动漫、漫画和电子游戏） also a platform for these cosplayers to express their creativity, share their passion, and form a sense of community（也是角色扮演者表达创意分享热情建立社群的平台）
The Anime Expo was not just about celebrating anime, manga, and video games; it was also a platform for these cosplayers to express their creativity, share their passion, and form a sense of community.
13
🇳 虽然一些cosplayer追求精确，将角色复制到最小细节，但另一些对角色加入自己的独特诠释，展示他们的创意和解读。
while some cosplayers aimed for accuracy, replicating their characters down to the smallest detail（虽然有些角色扮演者追求精确还原角色至最微小细节） others put their unique spin on their characters, showcasing their creativity and interpretation（其他人对角色的独特演绎展现了他们的创造力和诠释）
While some cosplayers aimed for accuracy, replicating their characters down to the smallest detail, others put their unique spin on their characters, showcasing their creativity and interpretation.
14
🇳 展览证明了流行文化将人们聚集在一起的力量。
expo was a testament to the power of pop culture in bringing people together（这次展览证明了流行文化凝聚人心的力量）
The expo was a testament to the power of pop culture in bringing people together.
15
🇳 无论年龄、性别或背景，每个人都分享对这种艺术形式的共同热爱。
regardless of age, gender, or background（无论年龄、性别或背景） everyone shared a common love for this art form（每个人都对这种艺术形式有着共同的热爱）
Regardless of age, gender, or background, everyone shared a common love for this art form.
16
🇳 这是一个粉丝可以庆祝他们喜爱的角色和故事的地方，在一个周末，踏入一个幻想与现实相遇的世界。
a place where fans could celebrate their favorite characters and stories（一个让粉丝庆祝喜爱角色和故事的地方） for a weekend, step into a world where fantasy meets reality（用一个周末踏入幻想遇见现实的世界）
It was a place where fans could celebrate their favorite characters and stories, and for a weekend, step into a world where fantasy meets reality.
17
🇳 作为学校记者，动漫展是一次大开眼界的经历。
as a school reporter（作为校报记者） the Anime Expo was an eye-opening experience（动漫展是一次大开眼界的经历）
As a school reporter, the Anime Expo was an eye-opening experience.
18
🇳 它凸显了流行文化粉丝核心的热情、创意和同志情谊。
highlighted the passion, creativity, and camaraderie that lie at the heart of pop culture fandom（凸显了流行文化粉丝圈核心中的热情、创造力和友谊）
It highlighted the passion, creativity, and camaraderie that lie at the heart of pop culture fandom.
19
🇳 无论你是动漫爱好者、休闲观众还是只是好奇，这样的活动都提供了一窥动漫世界和热爱它的人们的令人兴奋的机会。
whether you're an anime enthusiast, a casual viewer, or just curious（无论你是动漫迷、普通观众还是只是好奇） events like these offer an exciting glimpse into the world of anime and the people who love it（这类活动让人兴奋地一窥动漫世界和热爱它的人们）

📋 2023 Q9 Part B Learning English through Workplace Communication
You work for Restaurant Business magazine. You interviewed a restaurant owner about his/her experiences of running a business during the pandemic. Write a feature article for the magazine.
1
🇳 COVID-19疫情极大改变了餐饮业，企业主被迫重新制定策略并适应新常态。
COVID-19 pandemic has dramatically altered the restaurant industry（新冠疫情极大地改变了餐饮业） business owners being forced to reinvent their strategies and adapt to a new normal（企业主被迫重塑策略适应新常态）
The COVID-19 pandemic has dramatically altered the restaurant industry, with business owners being forced to reinvent their strategies and adapt to a new normal.
2
🇳 我们采访了一位受人尊敬的餐厅老板，尽管这些挑战时期，他不仅使业务维持，还在混乱中蓬勃发展。
caught up with an esteemed restaurant owner（与一位德高望重的餐厅老板交谈） despite these challenging times（尽管在这些充满挑战的时期） managed to not only keep his business afloat but also thrived amidst the chaos（不仅让生意维持下来还在混乱中繁荣发展）
We caught up with an esteemed restaurant owner who, despite these challenging times, managed to not only keep his business afloat but also thrived amidst the chaos.
3
🇳 疫情最初爆发时，餐厅老板的直接关切是员工福祉和如何继续运营。
when the pandemic first hit（疫情刚爆发时） immediate concern for restaurant owners was their staff's well-being and how to continue operations（餐厅老板最直接的担忧是员工福祉和如何继续运营）
When the pandemic first hit, the immediate concern for restaurant owners was their staff's well-being and how to continue operations.
4
🇳 "我们团队和顾客的安全成为首要任务。我们必须重新构想整个商业模式，以符合健康指引同时仍满足顾客期望，"我们的受访者分享。
safety of our team and customers became our top priority（团队和顾客的安全成为我们的首要任务） had to reimagine our entire business model to align with health guidelines and still meet customers' expectations（不得不重新构想整个商业模式以符合健康指引并仍满足顾客期望）
"The safety of our team and customers became our top priority. We had to reimagine our entire business model to align with health guidelines and still meet customers' expectations," shared our interviewee.
5
🇳 随着堂食服务暂时关闭，焦点转向外卖和配送服务。
with the temporary closure of dine-in services（随着堂食服务的暂时关闭） focus shifted to takeaway and delivery services（重心转向外卖和配送服务）
With the temporary closure of dine-in services, the focus shifted to takeaway and delivery services.
6
🇳 我们的受访者迅速跟上潮流，与本地配送应用合作以维持稳定收入。
quickly jumped on the bandwagon（迅速跟风） partnered with local delivery apps to maintain a steady stream of income（与本地外卖应用合作维持稳定的收入来源）
Our interviewee quickly jumped on the bandwagon and partnered with local delivery apps to maintain a steady stream of income.
7
🇳 "我们几乎一夜之间必须变得更懂科技。我们重新设计了网站用于在线下单，并优化了外卖菜单。"
had to become more tech-savvy, almost overnight（几乎一夜之间就不得不变得更懂科技） redesigned our website for online orders and optimized our menu for takeaway（重新设计网站支持在线下单并优化外卖菜单）
"We had to become more tech-savvy, almost overnight. We redesigned our website for online orders and optimized our menu for takeaway."
8
🇳 疫情还凸显了社区支持的重要性。
pandemic also underscored the importance of community support（疫情也突显了社区支持的重要性）
The pandemic also underscored the importance of community support.
9
🇳 餐厅老板发起"支持本地"活动，为邻里顾客提供折扣。
launched a 'Support Local' campaign, offering discounts to neighborhood customers（发起了「支持本地」活动，为社区顾客提供折扣）
The restaurant owner launched a 'Support Local' campaign, offering discounts to neighborhood customers.
10
🇳 "在危机时期，与社区保持联系至关重要。他们的支持是无价的，"他说。
in times of crisis（在危机时刻） essential to stay connected with your community（与社区保持联系至关重要） their support has been invaluable（他们的支持是无价的）
"In times of crisis, it's essential to stay connected with your community. Their support has been invaluable," he said.
11
🇳 然而，适应不仅限于运营。
however, the adaptation wasn't limited to operations alone（然而适应不仅限于运营）
However, the adaptation wasn't limited to operations alone.
12
🇳 菜单本身也经历了转变。
the menu itself underwent a transformation（菜单本身经历了转变）
The menu itself underwent a transformation.
13
🇳 "我们必须重新思考菜单，专注于容易运输的舒适食物。我们还推出了餐包，让顾客可以在家重现他们喜爱的菜肴。"
had to rethink our menu, focusing on comfort food that can be easily transported（不得不重新思考菜单，专注于易于运输的舒适食品） introduced meal kits so customers could recreate their favorite dishes at home（推出套餐食材包让顾客在家重现喜爱的菜肴）
"We had to rethink our menu, focusing on comfort food that can be easily transported. We also introduced meal kits so customers could recreate their favorite dishes at home."
14
🇳 餐厅还利用社交媒体与顾客保持联系。
leveraged social media to stay connected with its patrons（利用社交媒体与顾客保持联系）
The restaurant also leveraged social media to stay connected with its patrons.
15
🇳 从分享厨房幕后视频到主持直播烹饪环节，业务变得不仅是餐厅；它成为许多人封锁期间的娱乐和安慰来源。
from sharing behind-the-scenes kitchen videos to hosting live cooking sessions（从分享厨房幕后视频到举办现场烹饪课） became more than just a restaurant（成为不止一家餐厅） source of entertainment and comfort for many during lockdowns（封锁期间许多人的娱乐和安慰来源）
From sharing behind-the-scenes kitchen videos to hosting live cooking sessions, the business became more than just a restaurant; it became a source of entertainment and comfort for many during lockdowns.
16
🇳 尽管有挑战，我们的受访者对未来保持乐观。
despite the challenges（尽管面临挑战） remains optimistic about the future（对未来保持乐观）
Despite the challenges, our interviewee remains optimistic about the future.
17
🇳 "这场疫情教会了我们韧性。我们学会了适应和创新。虽然我们想念满座餐厅的热闹，但我们找到了服务顾客甚至接触更广泛受众的新方法。"
this pandemic has taught us resilience（这次疫情教会了我们韧性） learned to adapt and innovate（学会了适应和创新） miss the buzz of a full dining room（怀念满堂食客的热闹） found new ways to serve our customers and even reach a wider audience（找到了服务顾客甚至触及更广泛受众的新方式）
"This pandemic has taught us resilience. We've learned to adapt and innovate. While we miss the buzz of a full dining room, we've found new ways to serve our customers and even reach a wider audience."
18
🇳 餐饮业无疑是受疫情打击最严重的行业之一。
restaurant industry is undoubtedly one of the sectors hardest hit by the pandemic（餐饮业无疑是受疫情打击最严重的行业之一）
The restaurant industry is undoubtedly one of the sectors hardest hit by the pandemic.
19
🇳 然而，这样的故事激发希望。
yet, stories like these inspire hope（然而这样的故事激发希望）
Yet, stories like these inspire hope.
20
🇳 它们凸显了行业适应不可预见情况的韧性和能力。

as the world slowly returns to normal（随着世界慢慢恢复正常） it's clear that some changes are here to stay（显然有些变化会持续下去）

🇳 没有剧本表演的想法令人生畏；我们习惯了排练和记台词。

stepping into the unknown（踏入未知） something liberating about that（其中有某种解放的感觉）

as we got into groups and started brainstorming（分组开始头脑风暴时） initial fear began to dissipate（最初的恐惧开始消散）

bouncing ideas off each other（互相交换想法） atmosphere was buzzing with creativity（现场充满创意氛围）
We were bouncing ideas off each other, and the atmosphere was buzzing with creativity.

🇳 我们决定了一个家庭晚餐出岔子的滑稽前提，有夸张角色和荒谬情境。
decided on a comical premise of a family dinner gone wrong（确定了搞砸的家庭晚餐这个搞笑前提） with exaggerated characters and absurd situations（以夸张的角色和荒诞的情境）

🇳 轮到我们表演时，我的心在狂跳。

as I stepped onto the stage（踏上舞台时） reminded myself of the one rule in improvisation: "Yes, and..."（提醒自己即兴表演的唯一规则：是的而且……）

🇳 它意味着接受队友抛给我的任何场景并在其基础上构建。
meant accepting whatever scenario my teammates threw at me and building upon it（意味着接受队友抛来的任何情境并在此基础上发挥）
It meant accepting whatever scenario my teammates threw at me and building upon it.

this rule set the tone for our performance（这条规则为我们的表演定下了基调）
