🇳 小品混乱，充满意外转折，因为我们在没有路线图的情况下导航剧情。
skit was chaotic, full of unexpected twists and turns（小品一片混乱充满意外转折） as we navigated our way through the plot without a roadmap（在没有路线图的情况下摸索剧情）
The skit was chaotic, full of unexpected twists and turns as we navigated our way through the plot without a roadmap.
16
🇳 我们必须密切关注彼此，捕捉线索和反应来推动故事前进。
had to pay close attention to each other（必须密切注意彼此） picking up on cues and reactions to drive the story forward（捕捉提示和反应推动故事发展）
We had to pay close attention to each other, picking up on cues and reactions to drive the story forward.
17
🇳 有困惑的时刻，有言语和行动结巴的时刻，但它们只增加了情境的喜剧性。
moments of confusion（困惑的时刻） stumbling over words and actions（言语和动作磕磕巴巴） only added to the comedy of the situation（只是让情况更加滑稽）

What surprised me was the level of spontaneity and creativity that emerged in the absence of a script.

🇳 我们的角色实时发展，被当下的动力塑造。

Our characters developed in real-time, shaped by the dynamics of the moment.

🇳 幽默是有机的，源于我们真实的反应和互动。
humor was organic（笑点是自然的） stemming from our genuine reactions and interactions（源于我们真实的反应和互动）
The humor was organic, stemming from our genuine reactions and interactions.
21
🇳 观众的笑声感觉令人难以置信地有回报，知道这是我们即时创意的结果。
audience's laughter felt incredibly rewarding（观众的笑声让人无比满足） knowing it was a result of our on-the-spot creativity（知道这是我们即兴创作的成果）
The audience's laughter felt incredibly rewarding, knowing it was a result of our on-the-spot creativity.

experience was a rollercoaster（这次经历就像过山车） filled with exhilaration, anxiety, laughter, and relief（充满了兴奋、焦虑、欢笑和解脱）

日记 / Diary & Journal Entry — 2022 年 — 扮演英雄与反派的反思（Journal Entry）

📋 2022 Q7 Part B Learning English through Drama
As part of your drama class, you played the role of the hero and the villain in different plays. Write an entry in your drama journal. Reflect on which role you preferred playing and why.
1
🇳 日记：在戏剧的广阔领域中，我有独特机会探索两个迷人对比的角色：英雄和反派。
in the vast realm of drama（在广袤的戏剧领域） had the unique opportunity to explore two fascinatingly contrasting roles: the hero and the villain（有独特机会探索两个截然不同的迷人角色：英雄与反派）
Journal Entry: In the vast realm of drama, I had the unique opportunity to explore two fascinatingly contrasting roles: the hero and the villain.
2
🇳 这次经历是一次进入人性复杂性和表演艺术细微差别的启蒙之旅。
enlightening journey into the complexities of human nature and the nuances of performance art（探究人性复杂性和表演艺术细微差别的启迪之旅）
The experience was an enlightening journey into the complexities of human nature and the nuances of performance art.
3
🇳 作为英雄，我是勇气、韧性和道德正直的化身。
as the hero（作为主角） embodiment of courage, resilience, and moral integrity（勇气、韧性和道德正直的化身）
As the hero, I was the embodiment of courage, resilience, and moral integrity.
4
🇳 英雄的角色令人满足，因为它让我描绘我们常钦佩并试图效仿的令人向往的品质。
hero's role was gratifying（英雄角色令人满足） allowed me to portray the aspirational qualities that we often admire and seek to emulate（让我演绎我们钦佩并渴望效仿的理想品质）
The hero's role was gratifying as it allowed me to portray the aspirational qualities that we often admire and seek to emulate.
5
🇳 支持正确事业、站出来反对不公、成为他人希望灯塔，有一种满足感。
certain satisfaction in championing the right cause（为正确事业奋斗的满足感） standing up against injustice（站出来反对不公） being the beacon of hope for others（成为他人的希望灯塔）
There was a certain satisfaction in championing the right cause, in standing up against injustice, in being the beacon of hope for others.
6
🇳 英雄的旅程，有其考验磨难、胜利失败，让我深入人类韧性和坚定不移信念的力量。
hero's journey, with its trials and tribulations, victories and defeats（英雄的旅程，伴随着考验、磨难、胜利和失败） allowed me to delve into the depths of human resilience and the power of unwavering conviction（让我深入探索人类韧性和坚定信念的力量）
The hero's journey, with its trials and tribulations, victories and defeats, allowed me to delve into the depths of human resilience and the power of unwavering conviction.
7
🇳 然而，反派角色呈现了完全不同但同样有趣的前景。
however（然而） role of the villain presented an entirely different, yet equally intriguing, prospect（反派角色呈现出完全不同但同样吸引人的前景）
However, the role of the villain presented an entirely different, yet equally intriguing, prospect.
8
🇳 反派常被误解和中伤，是复杂的角色。
often misunderstood and maligned（常被误解和中伤） villain is a complex character（反派是一个复杂的角色）
Often misunderstood and maligned, the villain is a complex character.
9
🇳 扮演反派挑战我深入人类心理的黑暗面，探索由贪婪、权力或复仇驱动的动机。
playing the villain challenged me to delve into the darker aspects of the human psyche（扮演反派挑战我深入探索人类心理的阴暗面） explore motivations driven by greed, power, or vengeance（探索贪欲、权力或复仇驱动的动机）
Playing the villain challenged me to delve into the darker aspects of the human psyche, to explore motivations driven by greed, power, or vengeance.
10
🇳 这是一个要求高的角色，要求我脱离固有的对错观念，拥抱一个有缺陷、在许多方面悲剧性地人性化的角色。
demanding role（要求高的角色） required me to detach from my inherent notions of right and wrong（需要我摆脱固有的对错观念） embrace a character that was flawed and, in many ways, tragically human（拥抱一个充满缺陷且在许多方面悲剧性地人性的角色）
It was a demanding role, requiring me to detach from my inherent notions of right and wrong and to embrace a character that was flawed and, in many ways, tragically human.
11
🇳 反派角色提供了丰富的情感和层次供探索，让我推动作为演员的界限。
villain's role offered a wealth of emotions and layers to explore（反派角色提供了丰富的情感和层次供探索） allowing me to push my boundaries as an actor（让我突破演员的界限）
The villain's role offered a wealth of emotions and layers to explore, allowing me to push my boundaries as an actor.
12
🇳 反思两种经历，我发现自己更被反派角色吸引。
reflecting upon both experiences（反思这两段经历） find myself drawn more towards the role of the villain（发现自己更被反派角色吸引）
Reflecting upon both experiences, I find myself drawn more towards the role of the villain.
13
🇳 虽然喜欢反派胜过主角似乎不传统，但我的偏好不在于角色的道德对齐，而在于角色提供的复杂性和深度。
while it may seem unconventional to prefer the antagonist over the protagonist（虽然偏爱反派胜过主角似乎不合常规） my preference lies not in the moral alignment of the character but in the complexity and depth the role offers（我的偏好不在于角色的道德立场而在于角色提供的复杂性和深度）
While it may seem unconventional to prefer the antagonist over the protagonist, my preference lies not in the moral alignment of the character but in the complexity and depth the role offers.
14
🇳 扮演反派要求我调动广泛情感，为道德可疑的行为辩护，并人性化一个常被去人性化的角色。
playing the villain required me to tap into a wide range of emotions（扮演反派需要我触及广泛的情感） justify actions that were morally questionable（为道德上有问题的行为辩护） humanize a character that is often dehumanized（将常被非人化的角色赋予人性）
Playing the villain required me to tap into a wide range of emotions, to justify actions that were morally questionable, and to humanize a character that is often dehumanized.
15
🇳 这是一次有挑战、有时不舒服但最终有回报的经历。
challenging, sometimes uncomfortable, but ultimately rewarding experience（充满挑战但最终收获满满的经历）
It was a challenging, sometimes uncomfortable, but ultimately rewarding experience.
16
🇳 它推动我伸展演技，探索角色塑造的新维度，并质疑善恶的二元观念。
pushed me to stretch my acting skills（推动我拓展表演技能） explore new dimensions of character portrayal（探索角色塑造的新维度） question the binary notions of good and evil（质疑善恶二元对立的观念）
It pushed me to stretch my acting skills, to explore new dimensions of character portrayal, and to question the binary notions of good and evil.
17
🇳 最终，两个角色都提供了宝贵教训和独特经历。
in the end（最后） both roles offered invaluable lessons and unique experiences（两个角色都带来宝贵教训和独特经历）
In the end, both roles offered invaluable lessons and unique experiences.
18
🇳 它们凸显了人性的二元性和存在于我们每个人内的道德光谱。
highlighted the dichotomy of human nature and the spectrum of morality that exists within each of us（凸显了人性的二元性和存在于我们每个人内心的道德光谱）
They highlighted the dichotomy of human nature and the spectrum of morality that exists within each of us.
19
🇳 作为演员，这些角色丰富了我对角色发展和叙事的理解，这些教训我将在戏剧世界的旅程中继续携带。
as an actor（作为一名演员） these roles have enriched my understanding of character development and narrative storytelling（这些角色丰富了我对角色发展和叙事讲述的理解） lessons that I will carry forward in my journey in the world of drama（我将在戏剧世界的旅程中继续带在身边的教训）
As an actor, these roles have enriched my understanding of character development and narrative storytelling, lessons that I will carry forward in my journey in the world of drama. ---

📋 2021 Q4 Part B Learning English through Sports Communication
You are a professional athlete looking for a career change. You have seen the job vacancy shown below and would like to apply for the position of Assistant Coach. (Hong Kong Sports Foundation is hiring Assistant Coaches. Main duties: to design training programmes for elite athletes; to organise international sporting competitions; to identify and support local talent.) Write a job application letter to the Human Resources Manager. Introduce yourself and your athletic history. Explain your interest and suitability for the job.
1
🇳 尊敬的人力资源经理，我写信表达对最近广告的香港体育基金会助理教练职位的兴趣。
I am writing to express my interest in（我写信表达对……的兴趣） recently advertised position of Assistant Coach with the Hong Kong Sports Foundation（香港体育基金会最近招聘的助理教练职位）
Dear Human Resources Manager, I am writing to express my interest in the recently advertised position of Assistant Coach with the Hong Kong Sports Foundation.
2
🇳 凭借在职业体育的广泛背景和培养年轻人才的热情，我相信我是这个角色的理想候选人。
with an extensive background in professional sports and a passion for nurturing young talents（拥有丰富的职业体育背景和培养年轻人才的热情） ideal candidate for this role（该职位的理想人选）
With an extensive background in professional sports and a passion for nurturing young talents, I believe I am an ideal candidate for this role.
3
🇳 我叫[你的名字]，是一名有十多年国际比赛经验的职业运动员。
professional athlete with over a decade of experience competing at international levels（在国际水平竞赛中拥有十多年经验的职业运动员）
My name is [Your Name] and I am a professional athlete with over a decade of experience competing at international levels.
4
🇳 我代表香港参加过各种体育项目，最著名的是田径，在亚运会上获得过多枚奖牌。
represented Hong Kong in various sports disciplines（在多个体育项目中代表香港） most notably in athletics（特别是在田径方面） managed to secure multiple medals at the Asian Games（在亚运会上赢得了多枚奖牌）
I have represented Hong Kong in various sports disciplines, most notably in athletics where I have managed to secure multiple medals at the Asian Games.
5
🇳 在我的职业生涯中，我有幸与业内一些最好的教练和训练师合作，这不仅塑造了我作为运动员，也让我深入了解了教练和指导的艺术。
throughout my career（在我的整个职业生涯中） had the privilege of working with some of the best coaches and trainers in the industry（有幸与业内最优秀的教练和训练师合作） not only shaped me as an athlete but also given me an insight into the art of coaching and mentoring（不仅塑造了我作为运动员还让我洞察了教练和指导的艺术）
Throughout my career, I have had the privilege of working with some of the best coaches and trainers in the industry, which has not only shaped me as an athlete but also given me an insight into the art of coaching and mentoring.
6
🇳 我现在处于职业生涯中希望转型为教练的阶段，回馈给予我这么多的体育界。
at a point in my career where I wish to transition into coaching（在职业生涯中希望转向教练角色） give back to the sports community that has given me so much（回馈给予我如此多的体育界）
I am now at a point in my career where I wish to transition into coaching, to give back to the sports community that has given me so much.

her ability to express profound thoughts and emotions through simple yet powerful words（她通过简单而有力的词语表达深刻思想和情感的能力） deeply resonated with me（深深引起我的共鸣）
Her ability to express profound thoughts and emotions through simple yet powerful words was something that deeply resonated with me.
5
🇳 从那时起，我被诗歌世界迷住，一直将我的感受、想法和观察写成诗句。
since then（从那时起） been captivated by the world of poetry（被诗歌世界深深吸引） putting my feelings, thoughts, and observations into verse（将感受、想法和观察化为诗句）

🇳 我相信被志同道合的人包围，都分享对诗歌的同样热情，将是令人难以置信的启发。
being surrounded by like-minded individuals, all sharing the same passion for poetry（被志同道合同样热爱诗歌的人包围） incredibly inspiring（无比激励人心）

🇳 它将提供一个分享想法、从彼此视角学习和提升我们诗歌技巧的平台。

1
🇳 尊敬的黄先生，希望您身体健康。
I hope this letter finds you in good health（希望您收到此信时身体健康）

writing to express my interest in applying for a work transfer to the Shanghai branch of the Park Hotel（写信表达申请调往Park Hotel上海分店的意向）

had the privilege of working in customer service, sales, and operations（有幸在客户服务、销售和运营部门工作） giving me a well-rounded understanding of the hotel industry（让我对酒店行业有了全面的理解）
I have had the privilege of working in customer service, sales, and operations, giving me a well-rounded understanding of the hotel industry.
6
🇳 我最近担任的副经理角色进一步磨练了我的领导和管理技能。
most recent role as the Assistant Manager（最近的助理经理职位） further honed my leadership and management skills（进一步磨练了我的领导和管理技能）
My most recent role as the Assistant Manager has further honed my leadership and management skills.
7
🇳 我一直收到客人的正面反馈，并帮助我们酒店实现了高客户满意度。
consistently received positive feedback from guests（一直收到客人的正面反馈） helped our hotel achieve high customer satisfaction ratings（帮助酒店取得了高客户满意度评价）

8

The reason for my interest in transferring to Shanghai is twofold.
9
🇳 首先，我的家人在上海，搬家可以让我离他们更近。
firstly（首先） my family is based in Shanghai（我的家人在上海） the move would allow me to be closer to them（这次调动能让我离他们更近）
Firstly, my family is based in Shanghai, and the move would allow me to be closer to them.
10
🇳 其次，我渴望开阔视野，在不同文化和商业环境中体验酒店业。
secondly（其次） eager to broaden my horizons and experience the hotel industry in a different cultural and business environment（渴望拓宽视野在不同文化和商业环境中体验酒店业）
Secondly, I am eager to broaden my horizons and experience the hotel industry in a different cultural and business environment.
11
🇳 我相信在世界上最繁忙城市之一的上海工作，将呈现独特挑战和学习机会，促进我的职业成长。
working in Shanghai, one of the busiest cities in the world（在上海这一全球最繁忙城市工作） present unique challenges and learning opportunities（呈现独特的挑战和学习机会） enhance my professional growth（促进我的职业成长）

with the experience and knowledge I have gained in Hong Kong（凭借我在香港获得的经验和知识） bring a fresh perspective and innovative ideas to the Shanghai branch（为上海分公司带来新视角和创新理念）

well-versed in Park Hotel's standards of service and operational procedures（精通Park Hotel的服务标准和运营流程） allow for a seamless transition（实现无缝过渡）

moreover（此外） my understanding of the Hong Kong market can aid in attracting more guests from this region to our Shanghai branch（我对香港市场的理解有助于吸引更多该地区客人到上海分店）

短篇小说 / Short Story — 2018 年 — 飞向自由：鹦鹉Sky的故事

共29句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q9 Part B Learning English through Short Stories
Imagine you are a pet bird in a cage. One day your owner left your bird cage open. Write a story from the bird's point of view.
1
🇳 当太阳在城市上空升起，在建筑物上投下金色光芒时，我期待地竖起羽毛。
as the sun rose over the city（当太阳升起照耀城市） casting a golden glow on the buildings（为建筑洒下金色光芒） ruffled my feathers in anticipation（期待地竖起羽毛）
As the sun rose over the city, casting a golden glow on the buildings, I ruffled my feathers in anticipation.
2
🇳 今天不同。今天，我的笼门半开着，是通往我只从笼栏间瞥见过的世界的门户。
today was different（今天不一样） cage door was ajar（笼门半开） a portal to the world I had only glimpsed through the bars of my cage（一扇通往我只能透过笼栏窥见的世界的大门）
Today was different. Today, my cage door was ajar, a portal to the world I had only glimpsed through the bars of my cage.
3
🇳 我叫Sky，主人给我的名字，也许是对我从未知道的家的颂歌。
a name my owner gave me（主人给我的名字） perhaps as an ode to the home I never knew（也许是对我从未知道的家园的颂歌）
My name is Sky, a name my owner gave me, perhaps as an ode to the home I never knew.
4
🇳 作为一只宠物虎皮鹦鹉，我的世界一直被限制在笼子的四壁内。
as a pet parakeet（作为一只宠物鹦鹉） world had always been confined to the four walls of my cage（世界一直困在笼子四面墙内）
As a pet parakeet, my world had always been confined to the four walls of my cage.
5
🇳 我常梦想开阔的天空、飞翔的自由、感受翼下之风而无任何约束。
had often dreamt of the open skies（常常梦见广阔的天空） freedom to fly（飞翔的自由） feel the wind beneath my wings without any constraints（无拘无束地感受翼下的风）
I had often dreamt of the open skies, the freedom to fly, to feel the wind beneath my wings without any constraints.
6
🇳 那天早上主人去上班时，他看起来很匆忙。
when my owner left for work that morning（那天早上主人出门上班时） he looked rushed（他看起来很匆忙）
When my owner left for work that morning, he looked rushed.
7
🇳 匆忙中，他忘了关我的笼门。
in his haste（匆忙中） forgot to close my cage door（忘了关笼门）
In his haste, he forgot to close my cage door.
8
🇳 我注意到门开着的那一刻，我的心因恐惧和兴奋的混合而颤动。
the moment I noticed the open door（当我注意到门开着的那一刻） heart fluttered with a mix of fear and excitement（心因恐惧与兴奋交织而颤动）
The moment I noticed the open door, my heart fluttered with a mix of fear and excitement.
9
🇳 就是这一刻——我逃跑的机会，体验笼子之外世界的机会。
this was it（就是这一刻） my chance to escape（我逃跑的机会） experience the world beyond my cage（体验笼子之外的世界）
This was it - my chance to escape, to experience the world beyond my cage.
10
🇳 犹豫地扑腾一下，我跳上开着的门。
with a hesitant flutter（犹豫地扑腾着） hopped onto the open door（跳上开着的门）
With a hesitant flutter, I hopped onto the open door.
11
🇳 我环顾房间，没有笼子的安全包围，它大得多、令人生畏得多。
looked around the room（环顾房间） so much larger and more intimidating without the safety of my cage around me（没有笼子的安全感笼罩着，显得更大更令人生畏）
I looked around the room, so much larger and more intimidating without the safety of my cage around me.
12
🇳 但当我瞥见窗户——微开着，让温暖阳光和外面盛开的花朵的香味进来——我知道我必须抓住这个机会。
as I caught sight of the window, slightly ajar（瞥见窗户微开时） letting in the warm sunlight and the scent of the blooming flowers outside（让温暖的阳光和外面盛开的花朵的香气进来） knew I had to take this chance（知道我必须抓住这个机会）
But as I caught sight of the window, slightly ajar, letting in the warm sunlight and the scent of the blooming flowers outside, I knew I had to take this chance.
13
🇳 我深吸一口气，展开翅膀，飞了。
took a deep breath（深吸一口气） spread my wings（展开翅膀） flew（飞了）
I took a deep breath, spread my wings, and flew.
14
🇳 世界在颜色和声音的模糊中从我身边掠过。
world rushed past me in a blur of colors and sounds（世界在色彩声音中飞驰）
The world rushed past me in a blur of colors and sounds.
15
🇳 我穿过开着的窗户飞入开阔天空，风吹乱我的羽毛，太阳温暖我的背。
soared through the open window and into the open sky（从敞开的窗户飞出，翱翔入辽阔的天空） wind ruffling my feathers（风吹乱我的羽毛） sun warming my back（阳光温暖我的背）
I soared through the open window and into the open sky, the wind ruffling my feathers, the sun warming my back.
16
🇳 这令人振奋，一种我从未体验过的自由感。
it was exhilarating（那令人无比振奋） feeling of freedom I had never experienced before（从未体验过的自由感）
It was exhilarating, a feeling of freedom I had never experienced before.
17
🇳 我飞越城市，从我从未想象过的视角看它。
flew over the city（飞过城市上空） seeing it from a perspective I had never imagined（从从未想象过的角度看待它）
I flew over the city, seeing it from a perspective I had never imagined.
18
🇳 我栖息在公园的树上，与野鸟一起唱歌，在水坑里洗澡。
perched on a tree in the park（停在公园的一棵树上） sang along with the wild birds（与野鸟一起歌唱） bathed in a puddle（浸在水洼中）
I perched on a tree in the park, sang along with the wild birds, and bathed in a puddle.
19
🇳 我尝到了盛开的花朵的甜花蜜，与我习惯的谷物形成鲜明对比。
tasted the sweet nectar of a blooming flower（尝到了盛开花朵的甜美花蜜） a stark contrast to the grains I was used to（与我习惯的食物形成鲜明对比）
I tasted the sweet nectar of a blooming flower, a stark contrast to the grains I was used to.
20
🇳 每次经历都是新的、令人兴奋的、解放的。
each experience was new, exciting, and liberating（每一次经历都是崭新、兴奋和解放的）
Each experience was new, exciting, and liberating.
21
🇳 当太阳开始落山，用橙色和粉色描绘天空时，我发现自己飞回了公寓。
as the sun began to set（当太阳开始落山） painting the sky with hues of orange and pink（用橙粉色调染遍天空） found myself flying back to the apartment（发现自己飞回了公寓）
As the sun began to set, painting the sky with hues of orange and pink, I found myself flying back to the apartment.
22
🇳 我的一部分渴望笼子的熟悉和安全，我的家。
a part of me yearned for the familiarity and safety of my cage, my home（我内心深处渴望回到笼子的熟悉与安全，那是我的家）
A part of me yearned for the familiarity and safety of my cage, my home.
23
🇳 但当我栖息在开着的窗户上，看着曾经是我整个世界的笼子，我知道我不能回去只做一只笼中鸟。
as I perched on the open window（停在敞开的窗边时） looking at the cage that had once been my whole world（看着那个曾是我的整个世界的笼子） knew I couldn't go back to being just a cage bird（知道我不能回去只做一只笼中鸟）
But as I perched on the open window, looking at the cage that had once been my whole world, I knew I couldn't go back to being just a cage bird.
24
🇳 从那天起，我的生活改变了。
from that day on（从那天起） my life changed（我的人生改变了）
From that day on, my life changed.
25
🇳 我的主人对我的归来感到惊讶，决定让我的笼门开着。
my owner, surprised by my return（主人惊讶于我回来了） decided to leave my cage door open（决定让笼门开着）
My owner, surprised by my return, decided to leave my cage door open.
26
🇳 我不再只是一只宠物鸟；我是Sky，尝过自由的鸟。
no longer just a pet bird（不再只是一只宠物鸟） I am Sky, the bird who has tasted freedom（我是Sky，尝过自由的鸟）
I am no longer just a pet bird; I am Sky, the bird who has tasted freedom.
27
🇳 我的笼子不再是监狱，而是我日常冒险后可以回来的家。
cage is no longer a prison（笼子不再是监狱） but a home I could return to after my daily adventures（而是冒险后可回归的家）
My cage is no longer a prison, but a home I could return to after my daily adventures.
28
🇳 开阔的天空现在是我的游乐场，一个充满可能性和自由的世界。
open sky is now my playground（广阔天空现在是我的游乐场） a world full of possibilities and freedom（一个充满可能性和自由的世界）
The open sky is now my playground, a world full of possibilities and freedom.
29
🇳 即使我是大城市里的一只小鸟，第一次，我感到真正活着。
even though I am a small bird in a big city（尽管我只是一只大城市里的小鸟） for the first time（首次） I feel truly alive（我感到真正活着）
And even though I am a small bird in a big city, for the first time, I feel truly alive. ---

短篇小说 / Short Story — 2019 年 — 龟兔赛跑：团队版

共28句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2019 Q9 Part B Learning English through Short Stories
Cosmo book shop is organising a short story contest. In the tale The Tortoise and the Hare, two animals challenge each other to a race to prove who is the fastest. Mid-race, the hare lies down to rest, certain that it will win. The tortoise, though slow, never gives up and crosses the finishing line ahead of the hare. Slow and steady wins the race, as the message of the story goes. Re-write this story. Use the same characters but imagine that the tortoise and the hare team up to race against other contestants. Express a message through the telling of the story. Give your story a title.
1
🇳 从前，在一个充满活泼好胜生物的繁忙森林里，宣布了一场盛大比赛。
once upon a time（从前） in a bustling forest full of lively and competitive creatures（在一个充满生机和竞争动物的热闹森林里） a grand race was announced（一场盛大比赛宣布了）
Once upon a time, in a bustling forest full of lively and competitive creatures, a grand race was announced.
2
🇳 比赛对所有生物开放，但有一个转折：它将是团队项目。
race was open to all creatures（比赛对所有动物开放） but there was a twist（但有转折） it was to be a team event（这将是一场团队比赛）
The race was open to all creatures, but there was a twist: it was to be a team event.
3
🇳 这一宣布激起了极大兴奋，森林很快充满了急切参赛者组队的嗡嗡声。
announcement stirred up great excitement（这个消息引起了极大兴奋） forest was soon buzzing with eager contestants pairing up（森林很快因踊跃的参赛者组队而热闹起来）
This announcement stirred up great excitement, and the forest was soon buzzing with eager contestants pairing up.
4
🇳 在兴奋中，两个不太可能的朋友——乌龟和兔子——决定组队。
amid the excitement（在兴奋之中） two unlikely friends, the Tortoise and the Hare（两个不可能的朋友乌龟和野兔） decided to team up（决定联手）
Amid the excitement, two unlikely friends, the Tortoise and the Hare, decided to team up.
5
🇳 其他动物嘲笑他们的决定。
other animals scoffed at their decision（其他动物嘲笑他们的决定）
The other animals scoffed at their decision.
6
🇳 以慢步闻名的乌龟和因过度自信臭名昭著的兔子被视为最不具威胁的组合。
Tortoise, known for his slow pace（乌龟，以缓慢步伐著称） Hare, infamous for his overconfidence（野兔，以过度自信闻名） seen as the least threatening pair（被视为最不具威胁的一对）
The Tortoise, known for his slow pace, and the Hare, infamous for his overconfidence, were seen as the least threatening pair.
7
🇳 然而，二人不为所动。
however（然而） the duo was unfazed（这对搭档不为所动）
However, the duo was unfazed.
8
🇳 他们决心证明怀疑者错了。
determined to prove their doubters wrong（决心证明质疑者错了）
They were determined to prove their doubters wrong.
9
🇳 比赛日到了。
the day of the race arrived（the race arrived的day）
The day of the race arrived.
10
🇳 赛道充满挑战，有危险的斜坡和蜿蜒的小路。
course was challenging（课程很有挑战性） with treacherous slopes and winding paths（以危险的山坡和蜿蜒的小路）
The course was challenging, with treacherous slopes and winding paths.
11
🇳 比赛开始时，兔子用敏捷的腿领先。
as the race began（比赛开始时） the Hare, with his swift legs, took the lead（野兔以飞快的腿领先）
As the race began, the Hare, with his swift legs, took the lead.
12
🇳 不像上次比赛中他过度自信，他吸取了教训。
unlike the previous race, where he had been overconfident（与之前他过度自信的比赛不同） he had learned his lesson（他学到了教训）
Unlike the previous race, where he had been overconfident, he had learned his lesson.
13
🇳 他以稳定的速度跑，小心不要太早耗尽自己。
ran at a steady pace（以稳定的节奏奔跑） careful not to exhaust himself too early（小心不过早耗尽体力）
He ran at a steady pace, careful not to exhaust himself too early.
14
🇳 同时，乌龟以他缓慢稳定的步伐跟随着兔子。
meanwhile（与此同时） the Tortoise, with his slow and steady pace, followed the Hare（乌龟以缓慢稳健的步伐跟在野兔后面）
Meanwhile, the Tortoise, with his slow and steady pace, followed the Hare.
15
🇳 他没有被慢速吓倒。
he was not deterred by his slow speed（他没有因缓慢的速度而气馁）
He was not deterred by his slow speed.
16
🇳 相反，他专注于保持一致的步伐，知道耐力是他的强项。
instead（相反地） focused on maintaining a consistent pace（专注于保持稳定的节奏） knowing that endurance was his strength（知道耐力是他的优势）
Instead, he focused on maintaining a consistent pace, knowing that endurance was his strength.
17
🇳 比赛进行着，许多队伍落后，无法跟上要求高的赛道。
race progressed（比赛进行着） many teams fell behind（很多队伍落后了） unable to keep up with the demanding course（无法跟上高要求的课程）
The race progressed, and many teams fell behind, unable to keep up with the demanding course.
18
🇳 然而，乌龟和兔子坚持了下来。
the Hare and Tortoise, however, persisted（然而野兔和乌龟坚持了下来）
The Hare and Tortoise, however, persisted.
19
🇳 他们互相支持，兔子在乌龟需要休息时放慢速度，乌龟在兔子变得过于热心时鼓励他。
supported each other（互相支持） with the Hare slowing down when the Tortoise needed rest（野兔在乌龟需要休息时放慢速度） the Tortoise encouraging the Hare when he became overzealous（乌龟在野兔过度热情时鼓励他）
They supported each other, with the Hare slowing down when the Tortoise needed rest and the Tortoise encouraging the Hare when he became overzealous.
20
🇳 他们的同志情谊和互相支持成为他们最大的力量。
their camaraderie and mutual support became their greatest strength（他们的友谊和相互支持成为他们最大的力量）
Their camaraderie and mutual support became their greatest strength.
21
🇳 终于，经过数小时的艰苦比赛，终点线在望。
finally（最后） after hours of rigorous racing（经过数小时激烈角逐） the finish line was in sight（终点线就在眼前）
Finally, after hours of rigorous racing, the finish line was in sight.
22
🇳 乌龟和兔子尽管身体疲惫，却感到一股能量。
the Hare and the Tortoise, despite their physical exhaustion（尽管体力透支野兔和乌龟） felt a surge of energy（感到一股能量涌来）
The Hare and the Tortoise, despite their physical exhaustion, felt a surge of energy.
23
🇳 他们一起冲过终点线，令其他动物大为惊讶。
crossed the finish line together（一起冲过终点线） much to the astonishment of the other animals（令其他动物大为惊讶）
They crossed the finish line together, much to the astonishment of the other animals.
24
🇳 这对不太可能的组合赢了比赛，不是靠最快或最强，而是靠互相支持和永不放弃。
the unlikely duo had won the race（这对不可思议的组合赢得了比赛） not by being the fastest or the strongest（不是通过成为最快或最强） but by supporting each other and never giving up（而是互相支持永不放弃）
The unlikely duo had won the race, not by being the fastest or the strongest, but by supporting each other and never giving up.
25
🇳 他们的胜利教会森林动物宝贵一课：胜利不总是关于个人成为最好，而是关于你们能多好地合作和互相支持，拥抱彼此的优点和缺点。
victory taught the forest animals a valuable lesson（胜利给森林动物上了宝贵一课） winning is not always about being the best individually（胜利不总是关于个人做到最好） but about how well you can work together and support each other（而是看你们多能协作互助） embracing each other's strengths and weaknesses（接纳彼此的长处和短处）
Their victory taught the forest animals a valuable lesson: winning is not always about being the best individually, but about how well you can work together and support each other, embracing each other's strengths and weaknesses.
26
🇳 于是，龟兔赛跑的故事出现了意外转折。
thus（因此） the tale of the Tortoise and the Hare took an unexpected turn（the tortoise and the hare took an unexpected turn的tale）
Thus, the tale of the Tortoise and the Hare took an unexpected turn.
27
🇳 他们成为团结、韧性和团队合作力量的象征。
became a symbol of unity, resilience, and the power of teamwork（成为团结韧性和团队力量的象征）
They became a symbol of unity, resilience, and the power of teamwork.
28
🇳 森林动物学到，真正的成功不在于比赛的速度，而在于团结的力量。
forest animals learned that true success lies not in the speed of the race（森林动物们明白了真正的成功不在于比赛的速度） but in the strength of the unity（而是在团结的力量中）
The forest animals learned that true success lies not in the speed of the race but in the strength of the unity. ---
❓ 视题目而定

短篇小说 / Short Story — 2020 年 — 冰封之谜：北极科考站失踪案

共29句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2020 Q8 Part B Learning English through Short Stories
Sci-Fi magazine is organising a First Chapter Competition. The competition involves writing the first chapter of a story based on the following scenario: A journalist is sent to investigate a research station in the Arctic after staff begin to mysteriously disappear one by one. You would like to enter the competition. Write the first chapter ONLY of your story.
1
🇳 第一章：冰封之谜
Chapter 1: The Icebound Enigma（第一章：冰封之谜）
Chapter 1: The Icebound Enigma
2
🇳 直升机引擎的轰鸣声震耳欲聋，它与北极的烈风搏斗。
roar of the helicopter's engines was deafening（直升机引擎的轰鸣声震耳欲聋） battled the Arctic's harsh winds（与北极凛冽寒风搏斗）
The roar of the helicopter's engines was deafening as it battled the Arctic's harsh winds.
3
🇳 里面，来自《每日环球报》的资深记者Jack Sullivan穿着保暖装备缩成一团，凝视着下方荒凉的冰雪。
inside（在里面） Jack Sullivan, a seasoned journalist from 'The Daily Globe'（Jack Sullivan，《环球日报》资深记者） huddled in his thermal gear（蜷缩在他的保暖装备里） staring out at the bleak expanse of ice and snow below（凝视下方冰天雪地的荒凉）
Inside, Jack Sullivan, a seasoned journalist from 'The Daily Globe', was huddled in his thermal gear, staring out at the bleak expanse of ice and snow below.
4
🇳 他的任务和风景一样寒冷荒凉——调查偏远研究站无法解释的失踪事件。
his mission was as cold and desolate as the landscape（他的任务如同这片荒凉景观一样冰冷孤寂） investigate the inexplicable disappearances at a remote research station（调查偏远研究站的离奇失踪事件）
His mission was as cold and desolate as the landscape - to investigate the inexplicable disappearances at a remote research station.
5
🇳 这个恰如其分命名为"北极星"的站是致力于研究气候变化的最先进设施。
station, aptly named 'Polaris'（名为北极星的研究站） state-of-the-art facility dedicated to studying climate change（研究气候变化的先进设施）
The station, aptly named 'Polaris', was a state-of-the-art facility dedicated to studying climate change.
6
🇳 它是这片冰冻荒野中的希望灯塔，员工是一群敬业的科学家。
beacon of hope in the middle of this frozen wilderness（冰封荒野中的希望灯塔） staff a group of dedicated scientists（工作人员是一群敬业的科学家）
It was a beacon of hope in the middle of this frozen wilderness, its staff a group of dedicated scientists.
7
🇳 然而，近几个月来，工作人员开始一个接一个消失，无影无踪。
however（然而） in recent months（近几个月来） staff members began to vanish, one by one, without a trace（工作人员开始一个接一个消失无踪）
However, in recent months, staff members began to vanish, one by one, without a trace.
8
🇳 当局困惑，媒体好奇，Jack被指派解开这个谜团。
authorities were stumped（当局一筹莫展） media was intrigued（媒体很感兴趣） Jack was tasked with unraveling this mystery（Jack的任务是解开谜团）
The authorities were stumped, the media was intrigued, and Jack was tasked with unraveling this mystery.
9
🇳 当直升机降落在结冰的停机坪上时，Jack感到一阵寒意沿着脊椎流下。
as the helicopter descended onto the icy landing pad（直升机降落在冰雪停机坪时） felt a shiver run down his spine（感到一阵寒意沿脊柱而下）
As the helicopter descended onto the icy landing pad, Jack felt a shiver run down his spine.
10
🇳 这不只是因为寒冷。
it wasn't just from the cold（不仅仅是因为寒冷）
It wasn't just from the cold.
11
🇳 他以前处于过挑战情况——战区、政治骚乱、自然灾害——但这次不同。
he'd been in challenging situations before - war zones, political riots, natural disasters（他以前经历过挑战性局面——战区、政治骚乱、自然灾害） but this was different（但这次不同）
He'd been in challenging situations before - war zones, political riots, natural disasters - but this was different.
12
🇳 这是一个包裹在冰和沉默中的谜团，一个迄今为止拒绝被解开的谜题。
mystery wrapped in ice and silence（被冰雪和寂静包裹的谜团） puzzle that had so far refused to be solved（至今拒绝被解开的谜题）
This was a mystery wrapped in ice and silence, a puzzle that had so far refused to be solved.
13
🇳 走出直升机，Jack受到站主任Elena Kuznetsov博士迎接。
stepping out of the helicopter（走下直升机） greeted by Dr. Elena Kuznetsov, the station's director（受到研究站站长Elena Kuznetsov博士的接待）
Stepping out of the helicopter, Jack was greeted by Dr. Elena Kuznetsov, the station's director.
14
🇳 一个有着钢铁般目光的高个女人，她看起来和她指挥的冰堡垒一样令人生畏。
tall woman with a steely gaze（目光坚毅的高个子女人） looked as formidable as the icy fortress she commanded（她看起来和她掌控的冰堡垒一样令人生畏）
A tall woman with a steely gaze, she looked as formidable as the icy fortress she commanded.
15
🇳 "欢迎来到北极星，Sullivan先生，"她说，声音在寒风中几乎听不见。
welcome to Polaris, Mr. Sullivan（欢迎来到北极星站Sullivan先生） her voice barely audible over the frigid wind（她的声音在寒冷的风中几乎听不见）
"Welcome to Polaris, Mr. Sullivan," she said, her voice barely audible over the frigid wind.
16
🇳 当Jack跟着她进入站的温暖时，他注意到简朴的环境。
as Jack followed her into the warmth of the station（Jack随她走进温暖的车站时） took note of the austere surroundings（注意到了简朴的环境）
As Jack followed her into the warmth of the station, he took note of the austere surroundings.
17
🇳 设施是走廊和实验室的迷宫，充满嗡嗡作响的机器和闪烁的屏幕。
facility was a maze of corridors and labs（设施像迷宫般的走廊和实验室） filled with humming machinery and flickering screens（充满了嗡嗡作响的机器和闪烁的屏幕）
The facility was a maze of corridors and labs, filled with humming machinery and flickering screens.
18
🇳 很难想象这个无菌、科学的庇护所会是如此令人困惑的失踪现场。
hard to imagine that this sterile, scientific sanctuary could be the scene of such baffling disappearances（难以想象这个无菌的科学圣地竟是这样的离奇失踪现场）
It was hard to imagine that this sterile, scientific sanctuary could be the scene of such baffling disappearances.

🇳 喝着热咖啡，Kuznetsov博士向他详细介绍了情况。
over a hot cup of coffee（在一杯热咖啡旁） Dr. Kuznetsov filled him in on the details（Kuznetsov博士说明了细节）

five staff members had disappeared over the last six months（过去六个月里有五名工作人员失踪） each vanishing without a trace（每一个都消失得无影无踪）

no clues, no patterns（没有线索没有模式） just a chilling void where a person used to be（曾经有人的地方只剩令人不寒而栗的空无）
There were no clues, no patterns, just a chilling void where a person used to be.

any theories?（有什么猜想？） his reporter instincts kicking in（他的记者本能被激发）
"Any theories?" Jack asked, his reporter instincts kicking in.

🇳 "没有说得通的，"Kuznetsov博士承认，她的眼睛反射着北极的强光。"这就是为什么你在这里，Sullivan先生。我们希望新的眼睛可能发现我们错过的东西。"
none that make sense（没有一个说得通） her eyes reflecting the harsh Arctic light（她的眼睛映照着刺眼的北极光） hoping fresh eyes might uncover what we've missed（希望新的视角能发现我们遗漏的东西）

🇳 Jack点头，理解他任务的重量。
Jack nodded（Jack点了点头） understanding the weight of his task（明白任务的分量）
Jack nodded, understanding the weight of his task.
25
🇳 他来这里寻找答案，剥开这个冰封谜团的层层。
here to find answers（来寻找答案） peel back the layers of this icy enigma（揭开这个冰冷谜团的层层真相）
He was here to find answers, to peel back the layers of this icy enigma.
26

little did he know（他浑然不知） Polaris had secrets buried deeper than the Arctic frost（北极星站埋藏着比冰霜更深的秘密） secrets that were waiting to be unearthed（等待被发掘的秘密）

with a deep breath（深吸一口气） picked up his notepad and pen（拿起笔记本和笔）

time to begin his investigation（是时候开始调查了） time to step into the chilling mystery that was Polaris（是时候踏入北极星站的冰冷谜团了）

the story, like the Arctic itself（这个故事就像北极本身） was a vast expanse of unknowns（是一片广阔的未知） Jack was about to dive in headfirst（Jack正要一头扎进去）

📋 2021 Q7 Part B Learning English through Short Stories

1
🇳 当经验丰富的保安David在废弃工厂开始值班时，夜黑如墨。
the night was as black as ink（夜如墨般漆黑） David, a seasoned security guard（David，经验丰富的保安） began his shift at the abandoned factory（在废弃工厂开始夜班）
The night was as black as ink when David, a seasoned security guard, began his shift at the abandoned factory.
2
🇳 他习惯了诡异的沉默和老建筑令人不安的吱嘎声。
used to the eerie silence and the unsettling creaks of the old building（习惯了怪异寂静和旧建筑令人不安的吱嘎声）
He was used to the eerie silence and the unsettling creaks of the old building.

but tonight（但今晚） unusual chill in the air that made him shudder（空气中异常的寒意让他打了个寒颤）

as David was making his usual rounds（David例行巡逻时） noticed something strange（注意到一些奇怪的事情）
As David was making his usual rounds, he noticed something strange.
5
🇳 一扇总是锁着的门半开着。
a door, which was always locked, stood ajar（一扇总是锁着的门半开着）

6

curiosity piqued（好奇心被激起） decided to investigate（决定调查）
Curiosity piqued, he decided to investigate.
7
🇳 他走进房间，手里拿着手电筒，照亮空气中漫无目的漂浮的灰尘颗粒。
walked into the room, flashlight in hand（走进房间手拿手电筒） illuminating the dust particles floating aimlessly in the air（照亮了空气中漫无目的漂浮的尘埃）

room was filled with old machinery, long since abandoned（房间里满是早已废弃的旧机器）

🇳 突然，他发现地板上有一个娃娃——在工厂里是个奇怪的景象。
suddenly（突然） spotted a doll on the floor - an odd sight in a factory（发现地上有个娃娃——在工厂里是个奇怪的景象）
Suddenly, he spotted a doll on the floor - an odd sight in a factory.
11
🇳 它又旧又破，一只玻璃眼茫然地盯着天花板。
old and tattered（破旧不堪） with one glassy eye staring blankly at the ceiling（一只玻璃眼空洞地盯着天花板）
It was old and tattered, with one glassy eye staring blankly at the ceiling.
12
🇳 被娃娃的景象 unsettled，David决定离开房间。
unsettled by the sight of the doll（被娃娃的景象弄得不安） decided to leave the room（决定离开房间）
Unsettled by the sight of the doll, David decided to leave the room.
13

but as he turned（但当他转身） heard a soft giggle echoing through the room（听到轻柔的笑声在房间里回荡）

14

chill ran down his spine（脊背发凉）

15
🇳 他猛地转身，用手电筒重新照向娃娃。

🇳 恐慌涌上David的喉咙，但他试图摆脱它。

Panic rose in David's throat, but he tried to shake it off.
18

19
🇳 但当他转身离开时，他又听到了咯咯笑声，这次更大更邪恶。

🇳 他决定回到保安室，希望平复神经。
decided to return to the security office（决定返回保安室） hoping to calm his nerves（希望平复紧张的心情）

🇳 当他坐下时，他注意到保安监视器在闪烁。

27

as he squinted to see clearly（眯眼细看时） he gasped（他倒抽一口气）

the key to the room（房间的钥匙）

David was paralyzed with fear（David被恐惧吓得动弹不得）

短篇小说 / Short Story — 2022 年 — 山中风暴：徒步者的幸存

📋 2022 Q8 Part B Learning English through Short Stories
You entered the 'Stories of Survival' short story competition. The theme of this year's competition is 'Nature: friend or enemy?' Write a story about a hiker who gets caught in a storm while hiking in the mountains.
1
🇳 作为经验丰富的徒步者，David总在自然的怀抱中找到慰藉。
as a seasoned hiker（作为一名经验丰富的徒步者） found solace in the embrace of nature（在大自然的怀抱中找到慰藉）
As a seasoned hiker, David had always found solace in the embrace of nature.
2
🇳 伟大的户外是他的避难所，一个宁静的地方，他可以在脚步的节奏和荒野的交响乐中迷失自己。
great outdoors was his sanctuary（辽阔的户外是他的庇护所） place of tranquility（宁静之地） lose himself in the rhythm of his footsteps and the symphony of the wilderness（沉浸在自己脚步的节奏和荒野的交响乐中）
The great outdoors was his sanctuary, a place of tranquility where he could lose himself in the rhythm of his footsteps and the symphony of the wilderness.
3
🇳 但一个命运之日，自然露出了不同的面孔，一张既严酷又美丽的面孔。
but one fateful day（但在命运攸关的一天） nature revealed a different face（大自然展现了另一面） a face that was as harsh as it was beautiful（一张既冷峻又美丽的面孔）
But one fateful day, nature revealed a different face, a face that was as harsh as it was beautiful.
4
🇳 David在科罗拉多崎岖的山中独自徒步。
on a solo trek through the rugged mountains of Colorado（在穿越科罗拉多崎岖山脉的独自徒步中）
David was on a solo trek through the rugged mountains of Colorado.
5
🇳 这一天像任何其他一天开始，太阳温暖地照在他背上，他沿着陡峭的小径上行。
day started like any other（这一天像往常一样开始） sun a warm presence on his back（阳光温暖地洒在他背上） as he made his way up the steep trail（攀爬陡峭小径时）
The day started like any other, the sun a warm presence on his back as he made his way up the steep trail.
6
🇳 但当下午转为傍晚，天空开始不祥地变暗，之前清晰的地平线现在布满暴风云。
but as afternoon turned into evening（当下午转为傍晚） sky began to darken ominously（天空开始不祥地变暗） previously clear horizon now heavy with storm clouds（先前清晰的地平线现在被暴风云笼罩）
But as afternoon turned into evening, the sky began to darken ominously, the previously clear horizon now heavy with storm clouds.
7
🇳 他加快步伐，希望在风暴来袭前到达营地的遮蔽处。
quickened his pace（加快了脚步） hoping to reach the shelter of his campsite before the storm hit（希望在暴风雨来临前到达营地的庇护所）
He quickened his pace, hoping to reach the shelter of his campsite before the storm hit.
8
🇳 但自然有其他计划。
but nature had other plans（但大自然另有安排）
But nature had other plans.
9
🇳 风暴在风和雨的猛烈攻击中降临，将小径变成湿滑危险的道路。
storm descended in a furious onslaught of wind and rain（暴风雨以狂风暴雨的猛烈攻势降临） turning the trail into a slippery, treacherous path（将小径变成了湿滑危险的路）
The storm descended in a furious onslaught of wind and rain, turning the trail into a slippery, treacherous path.
10
🇳 雷声在山腰咆哮，闪电在刺眼的闪光中照亮被风暴袭击的景观。
thunder roared across the mountainside（雷声在山腰轰鸣） lightning illuminating the storm-lashed landscape in stark flashes（闪电以刺眼的闪光照亮被暴风雨肆虐的大地）
Thunder roared across the mountainside, lightning illuminating the storm-lashed landscape in stark flashes.
11
🇳 荒野的宁静变成了混乱和原始力量的风暴。
tranquility of the wilderness had turned into a tempest of chaos and raw power（荒野的宁静已变成混乱与原始力量的暴风雨）
The tranquility of the wilderness had turned into a tempest of chaos and raw power.
12
🇳 有一刻，恐惧攫住了他。
for a moment（有那么一刻） fear gripped him（恐惧攫住了他）
For a moment, fear gripped him.
13
🇳 他独自一人，暴露在风暴的愤怒下，距离最近的遮蔽处数英里。
alone（独自的） exposed to the wrath of the storm（暴露在暴风雨的愤怒之下） miles away from the nearest shelter（离最近的庇护所还有数英里）
He was alone, exposed to the wrath of the storm, miles away from the nearest shelter.
14
🇳 但屈服于恐慌现在帮不了他。
but surrendering to panic would not help him now（但屈服于恐慌无济于事）
But surrendering to panic would not help him now.
15
🇳 凭借他多年的徒步经验，他知道需要保持冷静并理性思考。
drawing upon his years of hiking experience（借助多年的徒步经验） knew he needed to stay calm and think rationally（知道他需要保持冷静理性思考）
Drawing upon his years of hiking experience, he knew he needed to stay calm and think rationally.
16
🇳 他找到一个小悬岩，提供了一些躲避无情雨水的遮蔽。
found a small overhang that offered some shelter from the relentless rain（找到一处小岩架，能稍微躲避无休止的大雨）
He found a small overhang that offered some shelter from the relentless rain.
17
🇳 他在那里缩成一团，裹在防水夹克里，在风暴在他周围肆虐时试图保暖。
huddled there（蜷缩在那里） wrapping himself in his waterproof jacket（裹紧防水夹克） trying to stay warm as the storm raged around him（在暴风雨肆虐时努力保持温暖）
He huddled there, wrapping himself in his waterproof jacket, trying to stay warm as the storm raged around him.
18
🇳 他以新的敬意注视风暴，它的纯粹力量是他自己脆弱的鲜明提醒。
watched the storm with a newfound respect for nature（带着对自然新生的敬畏看着暴风雨） its sheer power a stark reminder of his own vulnerability（其纯粹的力量鲜明地提醒着他自己的脆弱）
He watched the storm with a newfound respect for nature, its sheer power a stark reminder of his own vulnerability.
19
🇳 夜晚是耐力的战斗。
night was a battle of endurance（那个夜晚是一场耐力的战斗）
The night was a battle of endurance.
20
🇳 但当黎明破晓，风暴逐渐平息。
but as dawn broke（当黎明破晓） the storm gradually subsided（暴风雨逐渐减弱）
But as dawn broke, the storm gradually subsided.
21
🇳 太阳从散去的云中窥视，在被雨水浸透的景观上投下金色光芒。
sun peeked through the dispersing clouds（阳光从散开的云层中探出） casting a golden glow on the rain-soaked landscape（为雨浸大地洒下金光）
The sun peeked through the dispersing clouds, casting a golden glow on the rain-soaked landscape.
22
🇳 世界被洗得干净，空气清新令人振奋。
world was washed clean（世界被冲刷干净） air fresh and invigorating（空气清新提神）
The world was washed clean, the air fresh and invigorating.
23
🇳 David从遮蔽处出来，疲惫但未被击败。
emerged from his shelter（从他的庇护所中出来） weary but unbroken（疲惫但不屈）
David emerged from his shelter, weary but unbroken.
24
🇳 这次磨难是一次令人谦卑的经历。
ordeal had been a humbling experience（这次磨难是一次让人谦虚的经历）
The ordeal had been a humbling experience.
25
🇳 他看到了自然的愤怒，感受到了它无情的力量。
had seen the fury of nature（见识过大自然的愤怒） had felt its merciless power（感受过它无情的力量）
He had seen the fury of nature, had felt its merciless power.
26
🇳 但他也看到了它的美丽，它更新的能力，它不屈的精神。
but he had also seen its beauty（但他也见过它的美） its capacity for renewal（它的自我更新能力） its indomitable spirit（它不屈不挠的精神）
But he had also seen its beauty, its capacity for renewal, its indomitable spirit.
27
🇳 在风暴面前，David曾是一个入侵者，在广阔荒野中只是一个小点。
in the face of the storm（在暴风雨面前） David had been an intruder（David是个闯入者） a mere speck against the vastness of the wild（在广袤荒野面前不过是微小的一点）
In the face of the storm, David had been an intruder, a mere speck against the vastness of the wild.
28
🇳 但在其后果中，他是一个幸存者，是生命和更新无休止循环的一部分。
but in its aftermath（但在那之后） he was a survivor（他是个幸存者） part of the ceaseless cycle of life and renewal（生命与更新不息循环的一部分）
But in its aftermath, he was a survivor, a part of the ceaseless cycle of life and renewal.
29
🇳 自然既是朋友也是敌人，是其双重性格的证明。
nature had been both a friend and an enemy（大自然既是朋友也是敌人） testament to its dual character（其双重特性的证明）
Nature had been both a friend and an enemy, a testament to its dual character.
30
🇳 当他继续旅程，山中回响着远处的雷声，他带着对自然更深的欣赏，它不可预测力量的提醒，以及它对那些敢于冒险进入其领域的人要求的韧性。
as he continued his journey（继续旅程时） mountains echoing with the distant rumble of thunder（山间回荡着远处雷声的轰鸣） carried with him a deeper appreciation for nature（带着对自然更深的感悟） reminder of its unpredictable power（对其不可预测力量的提醒） resilience it demands from those who dare to venture into its realm（它对敢于涉足其领域的人所要求的韧性）

职场邮件 / Workplace Email — 2018 年 — 关于下班后沟通的邮件

共18句 · 中文已直接显示。点击词伙提示 → 显示原文

📋 2018 Q3 Part B Learning English through Workplace Communication
You are the boss of Reboot Online Company and you have recently received complaints from some staff about the number of work-related emails and text messages received out of office. Write a letter to staff addressing their complaints.
1
🇳 主题：关于下班后沟通的关切
Subject: Addressing Concerns Regarding After-Hours Communication（主题：关于非工作时间沟通问题的回应）
Subject: Addressing Concerns Regarding After-Hours Communication
2
🇳 亲爱的团队，希望大家一切都好。
Dear Team（亲爱的团队） I trust this message finds you well（相信您收到此信息时一切安好）
Dear Team, I trust this message finds you well.
3
🇳 我写信回应引起我注意的一个关切，关于办公时间外收到的工作相关邮件和短信数量。
writing to address a concern that has been brought to my attention（写信处理一个引起我注意的问题） concerning the number of work-related emails and text messages received outside of office hours（关于工作时间外收到的工作邮件和短信数量）
I am writing to address a concern that has been brought to my attention concerning the number of work-related emails and text messages received outside of office hours.
4
🇳 首先，我想承认你们对工作的奉献和对公司的宝贵贡献。
firstly（首先） would like to acknowledge your dedication to your work and the valuable contributions you make to our company（肯定你对工作的投入和宝贵贡献）
Firstly, I would like to acknowledge your dedication to your work and the valuable contributions you make to our company.
5
🇳 你们的努力和承诺不会被忽视。
your hard work and commitment do not go unnoticed（你们的努力和付出被看在眼里）
Your hard work and commitment do not go unnoticed.
6
🇳 我也理解保持健康的工作生活平衡对你们的福祉和整体生产力至关重要，这是我们在Reboot Online高度重视的原则。
also understand that maintaining a healthy work-life balance is crucial for your well-being and overall productivity（也理解保持工作与生活平衡对身心健康和生产力至关重要） a principle we hold in high regard here at Reboot Online（我们在Reboot Online高度重视的原则）
I also understand that maintaining a healthy work-life balance is crucial for your well-being and overall productivity, and it is a principle we hold in high regard here at Reboot Online.
7
🇳 鉴于提出的关切，我想强调，虽然我们工作的性质常要求我们保持连接，但我们的政策不是期望员工全天候可用。
in light of the concerns raised（鉴于所提出的关切） want to emphasize that（想强调） although the nature of our work often requires us to remain connected（尽管工作性质常需要保持联系） it is not our policy to expect employees to be available around the clock（期望员工全天候待命不是我们的政策）
In light of the concerns raised, I want to emphasize that although the nature of our work often requires us to remain connected, it is not our policy to expect employees to be available around the clock.
8
🇳 每个人都应该有时间休息、充电，在工作之外度过不受打扰的优质时间。
everyone deserves to have time to rest, recharge, and spend quality time outside of work without interruption（每个人都应该有休息、充电和不受打扰地享受工作之外时光的权利）
Everyone deserves to have time to rest, recharge, and spend quality time outside of work without interruption.
9
🇳 为了解决这个问题，我提出以下措施：
to address this issue（为解决这个问题） I propose the following measures（我提议以下措施）
To address this issue, I propose the following measures:
10
🇳 设定界限：除非是需要立即处理的最紧急事项，请避免在办公时间外发送非关键工作信息。
set boundaries（设定边界） unless it is a matter of utmost urgency that requires immediate attention（除非是极为紧急需要立即关注的事项） please refrain from sending non-critical work-related messages outside of office hours（请避免在工作时间外发送非关键的工作消息）
Set Boundaries: Unless it is a matter of utmost urgency that requires immediate attention, please refrain from sending non-critical work-related messages outside of office hours.
11
🇳 使用"请勿打扰"或"外出"功能：在邮件或消息应用中使用这些功能来指示你不可用的时间。
use "Do Not Disturb" or "Out of Office" features（使用「免打扰」或「外出」功能） make use of these features in your email or messaging apps to indicate times when you are unavailable（利用邮件或通讯应用中的这些功能标明你的不可用时间）
Use "Do Not Disturb" or "Out of Office" Features: Make use of these features in your email or messaging apps to indicate times when you are unavailable.
12
🇳 优先沟通：如果某事可以等到下一个工作日，请这样做。如果紧急，请打电话而不是发邮件或短信。
prioritize communication（优先考虑沟通） if something can wait until the next business day, please do so（如果事情可以等到下一个工作日，请这样做） if something is urgent, please call instead of sending an email or text（如果是紧急事项，请打电话而非发邮件或短信）
Prioritize Communication: If something can wait until the next business day, please do so. If something is urgent, please call instead of sending an email or text.
13
🇳 尊重他人时间：发送消息前，考虑是否有必要在那个时间发送，或者是否可以等到正常工作时间。
respect others' time（尊重他人时间） before sending a message, consider if it is necessary to send it at that time or if it can wait until normal working hours（发消息前考虑是否必须立即发送还是可以等到工作时间）
Respect Others' Time: Before sending a message, consider if it is necessary to send it at that time or if it can wait until normal working hours.
14
🇳 通过实施这些措施，我相信我们可以为每个人创造更尊重和平衡的工作环境。
by implementing these measures（通过实施这些措施） believe we can create a more respectful and balanced working environment for everyone（相信能为每个人创造更尊重更平衡的工作环境）
By implementing these measures, I believe we can create a more respectful and balanced working environment for everyone.
15
🇳 最后，我想感谢大家对Reboot Online的辛勤工作和奉献。
in closing（最后） would like to thank you all for your hard work and dedication to Reboot Online（感谢大家为Reboot Online的辛勤付出）
In closing, I would like to thank you all for your hard work and dedication to Reboot Online.
16
🇳 你们的福祉对我们很重要，我们致力于确保你们感到被尊重和重视。
your well-being is important to us（你的身心健康对我们很重要） committed to ensuring that you feel respected and valued（致力于确保你感到被尊重和珍视）
Your well-being is important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that you feel respected and valued.
17
🇳 欢迎并感谢你们的反馈，所以请不要犹豫分享你的想法或关切。
your feedback is always welcome and appreciated（你的反馈始终受欢迎） please do not hesitate to share your thoughts or concerns（请随时分享你的想法或顾虑）
Your feedback is always welcome and appreciated, so please do not hesitate to share your thoughts or concerns.
18
🇳 感谢你们的理解和合作。
thank you for your understanding and cooperation（感谢你的理解和配合）
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. ---

📋 2019 Q8 Part B Learning English through Workplace Communication
You are a volunteer in your local district council office. You have been asked to design a campaign poster for Ricky Kwan, a candidate who will be running in the upcoming council election. You have finished two designs (A and B) and are working on a third (C). Write an email to the council election committee. Explain the ideas behind designs A and B and how they would make a good campaign theme. Share the ideas you have for your third design. Include a subject heading for the email.
1
🇳 主题：Ricky Kwan竞选海报的构思与设计进度
Subject: Conceptualization and Design Progress of Ricky Kwan's Campaign Posters（主题：Ricky Kwan竞选海报的设计进度）
Subject: Conceptualization and Design Progress of Ricky Kwan's Campaign Posters
2
🇳 亲爱的议会选举委员会，希望这封邮件找到您时一切都好。
Dear Council Election Committee（尊敬的议会选举委员会） I trust this email finds you well（相信您收到此邮件时一切安好）
Dear Council Election Committee, I trust this email finds you well.
3
🇳 我写信向您更新Ricky Kwan即将到来的议会选举竞选海报的开发情况。
writing to update you on the development of Ricky Kwan's campaign posters for the upcoming council elections（写信汇报Ricky Kwan竞选海报的设计进展）
I am writing to update you on the development of Ricky Kwan's campaign posters for the upcoming council elections.
4
🇳 我们团队已完成两个设计（A和B），目前正在构思第三个（设计C）。
our team has completed two designs (A and B)（我们的团队已完成两个设计（A和B）） currently conceptualizing a third (design C)（目前正在构思第三个（设计C））
Our team has completed two designs (A and B) and we are currently conceptualizing a third (design C).
5
🇳 设计A描绘了两个男人握手，这是协议、合作和相互尊重的象征。
Design A is a depiction of two men shaking hands（设计A描绘两人握手） symbol of agreement, cooperation, and mutual respect（同意、合作和相互尊重的象征）
Design A is a depiction of two men shaking hands which is a symbol of agreement, cooperation, and mutual respect.
6
🇳 标语"有想法、问题或关切？让我们一起过桥。投Ricky Kwan！"强调了Ricky与选民积极对话和共同解决问题的承诺。
tagline underscores Ricky's commitment to engage in active dialogue with the electorate and solve problems collectively（口号强调了Ricky与选民积极对话并共同解决问题的承诺）
The tagline, "Have ideas, problems, or concerns? Let's cross the bridge together. Vote Ricky Kwan!" underscores Ricky's commitment to engage in active dialogue with the electorate and solve problems collectively.
7
🇳 "一起过桥"的概念是一个隐喻，强调Ricky和选民之间的伙伴关系、相互信任和共同责任。
concept of 'crossing the bridge together' is a metaphor（「一起过桥」的概念是一个隐喻） emphasizes partnership, mutual trust, and shared responsibility between Ricky and his constituents（强调Ricky与选民之间的伙伴关系、相互信任和共同责任）
The concept of 'crossing the bridge together' is a metaphor that emphasizes partnership, mutual trust, and shared responsibility between Ricky and his constituents.
8
🇳 通过将Ricky呈现为重视每个声音的人，我们旨在培养团结和合作感，我们相信这会引起选民共鸣。
by presenting Ricky as someone who values every voice（将Ricky塑造为重视每个声音的人） aim to foster a sense of unity and collaboration（旨在培养团结协作意识） which we believe would resonate with voters（我们相信这会引起选民共鸣）
By presenting Ricky as someone who values every voice, we aim to foster a sense of unity and collaboration, which we believe would resonate with the voters.
9
🇳 设计B以一个热气球飘浮在天空为特色，标语是"跳出框框思考。投Ricky Kwan！"
Design B features a hot air balloon floating in the sky with the slogan（设计B以天空飘浮的热气球为特色） "Think outside the box. Vote Ricky Kwan!"（「跳出框框，投票给Ricky Kwan！」）
Design B features a hot air balloon floating in the sky with the slogan, "Think outside the box. Vote Ricky Kwan!"
10
🇳 热气球是自由、抱负和创新思维的象征。
hot air balloon is a symbol of freedom, ambition, and innovative thinking（热气球是自由、雄心和创新思维的象征）
The hot air balloon is a symbol of freedom, ambition, and innovative thinking.
11
🇳 它标志着Ricky愿意探索新视野，为我们面临的挑战找到创造性解决方案。
signifies Ricky's willingness to explore new horizons and find creative solutions to the challenges we face（表明Ricky愿意探索新视野并为面临的挑战寻找创意解决方案）
It signifies Ricky's willingness to explore new horizons and find creative solutions to the challenges we face.
12
🇳 标语鼓励选民拥抱非传统思维，投票给愿意打破模式实现进步的候选人。
tagline encourages voters to embrace unconventional thinking（口号鼓励选民拥抱非传统思维） vote for a candidate who is willing to break the mold to achieve progress（投票给愿意打破常规取得进步的候选人）
The tagline encourages voters to embrace unconventional thinking and vote for a candidate who is willing to break the mold to achieve progress.
13
🇳 我们相信这个设计会吸引重视创新并准备好接受新治理方法的选民。
believe this design would appeal to voters who value innovation and are ready for a fresh approach to governance（此设计会吸引重视创新和全新治理方式的选民）
We believe this design would appeal to voters who value innovation and are ready for a fresh approach to governance.
14
🇳 对于设计C，我们正在考虑描绘一个灯塔，标语是"指引前进的道路。投Ricky Kwan！"
for design C（关于设计C） considering a depiction of a lighthouse with the slogan（正在考虑以灯塔为图案配合标语） "Guiding the way forward. Vote Ricky Kwan!"（「引领前进，投票给Ricky Kwan！」）
For design C, we are considering a depiction of a lighthouse with the slogan, "Guiding the way forward. Vote Ricky Kwan!"
15
🇳 灯塔是指引、安全和信任的传统象征，我们相信它能有效传达Ricky作为能在不确定时期引导社区的领导者的角色。
lighthouse is a traditional symbol of guidance, safety, and trust（灯塔是引导、安全和信任的传统象征） effectively communicate Ricky's role as a leader who can guide the community through uncertain times（有效传达Ricky作为能引导社区度过不确定时期的领导者的角色）
The lighthouse is a traditional symbol of guidance, safety, and trust, which we believe would effectively communicate Ricky's role as a leader who can guide the community through uncertain times.
16
🇳 标语表明了Ricky前瞻性的方法和他带领我们区走向更美好未来的承诺。
tagline is indicative of Ricky's forward-thinking approach and his commitment to leading our district towards a better future（口号体现了Ricky的前瞻性方法和他带领选区走向更美好未来的承诺）
The tagline is indicative of Ricky's forward-thinking approach and his commitment to leading our district towards a better future.
17
🇳 我们有信心这些设计，以其生动的图像和引人注目的信息，将有效传达Ricky的价值观和愿景，从而帮助建立强大的竞选主题。
confident that these designs, with their vivid imagery and compelling messages（自信这些设计以生动的图像和有力的信息） would effectively communicate Ricky's values and vision（将有效传达Ricky的价值观和愿景） thereby helping to establish a strong campaign theme（从而帮助确立强有力的竞选主题）
We are confident that these designs, with their vivid imagery and compelling messages, would effectively communicate Ricky's values and vision, thereby helping to establish a strong campaign theme.
18
🇳 我们对委员会关于这些设计或我们提出的设计C概念的建议或反馈持开放态度。
open to suggestions or feedback from the committee on these designs or our proposed concept for design C（开放接纳委员会对这些设计或设计C提案的建议或反馈）
We are open to suggestions or feedback from the committee on these designs or our proposed concept for design C.
19
🇳 期待您的回复。
looking forward to your response（期待你的回复）

(Mindmap: Transportation / Purpose of the trip / Cost / Lunch / School Trip)
1
🇳 尊敬的家长，我写信为您提供我们下个月即将前往sky100的学校旅行的必要信息。

Dear Parents, I am writing to provide you with the necessary information regarding our upcoming school trip to sky100 next month.
2
🇳 这次旅行的目的是给学生独特的香港视角，更多了解我们城市的建筑和历史。
purpose of the trip is to give our students a unique perspective of Hong Kong（这次旅行的目的是让学生们从独特视角看香港） learn more about our city's architecture and history（了解更多城市的建筑和历史）
The purpose of the trip is to give our students a unique perspective of Hong Kong and to learn more about our city's architecture and history.

will depart from school at 9:00 a.m. using the school bus（将于上午9点乘校车从学校出发） expect to return by 4:00 p.m.（预计下午4点前返回）

cost of the trip is $150（旅行费用为150美元） covers the transportation, the entrance fee to sky100 and an educational guided tour（涵盖交通、sky100门票和一次教育导览游）
The cost of the trip is $150, which covers the transportation, the entrance fee to sky100 and an educational guided tour.

🇳 请在下周末前将准确金额让孩子带来。
please send the exact amount with your child by the end of next week（请在下周末前让孩子带上确切的金额）
Please send the exact amount with your child by the end of next week.
6
🇳 我们将在sky100的咖啡厅吃午餐。
will be having lunch at the sky100's cafe（将在sky100的咖啡厅用午餐）
We will be having lunch at the sky100's cafe.
7
🇳 如果学生希望购买纪念品，鼓励他们带额外的钱。
students are encouraged to bring additional money if they wish to purchase any souvenirs（鼓励学生带额外零钱如果想买纪念品）
Students are encouraged to bring additional money if they wish to purchase any souvenirs.

your child should wear their school uniform and comfortable shoes（孩子应穿校服和舒适鞋子）
Your child should wear their school uniform and comfortable shoes.
9
🇳 还请确保您的孩子带一瓶水、一顶帽子，并在出发前涂防晒霜。
please also ensure your child brings a bottle of water, a hat, and applies sunscreen before departure（也请确保孩子带一瓶水一顶帽子并在出发前涂抹防晒霜）
Please also ensure your child brings a bottle of water, a hat, and applies sunscreen before departure.
10
🇳 同意书今天将随孩子带回家。
permission slip will be sent home with your child today（家长同意书今天会由孩子带回家）
A permission slip will be sent home with your child today.
11
🇳 请在本周末前签字并交回。
please sign and return it by the end of this week（请在本周末前签字交回）
Please sign and return it by the end of this week.

🇳 如果您有任何进一步的问题或关切，请不要犹豫联系我。
should you have any further questions or concerns（如果你有任何进一步的问题或顾虑） please do not hesitate to contact me（请随时联系我）
Should you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact me.

thank you for your support in this educational endeavor（感谢你对这项教育活动的支持）
